Replace the whole of `supabase/schemas/51.rpc_dataset_columns__apply_dictionaries.sql` with:

```sql
/**
 * Replaces every dictionary binding of one dataset with the given set in
 * one transaction and returns how many the dataset has now. An empty set
 * removes them all.
 *
 * A `reference` binding explains a column. A `convert` binding also
 * translates its values when the dataset loads: pinned to its code list's
 * pairs as they are now (`is_pinned`, an uploaded dataset converted in
 * place), or following the live list (a linked dataset). Each converted
 * column's `data_type` becomes what the conversion outputs and comes back
 * when the binding stops converting, a `<column>_original` copy is kept
 * where asked, and `p_added_pairs` are appended to their code lists first,
 * so pinned pairs include them.
 *
 * SECURITY DEFINER because bindings are select-only for signed-in users:
 * this function and the linked-dataset apply are their only write paths.
 * Before it reads anything else it checks that the caller can edit the
 * dataset and can read dictionaries in the dataset's own workspace, and it
 * refuses any column, entry, or code list from another dataset,
 * dictionary, or workspace. Adding values needs Data Sources editor. Every
 * refusal raises with a stable `hint` the client maps to copy. A binding
 * without the conversion fields, and a call without `p_added_pairs`, still
 * work, so a client that sends neither keeps working.
 *
 * Calls `data_dictionaries__check_pairs` from
 * `50.rpc_data_dictionaries__save.sql`.
 *
 * @param p_dataset_id The dataset whose bindings are replaced.
 * @param p_bindings The full set, as `[{ dataset_column_id, dictionary_id,
 *   entry_id, code_list_id, mode, direction, keeps_original,
 *   value_overrides, is_pinned }]`.
 * @param p_added_pairs Values to append to code lists the set uses, as
 *   `[{ code_list_id, code, label }]`.
 * @returns How many bindings the dataset has after the apply.
 */
create or replace function public.rpc_dataset_columns__apply_dictionaries (
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb,
  p_added_pairs jsonb default '[]'::jsonb
) returns integer language plpgsql security definer
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_bindings jsonb := coalesce(p_bindings, '[]'::jsonb);
  v_num_bindings integer;
begin
  v_workspace_id := public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__authorize (p_dataset_id);

  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check (p_dataset_id, v_workspace_id, v_bindings, false);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__add_pairs (v_workspace_id, v_bindings, coalesce(p_added_pairs, '[]'::jsonb));
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__write (p_dataset_id, v_workspace_id, v_bindings);

  select count(*)::integer
  into v_num_bindings
  from public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings b
  where b.dataset_id = p_dataset_id;

  return v_num_bindings;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises with a stable hint when a set of bindings cannot be written to a
 * dataset: a malformed payload, a mode the dataset cannot take, a column
 * from another dataset or a kept original column, an entry outside its
 * dictionary or the dataset's workspace, a code list the entry does not
 * use, or a `map` override to a code the list does not have.
 *
 * @param p_is_for_linked_dataset Whether the set describes a source for a
 *   new linked dataset, whose converted columns follow the dictionary.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check (
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb,
  p_is_for_linked_dataset boolean
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_payload (p_bindings);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_conversion (p_bindings);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_modes (p_dataset_id, p_bindings, p_is_for_linked_dataset);

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (dataset_column_id uuid)
    left join public.dataset_columns dc on dc.id = b.dataset_column_id
    where
      dc.id is null or
      dc.dataset_id <> p_dataset_id or
      dc.dictionary_binding_id is not null
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every column must be one of this dataset''s own columns'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'column_not_in_dataset';
  end if;

  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_entries (p_workspace_id, p_bindings);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_overrides (p_bindings);
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `binding_payload_invalid` unless the set is an array of objects,
 * each naming a column, a dictionary, an entry, an optional code list, a
 * known mode and direction, and, when present, a boolean `keeps_original`
 * and `is_pinned` and an array `value_overrides`, with no column twice.
 * Each check runs on its own, before anything casts the payload.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_payload (p_bindings jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_uuid_pattern constant text :=
    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_bindings) is distinct from 'array' then
    raise exception 'Bindings must be an array'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) as e (binding)
    where jsonb_typeof(e.binding) <> 'object'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every binding must be an object'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) as e (binding)
    where
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'dataset_column_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'dictionary_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'entry_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      (e.binding ->> 'code_list_id') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'mode', '') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.dataset_columns__binding_mode)::text[]
      ) or
      coalesce(e.binding ->> 'direction', '') <> all (
        enum_range(null::public.dataset_columns__binding_direction)::text[]
      ) or
      jsonb_typeof(coalesce(e.binding -> 'keeps_original', 'false'::jsonb)) <> 'boolean' or
      jsonb_typeof(coalesce(e.binding -> 'is_pinned', 'false'::jsonb)) <> 'boolean' or
      jsonb_typeof(coalesce(e.binding -> 'value_overrides', '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every binding must name a column, dictionary, entry, mode, and direction, with well-formed conversion fields'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (dataset_column_id uuid)
    group by b.dataset_column_id
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'A column appears more than once'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `binding_payload_invalid` when a binding's conversion fields do
 * not fit its mode: `keeps_original`, `is_pinned`, and `value_overrides`
 * are for `convert` only; each override is an object naming a value once
 * (ignoring case and spaces around it), with an action of `keep`, `empty`,
 * or `map`, and a `code` only and always for `map`. Runs after
 * `..._check_payload`, so every field it casts has its type.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_conversion (p_bindings jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (mode text, keeps_original boolean, is_pinned boolean, value_overrides jsonb)
    where
      b.mode = 'reference' and (
        coalesce(b.keeps_original, false) or
        coalesce(b.is_pinned, false) or
        jsonb_array_length(coalesce(b.value_overrides, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Only a converted column keeps its original values, is pinned, or overrides values'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (value_overrides jsonb)
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(b.value_overrides, '[]'::jsonb)) as o (override)
    where
      jsonb_typeof(o.override) <> 'object' or
      jsonb_typeof(o.override -> 'value') is distinct from 'string' or
      coalesce(o.override ->> 'action', '') not in ('keep', 'empty', 'map') or
      (o.override ->> 'action' = 'map') is distinct from (jsonb_typeof(o.override -> 'code') is not distinct from 'string')
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every override needs a value and an action, and a code only for map'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) with ordinality as e (binding, binding_index)
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(e.binding -> 'value_overrides', '[]'::jsonb)) as o (override)
    group by e.binding_index, lower(btrim(o.override ->> 'value'))
    having count(*) > 1
  ) then
    raise exception 'A value is overridden more than once in one column'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises when a binding converts in a way its dataset cannot: a `convert`
 * binding without a code list (`convert_needs_code_list`); in place, a
 * pinned conversion of anything but an upload or a live one of anything
 * but a linked dataset (`binding_mode_unsupported`), or a pinned
 * conversion of a dataset a linked dataset reads
 * (`dataset_has_linked_datasets`); for a new linked dataset, a pinned
 * conversion or none at all (`binding_payload_invalid`).
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_modes (
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb,
  p_is_for_linked_dataset boolean
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_source_type public.datasets__source_type;
  v_is_linked boolean;
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (mode text, code_list_id uuid)
    where b.mode = 'convert' and b.code_list_id is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'A converted column needs a code list'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'convert_needs_code_list';
  end if;

  if p_is_for_linked_dataset then
    if
      exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (mode text, is_pinned boolean)
        where b.mode = 'convert' and coalesce(b.is_pinned, false)
      ) or
      not exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (mode text)
        where b.mode = 'convert'
      )
    then
      raise exception 'A linked dataset converts at least one column and follows the dictionary'
        using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
    end if;

    return;
  end if;

  select ds.source_type, v.linked_source_dataset_id is not null
  into v_source_type, v_is_linked
  from public.datasets ds
  left join public.datasets__virtual v on v.dataset_id = ds.id
  where ds.id = p_dataset_id;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (mode text, is_pinned boolean)
    where
      b.mode = 'convert' and
      not (
        (coalesce(b.is_pinned, false) and v_source_type in ('csv_file', 'xlsx_file', 'pdf_file')) or
        (not coalesce(b.is_pinned, false) and coalesce(v_is_linked, false))
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'This dataset cannot be converted that way'
      using errcode = '0A000', hint = 'binding_mode_unsupported';
  end if;

  if
    exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (mode text, is_pinned boolean)
      where b.mode = 'convert' and coalesce(b.is_pinned, false)
    ) and
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.datasets__virtual v
      where v.linked_source_dataset_id = p_dataset_id
    )
  then
    raise exception 'A linked dataset reads this dataset, so it cannot be converted in place'
      using errcode = '0A000', hint = 'dataset_has_linked_datasets';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises with a stable hint when a binding's entry is not in its dictionary
 * and the dataset's workspace, or its code list is not one the entry uses.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_entries (p_workspace_id uuid, p_bindings jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (dictionary_id uuid, entry_id uuid)
    left join public.data_dictionaries__entries en on
      en.id = b.entry_id and
      en.dictionary_id = b.dictionary_id and
      en.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    where en.id is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every entry must belong to its dictionary in this workspace'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'entry_not_in_dictionary';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (entry_id uuid, code_list_id uuid)
    where
      b.code_list_id is not null and
      not exists (
        select 1
        from public.data_dictionaries__entry_codings ec
        where ec.entry_id = b.entry_id and ec.code_list_id = b.code_list_id
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'A binding''s code list must be one its entry uses'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'code_list_not_in_entry';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Raises `binding_payload_invalid` when a `map` override names a code its
 * binding's code list does not have. Codes compare trimmed and ignoring
 * case, as conversions compare them. Runs after `..._check_entries`, so
 * every code list is the binding's own.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check_overrides (p_bindings jsonb) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (code_list_id uuid, value_overrides jsonb)
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(b.value_overrides, '[]'::jsonb)) as o (override)
    left join public.data_dictionaries__code_lists cl on cl.id = b.code_list_id
    where
      o.override ->> 'action' = 'map' and
      not exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cl.pairs, '[]'::jsonb)) as p (pair)
        where lower(btrim(p.pair ->> 'code')) = lower(btrim(o.override ->> 'code'))
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'A map override must name a code in its column''s list'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Each code list `p_added_pairs` adds to, as `{ id, pairs }` with the new
 * values appended in the order given, trimmed, with no accepted spellings
 * and not missing: the shape `data_dictionaries__check_pairs` checks.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__merge_pairs (p_added_pairs jsonb) returns jsonb language sql stable
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', cl.id, 'pairs', cl.pairs || added.pairs)),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  from public.data_dictionaries__code_lists cl
  join (
    select
      (a.pair ->> 'code_list_id')::uuid as code_list_id,
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'code', btrim(a.pair ->> 'code'),
          'label', btrim(a.pair ->> 'label'),
          'accepted_spellings', '[]'::jsonb,
          'is_missing', false
        )
        order by a.pair_index
      ) as pairs
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_added_pairs) with ordinality as a (pair, pair_index)
    group by (a.pair ->> 'code_list_id')::uuid
  ) as added on added.code_list_id = cl.id;
$$;

/**
 * Appends `p_added_pairs` to their code lists and bumps each touched
 * dictionary's version once, as a dictionary save would. The merged lists
 * were checked by `data_dictionaries__check_pairs` first.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__write_pairs (p_added_pairs jsonb) returns void language sql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  with
    merged as (
      select (l.list ->> 'id')::uuid as id, l.list -> 'pairs' as pairs
      from jsonb_array_elements(public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__merge_pairs (p_added_pairs)) as l (list)
    ),
    updated as (
      update public.data_dictionaries__code_lists cl
      set pairs = merged.pairs
      from merged
      where cl.id = merged.id
      returning cl.dictionary_id
    )
  update public.data_dictionaries d
  set version = d.version + 1
  where d.id in (select u.dictionary_id from updated u);
$$;

/**
 * Appends the values the user added while applying to their code lists,
 * checked as a dictionary save checks them, bumps each touched
 * dictionary's version once, and re-types every live converted column of
 * those lists. Each value must go to a code list the set uses, and adding
 * needs Data Sources editor in the workspace. An empty `p_added_pairs`
 * changes nothing.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__add_pairs (
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb,
  p_added_pairs jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_uuid_pattern constant text :=
    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
  v_code_list_ids uuid[];
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_added_pairs) is distinct from 'array' then
    raise exception 'Added values must be an array'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  if jsonb_array_length(p_added_pairs) = 0 then
    return;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_added_pairs) as a (pair)
    where
      jsonb_typeof(a.pair) <> 'object' or
      coalesce(a.pair ->> 'code_list_id', '') !~* v_uuid_pattern or
      jsonb_typeof(a.pair -> 'code') is distinct from 'string' or
      jsonb_typeof(a.pair -> 'label') is distinct from 'string'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Every added value needs a code list, a code, and a label'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  v_code_list_ids := array(
    select distinct (a.pair ->> 'code_list_id')::uuid
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_added_pairs) as a (pair)
  );

  if exists (
    select 1
    from unnest(v_code_list_ids) as l (id)
    where not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as b (code_list_id uuid)
      where b.code_list_id = l.id
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'A value can only be added to a code list this apply uses'
      using errcode = '23514', hint = 'code_list_not_in_entry';
  end if;

  if not public.util__auth_user_meets_min_app_role (
    p_workspace_id,
    'data_sources'::public.app_type,
    'editor'::public.role_level
  ) then
    raise exception 'Only Data Sources editors can add values to a code list'
      using errcode = '42501', hint = 'dictionary_editor_required';
  end if;

  perform 1
  from public.data_dictionaries d
  where d.id in (
    select cl.dictionary_id
    from public.data_dictionaries__code_lists cl
    where cl.id = any (v_code_list_ids)
  )
  for update;

  perform public.data_dictionaries__check_pairs (public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__merge_pairs (p_added_pairs));
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__write_pairs (p_added_pairs);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__sync_live_types (v_code_list_ids);
end;
$$;

/**
 * Puts back the `data_type` of every column of `p_dataset_id` whose convert
 * binding the new set no longer converts: one left out, or one now
 * `reference`. Runs before the set is written, while the old bindings
 * still say which type each column replaced.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__restore_types (p_dataset_id uuid, p_bindings jsonb) returns void language sql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  update public.dataset_columns dc
  set data_type = b.replaced_data_type
  from public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings b
  where
    b.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and
    b.mode = 'convert' and
    b.replaced_data_type is not null and
    dc.id = b.dataset_column_id and
    not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as n (dataset_column_id uuid, mode text)
      where n.dataset_column_id = b.dataset_column_id and n.mode = 'convert'
    );
$$;

/**
 * Deletes a dataset's bindings that the new set leaves out and upserts the
 * rest, recording each dictionary's current version. A pinned binding
 * copies its code list's pairs and order as they are now. A convert
 * binding remembers the type its column had before any conversion: the
 * prior binding's when the column was already converted, the column's own
 * otherwise.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__upsert (
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb
) returns void language sql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  delete from public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings b
  where
    b.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and
    not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as n (dataset_column_id uuid)
      where n.dataset_column_id = b.dataset_column_id
    );

  insert into public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings (
    workspace_id, dataset_id, dataset_column_id, dictionary_id, entry_id,
    code_list_id, mode, direction, applied_dictionary_version, keeps_original,
    value_overrides, pinned_pairs, pinned_is_ordered, replaced_data_type
  )
  select
    p_workspace_id, p_dataset_id, n.dataset_column_id, n.dictionary_id, n.entry_id,
    n.code_list_id, n.mode::public.dataset_columns__binding_mode,
    n.direction::public.dataset_columns__binding_direction, d.version,
    coalesce(n.keeps_original, false), coalesce(n.value_overrides, '[]'::jsonb),
    case when coalesce(n.is_pinned, false) then cl.pairs end,
    case when coalesce(n.is_pinned, false) then cl.is_ordered end,
    case when n.mode = 'convert' then coalesce(prior.replaced_data_type, dc.data_type) end
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_bindings) as n (
    dataset_column_id uuid, dictionary_id uuid, entry_id uuid, code_list_id uuid,
    mode text, direction text, keeps_original boolean, value_overrides jsonb, is_pinned boolean
  )
  join public.data_dictionaries d on d.id = n.dictionary_id
  join public.dataset_columns dc on dc.id = n.dataset_column_id
  left join public.data_dictionaries__code_lists cl on cl.id = n.code_list_id
  left join public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings prior on
    prior.dataset_column_id = n.dataset_column_id and
    prior.mode = 'convert'
  on conflict (dataset_column_id) do update
  set
    dictionary_id = excluded.dictionary_id,
    entry_id = excluded.entry_id,
    code_list_id = excluded.code_list_id,
    mode = excluded.mode,
    direction = excluded.direction,
    applied_dictionary_version = excluded.applied_dictionary_version,
    keeps_original = excluded.keeps_original,
    value_overrides = excluded.value_overrides,
    pinned_pairs = excluded.pinned_pairs,
    pinned_is_ordered = excluded.pinned_is_ordered,
    replaced_data_type = excluded.replaced_data_type;
$$;

/**
 * Keeps one `<column>_original` copy for every convert binding of
 * `p_dataset_id` that keeps its original values, and none for the rest. A
 * new copy reads the column's stored values (its `original_name`) with the
 * type the column had before converting, is named by
 * `dataset_columns__get_free_name`, and goes after the dataset's last
 * column. A copy that exists keeps its name, so a user's rename stays.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__sync_copies (p_dataset_id uuid) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_column record;
begin
  delete from public.dataset_columns dc
  using public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings b
  where
    dc.dictionary_binding_id = b.id and
    b.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and
    not (b.mode = 'convert' and b.keeps_original);

  for v_column in
    select b.id as binding_id, b.replaced_data_type, dc.workspace_id, dc.original_name, dc.name, dc.original_data_type, dc.detected_data_type
    from public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings b
    join public.dataset_columns dc on dc.id = b.dataset_column_id
    where
      b.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and
      b.mode = 'convert' and
      b.keeps_original and
      not exists (
        select 1
        from public.dataset_columns c
        where c.dictionary_binding_id = b.id
      )
    order by dc.column_idx, dc.id
  loop
    insert into public.dataset_columns (
      dataset_id, workspace_id, original_name, name, original_data_type,
      detected_data_type, data_type, column_idx, dictionary_binding_id
    )
    select
      p_dataset_id, v_column.workspace_id, v_column.original_name,
      public.dataset_columns__get_free_name (p_dataset_id, v_column.name || '_original'),
      v_column.original_data_type, v_column.detected_data_type, v_column.replaced_data_type,
      coalesce(max(c.column_idx), -1) + 1, v_column.binding_id
    from public.dataset_columns c
    where c.dataset_id = p_dataset_id;
  end loop;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Writes a checked set of bindings to one dataset: restores the types of
 * columns that stop converting, upserts the set, sets the types of
 * converted columns, and keeps their original copies in step. Called by
 * both apply RPCs after their checks pass.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__write (
  p_dataset_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
begin
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__restore_types (p_dataset_id, p_bindings);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__upsert (p_dataset_id, p_workspace_id, p_bindings);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__set_types (p_dataset_id);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__sync_copies (p_dataset_id);
end;
$$;
```

The `language sql` helpers are declared before the helpers that call them (`merge_pairs` before `write_pairs`), because Postgres checks a SQL function's body, including the functions it calls, when it is created. The `plpgsql` functions are resolved when they run.

- [ ] **Step 7: Add the linked-dataset RPC.**

`supabase/schemas/52.rpc_dataset_columns__apply_dictionaries_as_linked_dataset.sql`:

```sql
/**
 * Creates a linked dataset over `p_source_dataset_id` in one transaction:
 * a virtual dataset that reads every column of its source
 * (`SELECT * FROM "<source id>"`) and converts the columns `p_bindings`
 * marks `convert`, through live convert bindings that follow the
 * dictionary. Columns the set binds as `reference` get the same reference
 * binding on the linked dataset, so their descriptions and code-list tags
 * follow. The source's bindings are replaced with the same set as
 * `reference`, so its values stay as stored and stay explained; any
 * in-place conversion it had is undone. Returns the new dataset's id.
 *
 * SECURITY DEFINER because bindings are select-only for signed-in users.
 * Before it reads anything else it checks dataset editor on the source,
 * Data Sources viewer, and the right to add a dataset to the workspace,
 * which any import needs. A refusal at any point, including while the new
 * dataset is being created, rolls the whole apply back.
 *
 * @param p_source_dataset_id The dataset the linked dataset reads. It may
 *   not itself be a linked dataset.
 * @param p_linked_dataset_id The new dataset's id, chosen by the caller.
 * @param p_linked_dataset_name The new dataset's name.
 * @param p_bindings The source's bindings, as for
 *   `rpc_dataset_columns__apply_dictionaries`, with `is_pinned` false.
 * @param p_added_pairs Values to append to code lists the set uses first.
 * @returns The new dataset's id.
 */
create or replace function public.rpc_dataset_columns__apply_dictionaries_as_linked_dataset (
  p_source_dataset_id uuid,
  p_linked_dataset_id uuid,
  p_linked_dataset_name text,
  p_bindings jsonb,
  p_added_pairs jsonb default '[]'::jsonb
) returns uuid language plpgsql security definer
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_bindings jsonb := coalesce(p_bindings, '[]'::jsonb);
begin
  v_workspace_id := public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__authorize (p_source_dataset_id);

  if not public.util__can_manage_workspace_settings (v_workspace_id) then
    raise exception 'Only a workspace admin can add a dataset'
      using errcode = '42501', hint = 'dataset_creator_required';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.datasets__virtual v
    where v.dataset_id = p_source_dataset_id and v.linked_source_dataset_id is not null
  ) then
    raise exception 'A linked dataset converts its own columns; apply to it directly'
      using errcode = '0A000', hint = 'binding_mode_unsupported';
  end if;

  if coalesce(btrim(p_linked_dataset_name), '') = '' then
    raise exception 'A linked dataset needs a name'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'binding_payload_invalid';
  end if;

  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__check (p_source_dataset_id, v_workspace_id, v_bindings, true);
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__add_pairs (v_workspace_id, v_bindings, coalesce(p_added_pairs, '[]'::jsonb));
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__write (p_source_dataset_id, v_workspace_id, public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__as_reference (v_bindings));
  perform public.datasets__virtual__create_linked (p_source_dataset_id, p_linked_dataset_id, v_workspace_id, btrim(p_linked_dataset_name));
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__write (
    p_linked_dataset_id,
    v_workspace_id,
    public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__for_linked_dataset (p_source_dataset_id, p_linked_dataset_id, v_bindings)
  );

  return p_linked_dataset_id;
end;
$$;

/**
 * The same bindings as `reference`: the same columns, entries, code lists,
 * and directions, with no conversion fields. What a linked dataset's
 * source keeps.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__as_reference (p_bindings jsonb) returns jsonb language sql immutable
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      (e.binding - 'keeps_original' - 'value_overrides' - 'is_pinned') || '{"mode":"reference"}'::jsonb
      order by e.binding_index
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) with ordinality as e (binding, binding_index);
$$;

/**
 * A source's set moved onto the linked dataset's columns of the same name:
 * each `convert` binding left live, and each `reference` binding as it is
 * (the checks already refused conversion fields on it), so the linked
 * dataset carries the same descriptions and code-list tags.
 */
create or replace function public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__for_linked_dataset (
  p_source_dataset_id uuid,
  p_linked_dataset_id uuid,
  p_bindings jsonb
) returns jsonb language sql stable
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      e.binding || jsonb_build_object('dataset_column_id', lc.id, 'is_pinned', false)
      order by lc.column_idx
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) as e (binding)
  join public.dataset_columns sc on
    sc.id = (e.binding ->> 'dataset_column_id')::uuid and
    sc.dataset_id = p_source_dataset_id
  join public.dataset_columns lc on
    lc.dataset_id = p_linked_dataset_id and
    lc.name = sc.name and
    lc.dictionary_binding_id is null;
$$;

/**
 * The DuckDB type a column of this Ava type has when a query reads it, the
 * rule `DuckDbDataTypeUtils.fromDatasetColumnType` follows. A linked
 * dataset's columns are detected as this, since it reads its source's
 * view.
 */
create or replace function public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (p_data_type public.datasets__ava_data_type) returns public.datasets__duckdb_data_type language sql immutable
set
  search_path = '' as $$
  select
    case p_data_type
      when 'varchar' then 'VARCHAR'
      when 'bigint' then 'BIGINT'
      when 'double' then 'DOUBLE'
      when 'time' then 'TIME'
      when 'date' then 'DATE'
      when 'timestamp' then 'TIMESTAMP'
      when 'boolean' then 'BOOLEAN'
    end::public.datasets__duckdb_data_type;
$$;

/**
 * Creates the virtual dataset a linked dataset is, with the source's
 * columns as its view names them (renamed names, current types), and
 * records the source. Kept original columns of the source are left out:
 * the source's own bindings were written as `reference` first, so it has
 * none.
 */
create or replace function public.datasets__virtual__create_linked (
  p_source_dataset_id uuid,
  p_linked_dataset_id uuid,
  p_workspace_id uuid,
  p_name text
) returns void language plpgsql
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_columns public.dataset_column_input[];
begin
  select coalesce(
    array_agg(
      row(
        dc.name,
        dc.name,
        dc.description,
        public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (dc.data_type)::text,
        public.datasets__ava_data_type_to_duckdb (dc.data_type),
        dc.data_type,
        dc.column_idx
      )::public.dataset_column_input
      order by dc.column_idx, dc.id
    ),
    array[]::public.dataset_column_input[]
  )
  into v_columns
  from public.dataset_columns dc
  where dc.dataset_id = p_source_dataset_id and dc.dictionary_binding_id is null;

  perform public.rpc_datasets__add_virtual_dataset (
    p_linked_dataset_id,
    p_workspace_id,
    p_name,
    null,
    v_columns,
    format('SELECT * FROM %I', p_source_dataset_id::text)
  );

  update public.datasets__virtual
  set linked_source_dataset_id = p_source_dataset_id
  where dataset_id = p_linked_dataset_id;
end;
$$;

```

`format('%I', ...)` quotes the id as an identifier, so the SQL is `SELECT * FROM "d4450001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"`: a uuid always contains `-`, and `%I` doubles any `"`, so the text cannot break out of the identifier. `rpc_datasets__add_virtual_dataset` is SECURITY INVOKER, so it runs as this function's owner here; `rpc_datasets__add_dataset` still checks `util__can_manage_workspace_settings` against the caller's `auth.uid()` and makes the caller the owner.

- [ ] **Step 8: Add the re-apply RPC.**

`supabase/schemas/50.rpc_dataset_columns__reapply_dictionary.sql`:

```sql
/**
 * Re-pins one dictionary's pinned convert bindings on one dataset to their
 * code lists' current pairs and order and the dictionary's current
 * version, and re-types their columns. A binding whose code list was
 * deleted keeps the pairs it has, since there is nothing to re-pin it to.
 * Live and reference bindings already follow the dictionary. Returns how
 * many bindings it re-pinned, and raises `nothing_to_reapply` when that is
 * none.
 *
 * SECURITY DEFINER because bindings are select-only for signed-in users.
 * It checks dataset editor and Data Sources viewer, as the apply does.
 *
 * @param p_dataset_id The dataset converted in place.
 * @param p_dictionary_id The dictionary to re-apply.
 * @returns How many bindings were re-pinned.
 */
create or replace function public.rpc_dataset_columns__reapply_dictionary (p_dataset_id uuid, p_dictionary_id uuid) returns integer language plpgsql security definer
set
  search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_num_repinned integer;
begin
  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__authorize (p_dataset_id);

  update public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings b
  set
    pinned_pairs = cl.pairs,
    pinned_is_ordered = cl.is_ordered,
    applied_dictionary_version = d.version
  from public.data_dictionaries__code_lists cl
  join public.data_dictionaries d on d.id = cl.dictionary_id
  where
    b.dataset_id = p_dataset_id and
    b.dictionary_id = p_dictionary_id and
    b.mode = 'convert' and
    b.pinned_pairs is not null and
    cl.id = b.code_list_id;

  get diagnostics v_num_repinned = row_count;

  if v_num_repinned = 0 then
    raise exception 'Nothing on this dataset is pinned to this dictionary'
      using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'nothing_to_reapply';
  end if;

  perform public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings__set_types (p_dataset_id);

  return v_num_repinned;
end;
$$;

revoke
execute on function public.rpc_dataset_columns__reapply_dictionary (uuid, uuid)
from
  public,
  anon,
  authenticated,
  service_role;

-- `authenticated` only. The function checks dataset edit rights itself.
grant
execute on function public.rpc_dataset_columns__reapply_dictionary (uuid, uuid) to authenticated;
```

### Task 6: The DictionaryBinding and DatasetColumn models: conversion fields

The binding model reads the columns Task 2 adds (`keeps_original`, `value_overrides`, `pinned_pairs`, `pinned_is_ordered`, `replaced_data_type`), the apply input carries what the user chose for a converted column, and the hint list knows every new refusal. `DatasetColumn` reads `dictionary_binding_id`, which marks a `<column>_original` copy, and `VirtualDataset` reads `linked_source_dataset_id`, which Tasks 11, 14, 15, and 22 read through the cached `VirtualDatasetClient`. The pinned pairs and the overrides stay outside the parser's deep key transforms, as a code list's `pairs` do, because `camelCaseKeysDeep` would rename `accepted_spellings` inside them.

**Needs Task 5's generated `shared/types/database.types.ts`.** The `ZodConsistencyTests` in each parser compare its `DBReadSchema` with the generated row, so they expect exactly these `Row` fields (any other nullability is a type error in Step 4):

| Table | Generated `Row` field |
| --- | --- |
| `dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings` | `keeps_original: boolean`, `pinned_is_ordered: boolean \| null`, `pinned_pairs: Json \| null`, `replaced_data_type: Database["public"]["Enums"]["datasets__ava_data_type"] \| null`, `value_overrides: Json` |
| `dataset_columns` | `dictionary_binding_id: string \| null` |
| `datasets__virtual` | `linked_source_dataset_id: string \| null` |

`supabaseJSONSchema` already accepts `null`, so `pinned_pairs: Json | null` and `value_overrides: Json` both parse with it.

`DatasetColumn.dictionaryBindingId` is an optional property (`?:`) rather than a required `| undefined`: 56 files build `DatasetColumn` values with `Model.make` in fixtures, and a required key would touch every one of them. A parsed column always carries it (as `undefined` for an ordinary column). `VirtualDataset.linkedSourceDatasetId` is required, since only its parser builds one.

`AttachStep.tsx` is the one place that builds a `DictionaryBinding.Input` literal; it gains the three new fields with their reference values so the tree keeps compiling until Task 20 replaces it.

```ts
import type { DataDictionaryId } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionary/DataDictionary.types.ts";
import type {
  CodePair,
  DataDictionaryCodeListId,
} from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.types.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryEntryId } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry.types.ts";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn.ts";
import type { SupabaseCrudModelSpec } from "$/models/SupabaseCrudModelSpec.ts";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace.ts";
import type { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import type { UUID } from "@avandar/utils";
import type { SetOptional } from "type-fest";

type ModelType = "DictionaryBinding";
export type DictionaryBindingId = UUID<ModelType>;

/**
 * What applying a dictionary does to a column. `reference` attaches the
 * entry's description and code list and leaves the values alone. `convert`
 * changes the values when the dataset loads.
 */
export type DictionaryBindingMode = "reference" | "convert";

/**
 * Which side of each code pair the column holds. `decode`: the column holds
 * codes, such as 1 and 2. `encode`: it holds labels, such as Male.
 */
export type DictionaryBindingDirection = "decode" | "encode";

/**
 * How one value no pair matches is resolved in a converted column. `keep`
 * leaves it as it is, `empty` turns it into an empty value, and `map`
 * converts it as if it were the pair whose code is `code`.
 */
export type DictionaryBindingValueOverride =
  | { value: string; action: "keep" }
  | { value: string; action: "empty" }
  | { value: string; action: "map"; code: string };

/** One dataset column bound to one dictionary entry. */
type DictionaryBindingRead = Model.Base<
  ModelType,
  {
    /** The dictionary's version when this binding was written */
    appliedDictionaryVersion: number;

    /** The entry's code list chosen for this column, if it has one */
    codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeListId | undefined;

    /** Timestamp of when the binding was created */
    createdAt: string;

    /** The bound column */
    datasetColumnId: DatasetColumn.Id;

    /** The dataset the column belongs to */
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;

    /** The dictionary the entry belongs to. Undefined once it is deleted. */
    dictionaryId: DataDictionaryId | undefined;

    /** Which side of each pair the column holds */
    direction: DictionaryBindingDirection;

    /** The bound entry. Undefined once it is deleted. */
    entryId: DataDictionaryEntryId | undefined;

    /** Unique identifier of the binding */
    id: DictionaryBindingId;

    /** Whether a `<column>_original` copy keeps the values as stored */
    keepsOriginal: boolean;

    /** Whether the column's values are converted or only explained */
    mode: DictionaryBindingMode;

    /** Whether the pinned pairs are levels of a scale. Set with them. */
    pinnedIsOrdered: boolean | undefined;

    /**
     * The pairs this column converts with, frozen when it was converted in
     * place or when its dictionary, entry, or code list was deleted.
     * Undefined while the binding follows its live code list.
     */
    pinnedPairs: CodePair[] | undefined;

    /**
     * The column's data type before this binding converted it, restored
     * when it stops converting. Undefined for a reference binding.
     */
    replacedDataType: AvaDataType.T | undefined;

    /** Timestamp of when the binding was last updated */
    updatedAt: string;

    /** How each value no pair matches is resolved. Empty unless converting. */
    valueOverrides: DictionaryBindingValueOverride[];

    /** Workspace this binding belongs to, always its dataset's */
    workspaceId: Workspace.Id;
  }
>;

/**
 * One column's binding as the apply RPC takes it: everything the user
 * chose, nothing the database fills in.
 */
export type DictionaryBindingInput = {
  datasetColumnId: DatasetColumn.Id;
  dictionaryId: DataDictionaryId;
  entryId: DataDictionaryEntryId;
  codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeListId | undefined;
  mode: DictionaryBindingMode;
  direction: DictionaryBindingDirection;
  /** Convert only: keep a `<column>_original` copy of the stored values. */
  keepsOriginal: boolean;
  /** Convert only: how each value no pair matches is resolved. */
  valueOverrides: readonly DictionaryBindingValueOverride[];
  /** Convert only: freeze today's pairs, for a dataset converted in place. */
  isPinned: boolean;
};

/** A value the user adds to a code list while applying. */
export type DictionaryBindingAddedPair = {
  codeListId: DataDictionaryCodeListId;
  code: string;
  label: string;
};

/**
 * A stable reason one of the apply RPCs refuses, sent as the error's
 * `hint`.
 */
export type DictionaryBindingApplyErrorHint =
  | "dataset_editor_required"
  | "dictionary_viewer_required"
  | "binding_payload_invalid"
  | "binding_mode_unsupported"
  | "column_not_in_dataset"
  | "entry_not_in_dictionary"
  | "code_list_not_in_entry"
  | "convert_needs_code_list"
  | "dataset_has_linked_datasets"
  | "dictionary_editor_required"
  | "code_pair_incomplete"
  | "codes_not_unique"
  | "labels_not_unique"
  | "dataset_creator_required"
  | "nothing_to_reapply";

/** CRUD type definitions for the DictionaryBinding model. */
export type DictionaryBindingModel = SupabaseCrudModelSpec<
  {
    tableName: "dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings";
    modelName: "DictionaryBinding";
    modelPrimaryKeyType: DictionaryBindingId;
    modelTypes: {
      Read: DictionaryBindingRead;
      Insert: SetOptional<
        DictionaryBindingRead,
        | "codeListId"
        | "createdAt"
        | "dictionaryId"
        | "direction"
        | "entryId"
        | "id"
        | "keepsOriginal"
        | "mode"
        | "pinnedIsOrdered"
        | "pinnedPairs"
        | "replacedDataType"
        | "updatedAt"
        | "valueOverrides"
      >;
      Update: Partial<DictionaryBindingRead>;
    };
  },
  {
    dbTablePrimaryKey: "id";
  }
>;
```

```ts
import { makeParserRegistry } from "@avandar/clients";
import { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import {
  camelCaseKeysDeep,
  excludeNullsExceptInProps,
  nullsToUndefinedDeep,
  snakeCaseKeysDeep,
  undefinedsToNullsDeep,
} from "@avandar/utils";
import { z } from "zod";
import { supabaseJSONSchema as supabaseJsonSchema } from "$/lib/zodHelpers.ts";
import {
  codePairsFromDBJson,
  codePairsToDBJson,
} from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryId } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionary/DataDictionary.types.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeListId } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.types.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryEntryId } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryEntry/DataDictionaryEntry.types.ts";
import type {
  DictionaryBindingId,
  DictionaryBindingModel,
  DictionaryBindingValueOverride,
} from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding.types.ts";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset.ts";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn.ts";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace.ts";
import type { Json } from "$/types/database.types.ts";
import type { Expect } from "@avandar/utils";
import type { ZodSchemaEqualsTypes } from "@utils/zod/index.ts";

const DBReadSchema = z.object({
  applied_dictionary_version: z.number().int(),
  code_list_id: z.uuid().nullable(),
  created_at: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }),
  dataset_column_id: z.uuid(),
  dataset_id: z.uuid(),
  dictionary_id: z.uuid().nullable(),
  direction: z.enum(["decode", "encode"]),
  entry_id: z.uuid().nullable(),
  id: z.uuid(),
  keeps_original: z.boolean(),
  mode: z.enum(["reference", "convert"]),
  pinned_is_ordered: z.boolean().nullable(),
  pinned_pairs: supabaseJsonSchema,
  replaced_data_type: z.enum(AvaDataType.Types).nullable(),
  updated_at: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }),
  value_overrides: supabaseJsonSchema,
  workspace_id: z.uuid(),
});

/** The stored shape of a binding's `value_overrides`. */
const StoredValueOverridesSchema = z.array(
  z.discriminatedUnion("action", [
    z.object({ value: z.string(), action: z.literal("keep") }),
    z.object({ value: z.string(), action: z.literal("empty") }),
    z.object({
      value: z.string(),
      action: z.literal("map"),
      code: z.string(),
    }),
  ]),
);

/** The binding columns stored as JSON, read and written on their own. */
type JsonProps = "pinnedPairs" | "valueOverrides";
type DBJsonProps = "pinned_pairs" | "value_overrides";
type ReadWithoutJson = Omit<DictionaryBindingModel["Read"], JsonProps>;
type DBReadWithoutJson = Omit<DictionaryBindingModel["DBRead"], DBJsonProps>;

/** Parses stored overrides, throwing when one is malformed. */
function _valueOverridesFromJson(
  valueOverrides: Json,
): DictionaryBindingValueOverride[] {
  return StoredValueOverridesSchema.parse(valueOverrides);
}

function _readRow(row: DBReadWithoutJson): ReadWithoutJson {
  const camelCaseRow = camelCaseKeysDeep(row) as ReadWithoutJson;
  return nullsToUndefinedDeep(camelCaseRow) as ReadWithoutJson;
}

/** The JSON columns of a binding write, leaving out the ones not given. */
function _jsonPropsToDB(
  model: Readonly<Partial<Pick<DictionaryBindingModel["Read"], JsonProps>>>,
): { pinned_pairs?: Json; value_overrides?: Json } {
  return {
    ...(model.pinnedPairs === undefined
      ? {}
      : { pinned_pairs: codePairsToDBJson(model.pinnedPairs) }),
    ...(model.valueOverrides === undefined
      ? {}
      : { value_overrides: [...model.valueOverrides] }),
  };
}

/** Snake-cases a binding write, keeping the nulls of its nullable columns. */
function _plainPropsToDB(
  row: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  return excludeNullsExceptInProps([
    "code_list_id",
    "dictionary_id",
    "entry_id",
    "pinned_is_ordered",
    "replaced_data_type",
  ])(undefinedsToNullsDeep(snakeCaseKeysDeep(row)));
}

/**
 * Parses `public.dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings` rows. The pinned
 * pairs and the overrides stay outside the deep key transforms and go
 * through their own schemas, so a malformed one fails loudly. Writes go
 * through the apply RPCs, so the insert and update transforms exist only
 * to satisfy the CRUD client.
 */
export const DictionaryBindingParsers =
  makeParserRegistry<DictionaryBindingModel>().build({
    modelName: "DictionaryBinding",
    DBReadSchema,
    fromDBReadToModelRead: (dbRow): DictionaryBindingModel["Read"] => {
      const { pinned_pairs: pinnedPairs, value_overrides, ...row } = dbRow;
      const modelRow = _readRow(row);
      return Model.make("DictionaryBinding", {
        ...modelRow,
        id: modelRow.id as DictionaryBindingId,
        codeListId: modelRow.codeListId as DataDictionaryCodeListId | undefined,
        datasetColumnId: modelRow.datasetColumnId as DatasetColumn.Id,
        datasetId: modelRow.datasetId as Dataset.Id,
        dictionaryId: modelRow.dictionaryId as DataDictionaryId | undefined,
        entryId: modelRow.entryId as DataDictionaryEntryId | undefined,
        workspaceId: modelRow.workspaceId as Workspace.Id,
        pinnedPairs:
          pinnedPairs === null ? undefined : codePairsFromDBJson(pinnedPairs),
        valueOverrides: _valueOverridesFromJson(value_overrides),
      });
    },
    fromModelInsertToDBInsert: (model) => {
      const { pinnedPairs, valueOverrides, ...row } = model;
      return {
        ...(_plainPropsToDB(row) as Omit<
          DictionaryBindingModel["DBInsert"],
          DBJsonProps
        >),
        ..._jsonPropsToDB({ pinnedPairs, valueOverrides }),
      };
    },
    fromModelUpdateToDBUpdate: (model) => {
      const { pinnedPairs, valueOverrides, ...row } = model;
      return {
        ...(_plainPropsToDB(row) as Omit<
          DictionaryBindingModel["DBUpdate"],
          DBJsonProps
        >),
        ..._jsonPropsToDB({ pinnedPairs, valueOverrides }),
      };
    },
  });

/** Keeps the database schema and CRUD row types aligned. */
type CrudTypes = DictionaryBindingModel;
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
// @ts-ignore Type tests - this variable is intentionally not used
type ZodConsistencyTests = [
  Expect<
    ZodSchemaEqualsTypes<
      typeof DBReadSchema,
      { input: CrudTypes["DBRead"]; output: CrudTypes["DBRead"] }
    >
  >,
];
```

### Task 7: ColumnConversion: the conversion rules and their SQL

One pure, shared model holds every rule a conversion follows, so the load-time view, the apply flow's preview and Unmatched values step, and the tests can never disagree. It builds SQL text only; it runs nothing. Both sides of every comparison are normalized by DuckDB (`lower(trim(CAST(value AS VARCHAR)))` against `lower(trim('<literal>'))`), because DuckDB's `trim` removes spaces only and its lowercasing need not match JavaScript's. Every literal goes through `quoteSqlLiteral`. The output type rule matches the SQL in `dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings` exactly, including its edge: an empty pair list is `varchar` (special-cased, since `[].every()` is true).

`ColumnConversion.T` carries one field beyond the Contracts: `inputDataType`, the binding's `replacedDataType`. Task 10 turns it into the converted replacement's `dataType` (the cast applied to the stored value before converting), so a `source-schema` column stored as text but typed `bigint` converts `'01'` as `1`, exactly as the user saw it while matching.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion.ts";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding.ts";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn.ts";

const SEX_PAIRS: DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[] = [
  {
    code: "1",
    label: "Male",
    acceptedSpellings: ["M", "man"],
    isMissing: false,
  },
  { code: "2", label: "Female", acceptedSpellings: ["F"], isMissing: false },
  { code: "9", label: "Unknown", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: true },
];

const SES_PAIRS: DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[] = [
  { code: "1", label: "Low", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
  { code: "2", label: "High", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
  { code: "9", label: "Unknown", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: true },
  { code: "99", label: "Unknown", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: true },
  { code: "5", label: " ", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
];

function _makeConversion(
  overrides: Partial<ColumnConversion.T> = {},
): ColumnConversion.T {
  return {
    datasetColumnId: "col-gender",
    direction: "decode",
    pairs: SEX_PAIRS,
    isOrdered: false,
    overrides: [],
    keepsOriginalAs: undefined,
    outputDataType: "varchar",
    inputDataType: undefined,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function _pair(code: string, label = "x"): DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair {
  return { code, label, acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false };
}

describe("ColumnConversion.getCases", () => {
  it("decodes each code to its label, in list order", () => {
    expect(ColumnConversion.getCases(_makeConversion())).toEqual([
      { match: "1", output: "Male" },
      { match: "2", output: "Female" },
      { match: "9", output: "Unknown" },
    ]);
  });

  it("skips a pair with a blank label when decoding, so its code passes through", () => {
    const cases = ColumnConversion.getCases(
      _makeConversion({ pairs: [_pair("1", "Low"), _pair("5", "  ")] }),
    );

    expect(cases).toEqual([{ match: "1", output: "Low" }]);
  });

  it("encodes each label and accepted spelling to its code", () => {
    const cases = ColumnConversion.getCases(
      _makeConversion({ direction: "encode" }),
    );

    expect(cases).toEqual([
      { match: "Male", output: "1" },
      { match: "M", output: "1" },
      { match: "man", output: "1" },
      { match: "Female", output: "2" },
      { match: "F", output: "2" },
      { match: "Unknown", output: "9" },
    ]);
  });

  it("still encodes the accepted spellings of a pair with a blank label", () => {
    const pairs = [
      { code: "1", label: "", acceptedSpellings: ["m"], isMissing: false },
    ];

    expect(
      ColumnConversion.getCases(
        _makeConversion({ direction: "encode", pairs }),
      ),
    ).toEqual([{ match: "m", output: "1" }]);
  });

  it("renders overrides after the pairs: empty is null, map is the pair's output, keep is nothing", () => {
    const cases = ColumnConversion.getCases(
      _makeConversion({
        overrides: [
          { value: "7", action: "empty" },
          { value: "x", action: "keep" },
          { value: "f", action: "map", code: "2" },
          { value: "q", action: "map", code: "404" },
        ],
      }),
    );

    expect(cases.slice(3)).toEqual([
      { match: "7", output: null },
      { match: "f", output: "Female" },
    ]);
  });

  it("maps to the pair's code when encoding", () => {
    const cases = ColumnConversion.getCases(
      _makeConversion({
        direction: "encode",
        overrides: [{ value: "Mle", action: "map", code: "1" }],
      }),
    );

    expect(cases.at(-1)).toEqual({ match: "Mle", output: "1" });
  });

  it("keeps a pair's case ahead of an override for the same value", () => {
    const cases = ColumnConversion.getCases(
      _makeConversion({ overrides: [{ value: "1", action: "empty" }] }),
    );

    expect(cases[0]).toEqual({ match: "1", output: "Male" });
    expect(cases.at(-1)).toEqual({ match: "1", output: null });
  });
});

describe("ColumnConversion.getOutputDataType", () => {
  it.each([
    [["1", "2", "9"], "bigint"],
    [["01", " 2 ", "-3"], "bigint"],
    [["1", "1.5"], "varchar"],
    [["1", "M"], "varchar"],
    [["1234567890123456789"], "varchar"],
    [[], "varchar"],
  ])("encodes codes %j as %s", (codes, expected) => {
    const pairs = codes.map((code) => {
      return _pair(code);
    });

    expect(
      ColumnConversion.getOutputDataType({ direction: "encode", pairs }),
    ).toBe(expected);
  });

  it("decodes to text, whatever the codes", () => {
    expect(
      ColumnConversion.getOutputDataType({
        direction: "decode",
        pairs: [_pair("1")],
      }),
    ).toBe("varchar");
  });
});

describe("ColumnConversion.getOutputType", () => {
  it("is an ENUM of an ordered list's labels, blank ones left out and each once", () => {
    const outputType = ColumnConversion.getOutputType(
      _makeConversion({ pairs: SES_PAIRS, isOrdered: true }),
    );

    expect(outputType).toEqual({
      kind: "enum",
      labels: ["Low", "High", "Unknown"],
    });
  });

  it("is the stored type when encoding an ordered list", () => {
    const outputType = ColumnConversion.getOutputType(
      _makeConversion({
        direction: "encode",
        isOrdered: true,
        outputDataType: "bigint",
      }),
    );

    expect(outputType).toEqual({ kind: "bigint" });
  });

  it("is text when an ordered list has no label yet", () => {
    const outputType = ColumnConversion.getOutputType(
      _makeConversion({ pairs: [_pair("1", "")], isOrdered: true }),
    );

    expect(outputType).toEqual({ kind: "varchar" });
  });
});

describe("ColumnConversion.toCaseSql", () => {
  it("decodes over a key both sides normalize the same way, keeping the rest as text", () => {
    expect(
      ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
        valueSql: '"GENDER"',
        conversion: _makeConversion(),
      }),
    ).toBe(
      `CASE lower(trim(CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN lower(trim('1')) THEN 'Male' WHEN lower(trim('2')) THEN 'Female' WHEN lower(trim('9')) THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR) END`,
    );
  });

  it("casts integer codes to BIGINT", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
      valueSql: '"sex"',
      conversion: _makeConversion({
        direction: "encode",
        pairs: [SEX_PAIRS[0]!],
        outputDataType: "bigint",
      }),
    });

    expect(sql).toBe(
      `TRY_CAST(CASE lower(trim(CAST("sex" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN lower(trim('Male')) THEN '1' WHEN lower(trim('M')) THEN '1' WHEN lower(trim('man')) THEN '1' ELSE CAST("sex" AS VARCHAR) END AS BIGINT)`,
    );
  });

  it("casts an ordered list to an ENUM of its labels, then the kept values", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
      valueSql: '"SES"',
      conversion: _makeConversion({
        pairs: [_pair("1", "Low"), _pair("2", "High")],
        isOrdered: true,
      }),
      keptValues: ["7", "Low"],
    });

    expect(sql).toBe(
      `CAST(CASE lower(trim(CAST("SES" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN lower(trim('1')) THEN 'Low' WHEN lower(trim('2')) THEN 'High' ELSE CAST("SES" AS VARCHAR) END AS ENUM('Low', 'High', '7'))`,
    );
  });

  it("leaves an ordered list as text without its kept values", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
      valueSql: '"SES"',
      conversion: _makeConversion({ pairs: SES_PAIRS, isOrdered: true }),
    });

    expect(sql).not.toContain("ENUM");
  });

  it("keeps every value as text when nothing can match", () => {
    expect(
      ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
        valueSql: '"GENDER"',
        conversion: _makeConversion({ pairs: [_pair("1", "")] }),
      }),
    ).toBe(`CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR)`);
  });

  it("quotes hostile labels as data", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
      valueSql: '"v"',
      conversion: _makeConversion({
        pairs: [
          _pair("1", "O'Brien"),
          _pair("2", "$& $` $' $$ $excludeClause$"),
          _pair("3", "x' ) ; DROP TABLE raw; --"),
          _pair("4", "two\nlines"),
        ],
      }),
    });

    expect(sql).toContain(`THEN 'O''Brien'`);
    expect(sql).toContain(`THEN '$& $\` $'' $$ $excludeClause$'`);
    expect(sql).toContain(`THEN 'x'' ) ; DROP TABLE raw; --'`);
    expect(sql).toContain(`THEN 'two\nlines'`);
  });
});

describe("ColumnConversion.toKeptValuesSql", () => {
  it("selects the values kept beside an ordered list's labels, sorted", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toKeptValuesSql({

      valueSql: '"SES"',
      conversion: _makeConversion({
        pairs: [_pair("1", "Low"), _pair("2", "High")],

    });

    expect(sql).toBe(
      `SELECT DISTINCT kept_value FROM (SELECT CASE lower(trim(CAST("SES" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN lower(trim('1')) THEN 'Low' WHEN lower(trim('2')) THEN 'High' ELSE CAST("SES" AS VARCHAR) END AS kept_value FROM "raw") WHERE kept_value IS NOT NULL AND kept_value NOT IN ('Low', 'High') ORDER BY kept_value`,
    );
  });
});

describe("ColumnConversion.toUnmatchedValuesSql", () => {
  it("counts the stored values no pair matches, most rows first", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toUnmatchedValuesSql({
      relationSql: '"raw"',
      valueSql: '"GENDER"',
      conversion: _makeConversion(),
      limit: 50,
    });

    expect(sql).toBe(
      `SELECT CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR) AS "value", count(*) AS "rows" FROM "raw" WHERE "GENDER" IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(CAST("GENDER" AS VARCHAR))) NOT IN (lower(trim('1')), lower(trim('2')), lower(trim('9'))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "rows" DESC, "value" LIMIT 50`,
    );
  });

  it("ignores overrides, so a resolved value is still listed", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toUnmatchedValuesSql({
      relationSql: '"raw"',
      valueSql: '"GENDER"',
      conversion: _makeConversion({
        overrides: [{ value: "7", action: "empty" }],
      }),
      limit: 50,
    });

    expect(sql).not.toContain("'7'");
  });

  it("counts every stored value when nothing can match", () => {
    const sql = ColumnConversion.toUnmatchedValuesSql({
      relationSql: '"raw"',
      valueSql: '"GENDER"',
      conversion: _makeConversion({ pairs: [] }),
      limit: 10,
    });

    expect(sql).not.toContain("NOT IN");
  });

  it("refuses a limit that is not a positive whole number", () => {
    expect(() => {
      return ColumnConversion.toUnmatchedValuesSql({
        relationSql: '"raw"',
        valueSql: '"GENDER"',
        conversion: _makeConversion(),
        limit: 0.5,
      });
    }).toThrow("positive integer");
  });
});

describe("ColumnConversion.fromRows", () => {
  const LIST_ID = "list-sex" as DataDictionaryCodeList.Id;
  const BINDING_ID = "binding-gender" as DictionaryBinding.Id;
  const GENDER_ID = "col-gender" as DatasetColumn.Id;
  const BINDING: ColumnConversion.Rows["bindings"][number] = {
    id: BINDING_ID,
    datasetColumnId: GENDER_ID,
    codeListId: LIST_ID,
    mode: "convert",
    direction: "decode",
    keepsOriginal: true,
    valueOverrides: [{ value: "7", action: "empty" }],
    pinnedPairs: undefined,
    pinnedIsOrdered: undefined,
    replacedDataType: "bigint",
  };
  const ROWS: ColumnConversion.Rows = {
    bindings: [BINDING],
    codeLists: [{ id: LIST_ID, isOrdered: true, pairs: SEX_PAIRS }],
    columns: [
      { id: GENDER_ID, name: "GENDER", dataType: "varchar" },
      {
        id: "col-copy" as DatasetColumn.Id,
        name: "GENDER_original",
        dataType: "bigint",
        dictionaryBindingId: BINDING_ID,
      },
    ],
  };

  it("reads a live binding's list, overrides, copy name, and types", () => {
    expect(ColumnConversion.fromRows(ROWS).get(GENDER_ID)).toEqual({
      datasetColumnId: GENDER_ID,
      direction: "decode",
      pairs: SEX_PAIRS,
      isOrdered: true,
      overrides: [{ value: "7", action: "empty" }],
      keepsOriginalAs: "GENDER_original",
      outputDataType: "varchar",
      inputDataType: "bigint",
    });
  });

  it("converts with the pinned pairs when the binding has them", () => {
    const pinnedPairs = [_pair("1", "Man")];
    const conversion = ColumnConversion.fromRows({
      ...ROWS,
      bindings: [{ ...BINDING, pinnedPairs, pinnedIsOrdered: false }],
    }).get(GENDER_ID);

    expect(conversion?.pairs).toEqual(pinnedPairs);
    expect(conversion?.isOrdered).toBe(false);
  });

  it("still converts a pinned binding whose list was deleted", () => {
    const conversion = ColumnConversion.fromRows({
      ...ROWS,
      bindings: [
        {
          ...BINDING,
          codeListId: undefined,
          pinnedPairs: SEX_PAIRS,
          pinnedIsOrdered: false,
        },
      ],
      codeLists: [],
    }).get(GENDER_ID);

    expect(conversion?.pairs).toEqual(SEX_PAIRS);
  });

  it("leaves out a live binding whose list is not loaded", () => {
    expect(ColumnConversion.fromRows({ ...ROWS, codeLists: [] }).size).toBe(0);
  });

  it("leaves out a reference binding", () => {
    expect(
      ColumnConversion.fromRows({
        ...ROWS,
        bindings: [{ ...BINDING, mode: "reference" }],
      }).size,
    ).toBe(0);
  });

  it("leaves out a binding whose column is not loaded", () => {
    expect(ColumnConversion.fromRows({ ...ROWS, columns: [] }).size).toBe(0);
  });

  it("names no copy when the binding keeps no original", () => {
    const conversion = ColumnConversion.fromRows({
      ...ROWS,
      bindings: [{ ...BINDING, keepsOriginal: false }],
    }).get(GENDER_ID);

    expect(conversion?.keepsOriginalAs).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```
