```ts
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList.ts";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding.ts";
import type { AvaDataType } from "$/models/datasets/AvaDataType/AvaDataType.ts";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn.ts";

/** What a convert binding does to one dataset column when it loads. */
export type ColumnConversionT = {
  /** The converted column */
  datasetColumnId: string;

  /** Which side of each pair the stored values hold */
  direction: DictionaryBinding.Direction;

  /** The live list's pairs, or the pinned pairs */
  pairs: readonly DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[];

  /** Whether the pairs are levels of a scale, kept in order */
  isOrdered: boolean;

  /** How each value no pair matches is resolved */
  overrides: readonly DictionaryBinding.ValueOverride[];

  /** The `<column>_original` copy's current name, when one is kept */
  keepsOriginalAs: string | undefined;

  /** The converted column's stored `data_type`: `bigint` or `varchar` */
  outputDataType: "bigint" | "varchar";

  /**
   * The column's `data_type` before the conversion, which the stored values
   * are cast to before they are converted (the binding's
   * `replacedDataType`). Undefined when the binding did not record one.
   */
  inputDataType: AvaDataType.T | undefined;
};

/** One `WHEN` of the conversion: a value to match, and what it becomes. */
export type ColumnConversionCase = {
  /** The value as written in the list, normalized by SQL when compared */
  match: string;

  /** The value it becomes, or null to leave it empty */
  output: string | null;
};

/** The SQL type a conversion casts its output to. */
export type ColumnConversionOutputType =
  | { kind: "bigint" }
  | { kind: "varchar" }
  | { kind: "enum"; labels: readonly string[] };

/**
 * The rows `ColumnConversion.fromRows` reads: a dataset's bindings, the
 * code lists they use, and every one of its columns, keep-original copies
 * included.
 */
export type ColumnConversionRows = {
  bindings: ReadonlyArray<
    Pick<
      DictionaryBinding.T,
      | "id"
      | "datasetColumnId"
      | "codeListId"
      | "mode"
      | "direction"
      | "keepsOriginal"
      | "valueOverrides"
      | "pinnedPairs"
      | "pinnedIsOrdered"
      | "replacedDataType"
    >
  >;
  codeLists: ReadonlyArray<
    Pick<DataDictionaryCodeList.T, "id" | "isOrdered" | "pairs">
  >;
  columns: ReadonlyArray<
    Pick<DatasetColumn.T, "id" | "name" | "dataType" | "dictionaryBindingId">
  >;
};
```

`shared/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversionModule/ColumnConversionModule.ts`:

```ts
import { quoteSqlLiteral } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import type {
  ColumnConversionCase,
  ColumnConversionOutputType,
  ColumnConversionRows,
  ColumnConversionT,
} from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion.types.ts";

/** A whole-number code of at most 18 digits, so it fits a BIGINT. */
const INTEGER_CODE_REGEX = /^-?[0-9]{1,18}$/;

type Binding = ColumnConversionRows["bindings"][number];

type Lookups = {
  columnsById: Map<string, ColumnConversionRows["columns"][number]>;
  codeListsById: Map<string, ColumnConversionRows["codeLists"][number]>;
  copyNamesByBindingId: Map<string, string>;
};

function _isBlank(text: string): boolean {
  return text.trim() === "";
}

function _unique(values: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(values)];
}

/**
 * The key a stored value is matched on: its text, trimmed of spaces and
 * lowercased by DuckDB. Every match literal goes through the same functions,
 * so both sides are normalized by one engine.
 */
function toValueKeySql(valueSql: string): string {
  return `lower(trim(CAST(${valueSql} AS VARCHAR)))`;
}

function _toMatchKeySql(match: string): string {
  return `lower(trim(${quoteSqlLiteral(match)}))`;
}

/**
 * The data type a conversion outputs, which the apply RPCs store as the
 * column's `data_type`: `varchar` for labels, and `bigint` for codes when
 * every code is a whole number of at most 18 digits. The SQL in
 * `dataset_columns__dictionary_bindings` follows the same rule.
 */
function getOutputDataType(
  options: Readonly<{
    direction: ColumnConversionT["direction"];
    pairs: ColumnConversionT["pairs"];
  }>,
): "bigint" | "varchar" {
  if (options.direction === "decode" || options.pairs.length === 0) {
    return "varchar";
  }
  const areWholeNumbers = options.pairs.every((pair) => {
    return INTEGER_CODE_REGEX.test(pair.code.trim());
  });
  return areWholeNumbers ? "bigint" : "varchar";
}

function _getPairCases(
  conversion: Readonly<ColumnConversionT>,
): ColumnConversionCase[] {
  return conversion.pairs.flatMap((pair) => {
    if (conversion.direction === "decode") {
      return _isBlank(pair.label)
        ? []
        : [{ match: pair.code, output: pair.label }];
    }
    return [pair.label, ...pair.acceptedSpellings]
      .filter((spelling) => {
        return !_isBlank(spelling);
      })
      .map((spelling) => {
        return { match: spelling, output: pair.code };
      });
  });
}

/** What a value mapped to the pair with `code` becomes, if anything. */
function _getMappedOutput(
  conversion: Readonly<ColumnConversionT>,
  code: string,
): string | undefined {
  const pair = conversion.pairs.find((candidate) => {
    return candidate.code === code;
  });
  const output = conversion.direction === "decode" ? pair?.label : pair?.code;
  return output === undefined || _isBlank(output) ? undefined : output;
}

function _getOverrideCases(
  conversion: Readonly<ColumnConversionT>,
): ColumnConversionCase[] {
  return conversion.overrides.flatMap((override): ColumnConversionCase[] => {
    if (override.action === "keep") {
      return [];
    }
    if (override.action === "empty") {
      return [{ match: override.value, output: null }];
    }
    const output = _getMappedOutput(conversion, override.code);
    return output === undefined ? [] : [{ match: override.value, output }];
  });
}

/**
 * The conversion's `WHEN` clauses in the order SQL tries them: the pairs
 * first, so a value a pair matches is never overridden, then the overrides.
 * Decoding matches each code to its label and skips a pair with a blank
 * label, whose code then passes through. Encoding matches each non-blank
 * label and accepted spelling to its code. `keep` overrides add nothing,
 * and a `map` override to a code the pairs no longer hold is dropped.
 */
function getCases(
  conversion: Readonly<ColumnConversionT>,
): ColumnConversionCase[] {
  return [..._getPairCases(conversion), ..._getOverrideCases(conversion)];
}

/** An ordered list's non-blank labels in list order, each once. */
function _getEnumLabels(conversion: Readonly<ColumnConversionT>): string[] {
  const labels = conversion.pairs
    .map((pair) => {
      return pair.label;
    })
    .filter((label) => {
      return !_isBlank(label);
    });
  return _unique(labels);
}

/**
 * The SQL type the converted column comes out as: an `ENUM` of the labels
 * in list order when an ordered list is decoded, so sorting follows the
 * list; otherwise the column's stored type.
 */
function getOutputType(
  conversion: Readonly<ColumnConversionT>,
): ColumnConversionOutputType {
  if (conversion.direction === "decode" && conversion.isOrdered) {
    const labels = _getEnumLabels(conversion);
    if (labels.length > 0) {
      return { kind: "enum", labels };
    }
  }
  return { kind: conversion.outputDataType };
}

/** The `CASE` as text, with no cast of its output. */
function _toCaseExpressionSql(
  valueSql: string,
  cases: readonly ColumnConversionCase[],
): string {
  const textSql = `CAST(${valueSql} AS VARCHAR)`;
  if (cases.length === 0) {
    return textSql;
  }
  const whens = cases.map((conversionCase) => {
    const outputSql =
      conversionCase.output === null
        ? "NULL"
        : quoteSqlLiteral(conversionCase.output);
    return `WHEN ${_toMatchKeySql(conversionCase.match)} THEN ${outputSql}`;
  });
  return `CASE ${toValueKeySql(valueSql)} ${whens.join(" ")} ELSE ${textSql} END`;
}

function _toEnumTypeSql(labels: readonly string[]): string {
  return `ENUM(${_unique(labels).map(quoteSqlLiteral).join(", ")})`;
}

/**
 * The converted value of `valueSql` as one SQL expression. A value no case
 * matches is kept as text. Integer codes are cast to `BIGINT`, so a kept
 * value that is not a number comes out empty. An ordered list's labels
 * become an `ENUM` only when `keptValues` lists every other value the
 * conversion keeps, since only the load-time read knows them and casting a
 * value outside the `ENUM` fails the whole query; without it the labels
 * stay text.
 */
function toCaseSql(
  options: Readonly<{
    valueSql: string;
    conversion: ColumnConversionT;
    keptValues?: readonly string[];
  }>,
): string {
  const expressionSql = _toCaseExpressionSql(
    options.valueSql,
    getCases(options.conversion),
  );
  const outputType = getOutputType(options.conversion);
  if (outputType.kind === "bigint") {
    return `TRY_CAST(${expressionSql} AS BIGINT)`;
  }
  if (outputType.kind === "enum" && options.keptValues !== undefined) {
    const labels = [...outputType.labels, ...options.keptValues];
    return `CAST(${expressionSql} AS ${_toEnumTypeSql(labels)})`;
  }
  return expressionSql;
}

/**
 * A query for every value an ordered list's conversion keeps that is not
 * one of its labels, sorted, as one `kept_value` column. Its rows are the
 * `keptValues` that complete the column's `ENUM`.
 */
function toKeptValuesSql(
  options: Readonly<{
    relationSql: string;
    valueSql: string;
    conversion: ColumnConversionT;
  }>,
): string {
  const expressionSql = _toCaseExpressionSql(
    options.valueSql,
    getCases(options.conversion),
  );
  const labels = _getEnumLabels(options.conversion);
  const notListedSql =
    labels.length === 0
      ? ""
      : ` AND kept_value NOT IN (${labels.map(quoteSqlLiteral).join(", ")})`;
  return `SELECT DISTINCT kept_value FROM (SELECT ${expressionSql} AS kept_value FROM ${options.relationSql}) WHERE kept_value IS NOT NULL${notListedSql} ORDER BY kept_value`;
}

/**
 * A query for the stored values no pair matches, as exactly two columns:
 * `"value"`, the stored value as text, and `"rows"`, a `BIGINT` count,
 * most rows first, then by value, at most `limit` rows. Overrides are
 * ignored: it lists every value no pair matches, and a caller drops the
 * ones it has resolved. Used by the apply flow's Unmatched values step.
 *
 * @throws When `limit` is not a positive whole number.
 */
function toUnmatchedValuesSql(
  options: Readonly<{
    relationSql: string;
    valueSql: string;
    conversion: ColumnConversionT;
    limit: number;
  }>,
): string {
  if (!Number.isInteger(options.limit) || options.limit < 1) {
    throw new Error(
      `An unmatched values limit must be a positive integer, not ${options.limit}`,
    );
  }
  const matchKeysSql = _getPairCases(options.conversion).map(
    (conversionCase) => {
      return _toMatchKeySql(conversionCase.match);
    },
  );
  const unmatchedSql =
    matchKeysSql.length === 0
      ? ""
      : ` AND ${toValueKeySql(options.valueSql)} NOT IN (${matchKeysSql.join(", ")})`;
  return `SELECT CAST(${options.valueSql} AS VARCHAR) AS "value", count(*) AS "rows" FROM ${options.relationSql} WHERE ${options.valueSql} IS NOT NULL${unmatchedSql} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "rows" DESC, "value" LIMIT ${options.limit}`;
}

function _byId<Row extends { id: string }>(
  rows: readonly Row[],
): Map<string, Row> {
  return new Map(
    rows.map((row) => {
      return [row.id, row] as const;
    }),
  );
}

function _getCopyNamesByBindingId(
  columns: ColumnConversionRows["columns"],
): Map<string, string> {
  return new Map(
    columns.flatMap((column) => {
      return column.dictionaryBindingId === undefined
        ? []
        : [[column.dictionaryBindingId, column.name] as const];
    }),
  );
}

function _toConversion(
  binding: Binding,
  lookups: Lookups,
): ColumnConversionT | undefined {
  const column = lookups.columnsById.get(binding.datasetColumnId);
  const codeList =
    binding.codeListId === undefined
      ? undefined
      : lookups.codeListsById.get(binding.codeListId);
  const pairs = binding.pinnedPairs ?? codeList?.pairs;
  if (binding.mode !== "convert" || !column || pairs === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return {
    datasetColumnId: binding.datasetColumnId,
    direction: binding.direction,
    pairs,
    isOrdered:
      binding.pinnedPairs === undefined
        ? (codeList?.isOrdered ?? false)
        : (binding.pinnedIsOrdered ?? false),
    overrides: binding.valueOverrides,
    keepsOriginalAs: binding.keepsOriginal
      ? lookups.copyNamesByBindingId.get(binding.id)
      : undefined,
    outputDataType: column.dataType === "bigint" ? "bigint" : "varchar",
    inputDataType: binding.replacedDataType,
  };
}

/**
 * Each convert binding's conversion, by dataset column id. Pinned pairs win
 * over the live list. A reference binding, a binding whose column is not
 * among `rows.columns`, and a live binding whose code list is not among
 * `rows.codeLists` convert nothing and are left out. Pass every column of
 * the dataset, keep-original copies included, so `keepsOriginalAs` can be
 * found.
 */
function fromRows(
  rows: Readonly<ColumnConversionRows>,
): Map<string, ColumnConversionT> {
  const lookups: Lookups = {
    columnsById: _byId(rows.columns),
    codeListsById: _byId(rows.codeLists),
    copyNamesByBindingId: _getCopyNamesByBindingId(rows.columns),
  };
  const result = new Map<string, ColumnConversionT>();
  rows.bindings.forEach((binding) => {
    const conversion = _toConversion(binding, lookups);
    if (conversion !== undefined) {
      result.set(binding.datasetColumnId, conversion);
    }
  });
  return result;
}

/**
 * Pure rules for converting a column with a dictionary: which `WHEN`
 * clauses, which output type, and the SQL that converts, finds kept values,
 * and finds unmatched values. Used by the load-time view, the apply flow's
 * preview and Unmatched values step, and their tests.
 */
export const ColumnConversionModule = {
  fromRows,
  getCases,
  getOutputType,
  getOutputDataType,
  toValueKeySql,
  toCaseSql,
  toKeptValuesSql,
  toUnmatchedValuesSql,
};
```

### Task 8: The projection renderer: CASE, keep-original, ENUM

`getParquetProjectionClauses` renders a converted column as its `ColumnConversion.toCaseSql` under its output name (its alias when renamed), followed by its `<column>_original` copy when the binding keeps one. Two types meet here, and they mean different things:

- `dataType` on a converted replacement is the cast applied to the stored value **before** converting (from `ColumnConversion.T.inputDataType`, set by Task 10). The `CASE` reads that value, and so does the raw-values view (Task 9).
- `originalCopyDataType` is the cast for the keep-original copy, set by Task 10 from the copy's own `dataset_columns` row when its stored type differs from the type the column loads as. Without it the copy is the bare stored column.

The output type (`BIGINT`, text, or an `ENUM`) always comes from the conversion. An encode with `BIGINT` output turns a kept value that is not a whole number (`Other`) into NULL through `TRY_CAST`, and casts one that is (` 7 ` becomes `7`); that is intended, and the Unmatched values step says so (Task 18). An executed case pins both. Each name now goes through `quoteSqlIdentifier`, so a column whose name holds `"` loads too (the text is unchanged for every other name). `omitsValueMappings` renders the same clauses without conversions or copies, for the raw-values view. `keptValuesByColumn`, keyed by original name, completes an ordered column's `ENUM` (Task 9 reads it); without it an ordered column stays text, which is what a preview query wants.

```ts
/** A decode conversion of GENDER, which keeps a `GENDER_original` copy. */
const GENDER_CONVERSION: ColumnConversion.T = {
  datasetColumnId: "col-gender",
  direction: "decode",
  pairs: [
    { code: "1", label: "Male", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
  ],
  isOrdered: false,
  overrides: [],
  keepsOriginalAs: "GENDER_original",
  outputDataType: "varchar",
  inputDataType: "bigint",
};

const GENDER_CASE_SQL = `CASE lower(trim(CAST(TRY_CAST("GENDER" AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR))) WHEN lower(trim('1')) THEN 'Male' ELSE CAST(TRY_CAST("GENDER" AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) END`;

describe("getParquetProjectionClauses", () => {
  it("renames and casts as before, quoting each name", () => {
    expect(
      getParquetProjectionClauses({
        zip: { alias: 'zip "code"', dataType: "VARCHAR" },
      }),
    ).toEqual({
      excludeClause: 'EXCLUDE ("zip")',
      replaceClause: ', TRY_CAST("zip" AS VARCHAR) AS "zip ""code"""',
    });
  });

  it("selects a converted column as its conversion, then its keep-original copy", () => {
    const { excludeClause, replaceClause } = getParquetProjectionClauses({
      GENDER: { dataType: "BIGINT", valueMapping: GENDER_CONVERSION },
    });

    expect(excludeClause).toBe('EXCLUDE ("GENDER")');
    expect(replaceClause).toBe(
      `, ${GENDER_CASE_SQL} AS "GENDER", "GENDER" AS "GENDER_original"`,
    );
  });

  it("casts the keep-original copy to its own stored type", () => {
    const { replaceClause } = getParquetProjectionClauses({
      GENDER: {
        dataType: "BIGINT",
        originalCopyDataType: "BIGINT",
        valueMapping: GENDER_CONVERSION,
      },
    });

    expect(replaceClause).toBe(
      `, ${GENDER_CASE_SQL} AS "GENDER", TRY_CAST("GENDER" AS BIGINT) AS "GENDER_original"`,
    );
  });

  it("names a renamed converted column by its alias", () => {
    const { replaceClause } = getParquetProjectionClauses({
      GENDER: {
        alias: "sex",
        valueMapping: { ...GENDER_CONVERSION, keepsOriginalAs: undefined },
      },
    });

    expect(replaceClause.endsWith(' END AS "sex"')).toBe(true);
  });

  it("leaves conversions and copies out of the raw-values view", () => {
    expect(
      getParquetProjectionClauses(
        { GENDER: { dataType: "BIGINT", valueMapping: GENDER_CONVERSION } },
        { omitsValueMappings: true },
      ),
    ).toEqual({
      excludeClause: 'EXCLUDE ("GENDER")',
      replaceClause: ', TRY_CAST("GENDER" AS BIGINT) AS "GENDER"',
    });
  });

  it("completes an ordered column's ENUM with the kept values for its original name", () => {
    const { replaceClause } = getParquetProjectionClauses(
      {
        SES: {
          valueMapping: {
            ...GENDER_CONVERSION,
            isOrdered: true,
            keepsOriginalAs: undefined,
            inputDataType: undefined,
          },
        },
      },
      { keptValuesByColumn: { SES: ["7"] } },
    );

    expect(replaceClause).toContain("AS ENUM('Male', '7')) AS \"SES\"");
  });

  it("returns empty clauses when nothing is replaced", () => {
    expect(getParquetProjectionClauses(undefined)).toEqual({
      excludeClause: "",
      replaceClause: "",
    });
  });
});
```

`src/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText.executed.test.ts` builds the converted view exactly as a load does (kept values first, then the `CREATE VIEW` through `getQueryStringFromParams`) over real rows in node DuckDB:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import {
  getParquetProjectionClauses,
  getQueryStringFromParams,
} from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText";
import { withDuckDb } from "../../../tests/integration/queries/executedDuckDb";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DuckDbLoadParquetOptions } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbClientOperations";
import type { DuckDBConnection } from "@duckdb/node-api";

/** Stored rows, as a dataset's Parquet file holds them. */
const RAW_ROWS_SQL = `CREATE TABLE raw AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  (1, '1', 'Male', 1, '01', 1),
  (2, ' 2 ', ' f ', 4, '2', 2),
  (3, '9', 'man', 2, '9', 3),
  (4, '7', 'Mle', 7, 'x', 4),
  (5, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 5),
  (6, 'm', 'Unknown', 99, '1', 6),
  (7, '1', 'F', 3, '2', 7)
) AS t(case_id, "GENDER", sex_label, "SES", code_text, hostile)`;

/** The view statement `loadParquetIntoDuckDb` runs, over the table above. */
const VIEW_TEMPLATE = `CREATE VIEW "$tableName$" AS SELECT * $excludeClause$ $replaceClause$ FROM raw`;

function _pair(code: string, label: string, acceptedSpellings: string[] = []) {
  return { code, label, acceptedSpellings, isMissing: false };
}

const SEX_PAIRS: DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[] = [
  _pair("1", "Male", ["M", "man"]),
  _pair("2", "Female", ["F"]),
  _pair("9", "Unknown"),
];

const HOSTILE_LABELS = [
  "O'Brien",
  "$& and $` and $' and $$",
  'say "hi"',
  "x' ) ; DROP TABLE raw; --",
  "two\nlines",
  "$excludeClause$",
];

function _conversion(
  overrides: Partial<ColumnConversion.T>,
): ColumnConversion.T {
  return {
    datasetColumnId: "col",
    direction: "decode",
    pairs: SEX_PAIRS,
    isOrdered: false,
    overrides: [],
    keepsOriginalAs: undefined,
    outputDataType: "varchar",
    inputDataType: undefined,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const SES_CONVERSION = _conversion({
  pairs: [
    _pair("1", "Low"),
    _pair("2", "Lower-middle"),
    _pair("3", "Upper-middle"),
    _pair("4", "High"),
    _pair("9", "Unknown"),
    _pair("99", "Unknown"),
  ],
  isOrdered: true,
});

const REPLACEMENTS: NonNullable<
  DuckDbLoadParquetOptions["columnReplacements"]
> = {
  GENDER: {
    valueMapping: _conversion({
      keepsOriginalAs: "GENDER_original",
      overrides: [
        { value: "7", action: "empty" },
        { value: "m", action: "map", code: "2" },
      ],
    }),
  },
  sex_label: {
    alias: "sex",
    valueMapping: _conversion({
      direction: "encode",
      outputDataType: "bigint",
    }),
  },
  SES: { valueMapping: SES_CONVERSION },
  code_text: {
    dataType: "BIGINT",
    originalCopyDataType: "BIGINT",
    valueMapping: _conversion({ keepsOriginalAs: "code_text_original" }),
  },
  hostile: {
    valueMapping: _conversion({
      pairs: HOSTILE_LABELS.map((label, index) => {
        return _pair(String(index + 1), label);
      }),
    }),
  },
};

async function _readAll(
  connection: DuckDBConnection,
  sql: string,
): Promise<Array<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  return (await connection.runAndReadAll(sql)).getRowObjects();
}

/** Builds the converted view the way a load does, then reads `sql` from it. */
async function _readConverted(
  sql: string,
): Promise<Array<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  return await withDuckDb(async (connection) => {
    await _readAll(connection, RAW_ROWS_SQL);
    const keptRows = await _readAll(
      connection,
      ColumnConversion.toKeptValuesSql({
        relationSql: '"raw"',
        valueSql: '"SES"',
        conversion: SES_CONVERSION,
      }),
    );
    const keptValues = keptRows.map((row) => {
      return String(row.kept_value);
    });
    const clauses = getParquetProjectionClauses(REPLACEMENTS, {
      keptValuesByColumn: { SES: keptValues },
    });
    await _readAll(
      connection,
      getQueryStringFromParams({
        queryString: VIEW_TEMPLATE,
        params: { tableName: "converted", ...clauses },
      }),
    );
    return await _readAll(connection, sql);
  });
}

describe("getParquetProjectionClauses, executed", () => {
  it("decodes codes, applies overrides, and keeps the original values beside them", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT "GENDER", "GENDER_original" FROM converted ORDER BY case_id`,
    );

    expect(rows).toEqual([
      { GENDER: "Male", GENDER_original: "1" },
      { GENDER: "Female", GENDER_original: " 2 " },
      { GENDER: "Unknown", GENDER_original: "9" },
      { GENDER: null, GENDER_original: "7" },
      { GENDER: null, GENDER_original: null },
      { GENDER: "Female", GENDER_original: "m" },
      { GENDER: "Male", GENDER_original: "1" },
    ]);
  });

  it("encodes labels and accepted spellings to BIGINT codes, emptying a value that is not a number", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT sex FROM converted ORDER BY case_id`,
    );

    expect(
      rows.map((row) => {
        return row.sex;
      }),
    ).toEqual([1n, 2n, 1n, null, null, 9n, 2n]);
  });

  it("encodes to BIGINT, emptying a kept value that is not a whole number and casting one that is", async () => {
    const rows = await withDuckDb(async (connection) => {
      const codeSql = ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
        valueSql: '"sex"',
        conversion: _conversion({
          direction: "encode",
          outputDataType: "bigint",
        }),
      });
      return await _readAll(
        connection,
        `SELECT ${codeSql} AS code FROM (VALUES ('Male'), ('Other'), (' 7 ')) AS t(sex)`,
      );
    });

    expect(rows).toEqual([{ code: 1n }, { code: null }, { code: 7n }]);
  });

  it("converts the value the column had before converting", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT code_text FROM converted ORDER BY case_id`,
    );

    expect(
      rows.map((row) => {
        return row.code_text;
      }),
    ).toEqual(["Male", "Female", "Unknown", null, null, "Male", "Female"]);
  });

  it("keeps a BIGINT copy of a text column cast to BIGINT before converting", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT code_text_original, typeof(code_text_original) AS copy_type FROM converted ORDER BY case_id`,
    );

    expect(rows).toEqual([
      { code_text_original: 1n, copy_type: "BIGINT" },
      { code_text_original: 2n, copy_type: "BIGINT" },
      { code_text_original: 9n, copy_type: "BIGINT" },
      { code_text_original: null, copy_type: "BIGINT" },
      { code_text_original: null, copy_type: "BIGINT" },
      { code_text_original: 1n, copy_type: "BIGINT" },
      { code_text_original: 2n, copy_type: "BIGINT" },
    ]);
  });

  it("types an integer-coded column as BIGINT and an ordered one as an ENUM with its kept values", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT column_name, column_type FROM (DESCRIBE converted) WHERE column_name IN ('sex', 'SES')`,
    );

    expect(rows).toEqual([
      { column_name: "sex", column_type: "BIGINT" },
      {
        column_name: "SES",
        column_type:
          "ENUM('Low', 'Lower-middle', 'Upper-middle', 'High', 'Unknown', '7')",
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("sorts an ordered list in list order, its kept values after", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT "SES" AS level, count(*)::INTEGER AS n FROM converted GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1`,
    );

    expect(rows).toEqual([
      { level: "Low", n: 1 },
      { level: "Lower-middle", n: 1 },
      { level: "Upper-middle", n: 1 },
      { level: "High", n: 1 },
      { level: "Unknown", n: 1 },
      { level: "7", n: 1 },
      { level: null, n: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it("filters an ordered column by label and by a label it does not hold, without an error", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "SES" = 'Low')::INTEGER AS low, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "SES" = 'Bogus')::INTEGER AS bogus FROM converted`,
    );

    expect(rows).toEqual([{ low: 1, bogus: 0 }]);
  });

  it("keeps hostile labels as data, through the view template", async () => {
    const rows = await _readConverted(
      `SELECT hostile FROM converted ORDER BY case_id`,
    );

    expect(
      rows.map((row) => {
        return row.hostile;
      }),
    ).toEqual([...HOSTILE_LABELS, "7"]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { objectEntries } from "@avandar/utils";

import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
```

Then replace this block:

```ts
/** Builds the `EXCLUDE`/replacement clauses for a parquet projection. */
export function getParquetProjectionClauses(
  columnReplacements: DuckDbLoadParquetOptions["columnReplacements"],
): { excludeClause: string; replaceClause: string } {
  const projections = objectEntries(columnReplacements ?? {}).map(
    ([columnName, { alias, dataType }]) => {
      const outputName = alias ?? columnName;
      const valueExpression = dataType
        ? `TRY_CAST("${columnName}" AS ${dataType})`
        : `"${columnName}"`;
      return {
        exclusion: `"${columnName}"`,
        replacement: `${valueExpression} AS "${outputName}"`,
      };
    },
  );
  return {
    excludeClause:
      projections.length > 0
        ? `EXCLUDE (${projections.map(prop("exclusion")).join(", ")})`
        : "",
    replaceClause:
      projections.length > 0
        ? `, ${projections.map(prop("replacement")).join(", ")}`
        : "",
  };
}
```

with:

```ts
/** One stored column's replacement, as a loader receives it. */
type ParquetColumnReplacement = NonNullable<
  DuckDbLoadParquetOptions["columnReplacements"]
>[string];

/** Options for {@link getParquetProjectionClauses}. */
type ParquetProjectionOptions = Readonly<{
  /** Kept values to append to each ordered column's ENUM, by original name. */
  keptValuesByColumn?: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
  /** Leaves conversions out, for the raw-values view. */
  omitsValueMappings?: boolean;
}>;

/**
 * A stored column's value: the column itself, or `TRY_CAST` to `dataType`.
 * For a converted column, `dataType` is the type it had before converting,
 * so the conversion and the raw-values view read the value users saw
 * before; its keep-original copy is cast to its own stored type.
 */
function _getStoredValueSql(
  columnName: string,
  dataType: DuckDbDataType | undefined,
): string {
  const columnSql = quoteSqlIdentifier(columnName);
  return dataType ? `TRY_CAST(${columnSql} AS ${dataType})` : columnSql;
}

/** The select-list items that replace one stored column. */
function _getReplacementItems(
  columnName: string,
  replacement: ParquetColumnReplacement,
  options: ParquetProjectionOptions,
): string[] {
  const outputNameSql = quoteSqlIdentifier(replacement.alias ?? columnName);
  const storedValueSql = _getStoredValueSql(columnName, replacement.dataType);
  const { valueMapping } = replacement;
  if (valueMapping === undefined || options.omitsValueMappings) {
    return [`${storedValueSql} AS ${outputNameSql}`];
  }
  const convertedSql = ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({
    valueSql: storedValueSql,
    conversion: valueMapping,
    keptValues: options.keptValuesByColumn?.[columnName],
  });
  const convertedItem = `${convertedSql} AS ${outputNameSql}`;
  if (valueMapping.keepsOriginalAs === undefined) {
    return [convertedItem];
  }
  const copySql = _getStoredValueSql(
    columnName,
    replacement.originalCopyDataType,
  );
  return [
    convertedItem,
    `${copySql} AS ${quoteSqlIdentifier(valueMapping.keepsOriginalAs)}`,
  ];
}

/**
 * Builds the `EXCLUDE`/replacement clauses for a parquet projection. A
 * renamed or retyped column is excluded and selected again under its name
 * and type. A converted column is selected as its conversion, followed by
 * its `<column>_original` copy when it keeps one, cast to
 * `originalCopyDataType` when that is set. With
 * `omitsValueMappings`, conversions and copies are left out, for the view
 * of a dataset's values as stored.
 */
export function getParquetProjectionClauses(
  columnReplacements: DuckDbLoadParquetOptions["columnReplacements"],
  options: ParquetProjectionOptions = {},
): { excludeClause: string; replaceClause: string } {
  const entries = objectEntries(columnReplacements ?? {});
  const exclusions = entries.map(([columnName]) => {
    return quoteSqlIdentifier(columnName);
  });
  const items = entries.flatMap(([columnName, replacement]) => {
    return _getReplacementItems(columnName, replacement, options);
  });
  return {
    excludeClause:
      exclusions.length > 0 ? `EXCLUDE (${exclusions.join(", ")})` : "",
    replaceClause: items.length > 0 ? `, ${items.join(", ")}` : "",
  };
}
```

### Task 9: Loading: kept ENUM values and the raw-values view

Before it builds a dataset's views, `loadParquetIntoDuckDb` reads, from the registered file and one query at a time on its own connection, the values each ordered column's conversion keeps beside its labels, and passes them to `getParquetProjectionClauses` so the `ENUM` cast never meets a value it lacks (decision 1). It then creates the public view, recreates `ava_rows_<id>` as before, and recreates a third view, `ava_raw_<id>`, with the renames and casts but no conversions and no keep-original copies. Profiling, matching, and the apply flow's preview and unmatched values read `ava_raw_<id>` (Task 16), because a converted dataset's public view holds labels. The SQL analyzer reads `ava_raw_<id>` as a read of dataset `<id>`, exactly as it reads `ava_rows_<id>`, so it inherits that dataset's lease and the workspace allowlist; the prefix alone never makes a name inspectable.

All three statements are trusted internal SQL, like the loader's other statements. `_createRowNumberedView` and `_dropRowNumberedView` become `_createAuxiliaryView` and `_dropAuxiliaryView`, and the known gap they document (an auxiliary view outlives a dataset dropped without a reload) now covers both views.

In `src/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText.ts`, add right after `getRowNumberedViewName`:


```ts
/**
 * Prefix of the auxiliary view that exposes a dataset's values as stored:
 * its renames and casts, none of its conversions, and no keep-original
 * copies. Deliberately not a `RelationRef` prefix, for the same reason as
 * `ava_rows_`.
 */
const RAW_VALUES_VIEW_PREFIX = "ava_raw_";

/**
 * Names the auxiliary view of a dataset's values before any conversion.
 * Profiling, matching, and the apply flow's preview and unmatched values
 * read it, because a converted dataset's public view holds labels.
 */
export function getRawValuesViewName(tableName: string): string {
  return `${RAW_VALUES_VIEW_PREFIX}${tableName}`;
}

/**
 * The dataset table an `ava_raw_` view reads, or undefined for any other
 * name. The inverse of `getRawValuesViewName`, which the SQL analyzer uses
 * to treat the view as a read of that dataset.
 */
export function getTableNameFromRawValuesViewName(
  viewName: string,
): string | undefined {
  return viewName.startsWith(RAW_VALUES_VIEW_PREFIX)
    ? viewName.slice(RAW_VALUES_VIEW_PREFIX.length)
    : undefined;
}
```

and right before the `$name$` placeholder constant that Task 1 added:

```ts
/**
 * One query per column whose conversion outputs an `ENUM`, reading the
 * values it keeps beside its labels from `relationSql`. A loader runs them
 * before it builds the view and passes their rows to
 * `getParquetProjectionClauses` as `keptValuesByColumn`, so the cast to the
 * `ENUM` never meets a value it lacks.
 */
export function getKeptEnumValuesQueries(
  options: Readonly<{
    columnReplacements: DuckDbLoadParquetOptions["columnReplacements"];
    relationSql: string;
  }>,
): Array<{ columnName: string; sql: string }> {
  return objectEntries(options.columnReplacements ?? {}).flatMap(
    ([columnName, replacement]) => {
      const conversion = replacement.valueMapping;
      if (
        conversion === undefined ||
        ColumnConversion.getOutputType(conversion).kind !== "enum"
      ) {
        return [];
      }
      const sql = ColumnConversion.toKeptValuesSql({
        relationSql: options.relationSql,
        valueSql: _getStoredValueSql(columnName, replacement.dataType),
        conversion,
      });
      return [{ columnName, sql }];
    },
  );
}
```

Replace `src/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbParquetLoad.ts` with:

```ts
import { promiseMapSequential } from "@avandar/utils";
import { quoteSqlIdentifier } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import { uuid } from "$/lib/uuid";
import { DatasetDuckDbCoordinator } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/DatasetDuckDbCoordinator/DatasetDuckDbCoordinator";
import { TRUSTED_INTERNAL_SQL } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbClientOperations";
import { registerParquetFile } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbFileRegistry";
import {
  getKeptEnumValuesQueries,
  getParquetProjectionClauses,
  getRawValuesViewName,
  getRowNumberedViewName,
} from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText";
import { getLoadedDuckDbTableShape } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbTableIntrospection";
import type { DatasetDuckDbLease } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/DatasetDuckDbCoordinator/DatasetDuckDbCoordinator";
import type { DuckDbLoadParquetResult } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/DuckDbClient.types";
import type {
  DuckDbClientOperations,
  DuckDbLoadParquetOptions,
} from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbClientOperations";
import type * as duckdb from "@duckdb/duckdb-wasm";

/** What every statement of one load runs with. */
type ViewLoadContext = Readonly<{
  client: DuckDbClientOperations;
  conn: duckdb.AsyncDuckDBConnection;
  datasetDuckDbLease: DatasetDuckDbLease;
  tableName: string;
}>;

/** A view's `EXCLUDE` and replacement clauses. */
type ProjectionClauses = Readonly<{
  excludeClause: string;
  replaceClause: string;
}>;

async function _createParquetView(
  options: ViewLoadContext & ProjectionClauses,
): Promise<void> {
  await options.conn.query("SET enable_external_file_cache = false");
  try {
    await options.client.runRawQuery(
      `CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "$tableName$" AS
    SELECT * $excludeClause$ $replaceClause$
    FROM read_parquet("$tableName$")`,
      {
        conn: options.conn,
        datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
        [TRUSTED_INTERNAL_SQL]: true,
        params: {
          tableName: options.tableName,
          replaceClause: options.replaceClause,
          excludeClause: options.excludeClause,
        },
      },
    );
  } finally {
    await options.conn.query("SET enable_external_file_cache = true");
  }
}

/**
 * Creates an auxiliary view beside the dataset's public view and over the
 * same registered file: `ava_rows_<id>`, with the public view's projection
 * plus `file_row_number`, which `SELECT *` picks up once
 * `file_row_number = true` is set, or `ava_raw_<id>`, with the renames and
 * casts but none of the conversions.
 */
async function _createAuxiliaryView(
  options: ViewLoadContext &
    ProjectionClauses &
    Readonly<{ viewName: string; readParquetOptions: string }>,
): Promise<void> {
  await options.client.runRawQuery(
    `CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "$viewName$" AS
    SELECT * $excludeClause$ $replaceClause$
    FROM read_parquet("$tableName$"$readParquetOptions$)`,
    {
      conn: options.conn,
      datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
      [TRUSTED_INTERNAL_SQL]: true,
      params: {
        viewName: options.viewName,
        tableName: options.tableName,
        readParquetOptions: options.readParquetOptions,
        replaceClause: options.replaceClause,
        excludeClause: options.excludeClause,
      },
    },
  );
}

/**
 * Drops an auxiliary view.
 *
 * Deliberately a plain `DROP VIEW`, not `client.dropTableViewAndFile`: that
 * helper treats its argument as a dataset id when it takes the coordinator
 * lease, and an `ava_rows_` or `ava_raw_` name is not one. There is also no
 * registered file of its own to drop, because it reads the dataset's file.
 *
 * KNOWN GAP, deliberate: this load path is the auxiliary views' only
 * lifecycle owner, so a dataset dropped through `dropTableViewAndFile` and
 * never reloaded leaves orphan views over a dropped file. Adding the drop to
 * that shared helper was tried and reverted: it changed the drop sequence
 * every dataset drop goes through and broke four leasing tests, which is too
 * much risk for an orphan that only fails if something queries it. Fix it
 * with the spine caching work, which needs this lifecycle anyway.
 */
async function _dropAuxiliaryView(
  options: ViewLoadContext & Readonly<{ viewName: string }>,
): Promise<void> {
  await options.client.runRawQuery(`DROP VIEW IF EXISTS "$viewName$"`, {
    conn: options.conn,
    datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
    [TRUSTED_INTERNAL_SQL]: true,
    params: { viewName: options.viewName },
  });
}

/**
 * Reads, from the registered file, the values each ordered column's
 * conversion keeps beside its labels, by original column name. They
 * complete the column's `ENUM`, so the view's cast never meets a value it
 * lacks. Run one at a time on the load's own connection.
 */
async function _readKeptEnumValues(
  options: ViewLoadContext &
    Readonly<{
      columnReplacements: DuckDbLoadParquetOptions["columnReplacements"];
    }>,
): Promise<Record<string, string[]>> {
  const queries = getKeptEnumValuesQueries({
    columnReplacements: options.columnReplacements,
    relationSql: `read_parquet(${quoteSqlIdentifier(options.tableName)})`,
  });
  const entries = await promiseMapSequential(queries, async (query) => {
    const { data } = await options.client.runRawQuery<{ kept_value: string }>(
      query.sql,
      {
        conn: options.conn,
        datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
        [TRUSTED_INTERNAL_SQL]: true,
      },
    );
    const keptValues = data.map((row) => {
      return String(row.kept_value);
    });
    return [query.columnName, keptValues] as const;
  });
  return Object.fromEntries(entries);
}

/**
 * Creates the dataset's public view and recreates its two auxiliary views
 * over the registered file. The auxiliary views are recreated with the
 * public view rather than left behind, so a reloaded dataset can never be
 * ordered by a stale row order or profiled through stale casts.
 */
async function _createRelationViews(
  options: ViewLoadContext &
    Readonly<{
      columnReplacements: DuckDbLoadParquetOptions["columnReplacements"];
    }>,
): Promise<void> {
  const { columnReplacements, ...context } = options;
  const keptValuesByColumn = await _readKeptEnumValues(options);
  const projectionClauses = getParquetProjectionClauses(columnReplacements, {
    keptValuesByColumn,
  });
  await _createParquetView({ ...context, ...projectionClauses });
  const rowsViewName = getRowNumberedViewName(context.tableName);
  await _dropAuxiliaryView({ ...context, viewName: rowsViewName });
  await _createAuxiliaryView({
    ...context,
    ...projectionClauses,
    viewName: rowsViewName,
    readParquetOptions: ", file_row_number = true",
  });
  const rawViewName = getRawValuesViewName(context.tableName);
  await _dropAuxiliaryView({ ...context, viewName: rawViewName });
  await _createAuxiliaryView({
    ...context,
    ...getParquetProjectionClauses(columnReplacements, {
      omitsValueMappings: true,
    }),
    viewName: rawViewName,
    readParquetOptions: "",
  });
}

async function _getParquetLoadResult(
  options: Readonly<{
    client: DuckDbClientOperations;
    tableName: string;
    datasetDuckDbLease: DatasetDuckDbLease;
  }>,
): Promise<DuckDbLoadParquetResult> {
  DatasetDuckDbCoordinator.markDatasetDuckDbTableValidForWorkspace(
    options.tableName,
  );
  const { columns, rowCount } = await getLoadedDuckDbTableShape(options);
  return {
    name: options.tableName,
    columns,
    id: uuid(),
    numRows: rowCount,
  };
}

/**
 * Registers a parquet blob and exposes it as the dataset's bare DuckDB view,
 * plus its `ava_rows_` and `ava_raw_` views.
 *
 * The caller must already hold the dataset's DuckDB lease.
 */
export async function loadParquetIntoDuckDb(
  options: Readonly<
    DuckDbLoadParquetOptions & {
      client: DuckDbClientOperations;
      datasetDuckDbLease: DatasetDuckDbLease;
    }
  >,
): Promise<DuckDbLoadParquetResult> {
  const { client, tableName, blob, columnReplacements } = options;
  await client.dropTableViewAndFile({
    tableOrViewName: tableName,
    datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
  });
  const db = await client.getDb();
  await registerParquetFile({ db, tableName, blob });

  const conn = await client.connect();
  try {
    await _createRelationViews({
      client,
      conn,
      datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
      tableName,
      columnReplacements,
    });
    return await _getParquetLoadResult({
      client,
      tableName,
      datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
    });
  } finally {
    await client.closeConnection(conn);
  }
}
```

### Task 10: Conversions in relation loading, and the projection key

Every QETL entry point reaches `queryRunner._loadQueryRelations`, so this task wires conversions in there, once. A `catalog` session (every workspace query) reads each dependency's columns, convert bindings, and live code lists, builds its replacements with `getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(columns, conversions)`, and hashes them into a projection key. The queryable tier records the key a view was built with, and `probeRelationCache` treats a different key as a miss, so the storage tier serves the same bytes and the view is rebuilt with the new projection: a binding or code-list change reaches the next query with no cache clear. A `stored` session (public dashboards) never reads the catalog, as before.

Two read rules matter. Columns keep the existing `ensureQueryData` read (a column edit already drops the dataset's view). Bindings and code lists use `fetchQuery`, which refetches when invalidated or older than the online stale time (6 minutes) and serves the cache offline (stale time is infinite offline), and fall back to the cached rows when a fetch fails. When nothing can be read, the datasets load unconverted and the failure is logged; the key then records "no conversions", so the first successful read rebuilds the view. A query that names no dataset reads nothing.

`ColumnConversion.fromRows` comes from Task 7, which takes `{ bindings, codeLists, columns }` (the models' `T` types) and returns conversions by dataset column id. It must receive every column of each dataset, keep-original copies included, before anything narrows them to a loaded subset, or `keepsOriginalAs` comes back undefined. `ColumnReplacement.valueMapping` and `originalCopyDataType` come from Task 8. `DatasetColumn.T.dictionaryBindingId` comes from Task 6.

On a converted column's replacement, `dataType` is the cast applied before converting, not after: the `CASE` reads the cast value, so text-stored `"01"` cast to `BIGINT` matches code `1`. It is set from the conversion's `inputDataType` (the binding's `replacedDataType`, the column's type before converting) when that differs from the type the column loads as, and is undefined otherwise. The conversion's output type governs what the column becomes.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  getColumnReplacementsFromColumns,
  getProjectionKey,
} from "@/clients/qetl/QueryMediator/relationLoading/getColumnReplacementsFromColumns/getColumnReplacementsFromColumns";
import type { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";

const GENDER_ID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" as DatasetColumn.Id;
const COPY_ID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" as DatasetColumn.Id;

function _makeColumn(
  options: Pick<DatasetColumn.T, "id" | "name" | "originalName"> &
    Partial<DatasetColumn.T>,
): DatasetColumn.T {
  return Model.make("DatasetColumn", {
    datasetId: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333" as Dataset.Id,
    workspaceId: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" as Workspace.Id,
    createdAt: "2026-11-13T00:00:00.000Z",
    updatedAt: "2026-11-13T00:00:00.000Z",
    originalDataType: "BIGINT",
    detectedDataType: "BIGINT",
    dataType: "bigint",
    description: undefined,
    columnIdx: 0,
    dictionaryBindingId: undefined,
    ...options,
  });
}

const GENDER_CONVERSION: ColumnConversion.T = {
  datasetColumnId: GENDER_ID,
  direction: "decode",
  pairs: [
    { code: "1", label: "Male", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
    { code: "2", label: "Female", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
  ],
  isOrdered: false,
  overrides: [],
  keepsOriginalAs: undefined,
  outputDataType: "varchar",
  inputDataType: "bigint",
};

describe("getColumnReplacementsFromColumns", () => {
  it("gives a converted column its conversion and no cast before it", () => {
    // Converting set the stored type to `varchar`, which differs from the
    // detected `BIGINT`. That is the output's type, not a cast: the column
    // was `bigint` before converting, as it loads, so nothing is cast first.
    const gender = _makeColumn({
      id: GENDER_ID,
      name: "GENDER",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dataType: "varchar",
    });

    const replacements = getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
      [gender],
      new Map([[GENDER_ID, GENDER_CONVERSION]]),
    );

    expect(replacements).toEqual([
      {
        originalName: "GENDER",
        alias: undefined,
        dataType: undefined,
        valueMapping: GENDER_CONVERSION,
        originalCopyDataType: undefined,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("casts a converted column to its type before converting, so the codes match", () => {
    // Stored as text ("01") but typed `bigint` before converting: the CASE
    // reads the cast value, so "01" matches code 1.
    const gender = _makeColumn({
      id: GENDER_ID,
      name: "GENDER",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dataType: "varchar",
      detectedDataType: "VARCHAR",
    });

    const [replacement] = getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
      [gender],
      new Map([[GENDER_ID, GENDER_CONVERSION]]),
    );

    expect(replacement?.dataType).toBe("BIGINT");
  });

  it("casts nothing before converting when the conversion names no input type", () => {
    const gender = _makeColumn({
      id: GENDER_ID,
      name: "GENDER",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dataType: "varchar",
      detectedDataType: "VARCHAR",
    });

    const [replacement] = getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
      [gender],
      new Map([[GENDER_ID, { ...GENDER_CONVERSION, inputDataType: undefined }]]),
    );

    expect(replacement?.dataType).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("casts the keep-original copy as the copy's own row asks", () => {
    // The column held text codes cast to numbers before it was converted,
    // so its copy keeps that cast while the converted column holds labels.
    const gender = _makeColumn({
      id: GENDER_ID,
      name: "GENDER",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dataType: "varchar",
      detectedDataType: "VARCHAR",
    });
    const copy = _makeColumn({
      id: COPY_ID,
      name: "GENDER_original",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dataType: "bigint",
      detectedDataType: "VARCHAR",
      dictionaryBindingId: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555" as DictionaryBinding.Id,
    });

    const [replacement] = getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
      [gender, copy],
      new Map([
        [GENDER_ID, { ...GENDER_CONVERSION, keepsOriginalAs: "GENDER_original" }],
      ]),
    );

    expect(replacement?.originalCopyDataType).toBe("BIGINT");
  });

  it("leaves the copy uncast when its row loads as stored", () => {
    const gender = _makeColumn({
      id: GENDER_ID,
      name: "GENDER",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dataType: "varchar",
    });
    const copy = _makeColumn({
      id: COPY_ID,
      name: "GENDER_original",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dictionaryBindingId: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555" as DictionaryBinding.Id,
    });

    const [replacement] = getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
      [gender, copy],
      new Map([
        [GENDER_ID, { ...GENDER_CONVERSION, keepsOriginalAs: "GENDER_original" }],
      ]),
    );

    expect(replacement?.originalCopyDataType).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("keeps a converted column's rename", () => {
    const gender = _makeColumn({
      id: GENDER_ID,
      name: "sex",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dataType: "varchar",
    });

    const [replacement] = getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
      [gender],
      new Map([[GENDER_ID, GENDER_CONVERSION]]),
    );

    expect(replacement?.alias).toBe("sex");
  });

  it("leaves a keep-original copy to the conversion it belongs to", () => {
    // The copy shares the converted column's Parquet header and is renamed,
    // so without the skip it would emit a second `EXCLUDE` of "GENDER".
    const copy = _makeColumn({
      id: COPY_ID,
      name: "GENDER_original",
      originalName: "GENDER",
      dictionaryBindingId: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555" as DictionaryBinding.Id,
    });

    expect(getColumnReplacementsFromColumns([copy])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("still renames and casts a column with no conversion", () => {
    const zip = _makeColumn({
      id: COPY_ID,
      name: "zip",
      originalName: "zip_code",
      dataType: "varchar",
    });

    expect(getColumnReplacementsFromColumns([zip])).toEqual([
      { originalName: "zip_code", alias: "zip", dataType: "VARCHAR" },
    ]);
  });
});

describe("getProjectionKey", () => {
  it("does not depend on the order of the replacements or their keys", () => {
    const rename = { originalName: "zip_code", alias: "zip" };
    const conversion = {
      valueMapping: GENDER_CONVERSION,
      originalName: "GENDER",
    };

    expect(getProjectionKey([rename, conversion])).toBe(
      getProjectionKey([conversion, rename]),
    );
  });

  it("changes when a code list's label changes", () => {
    const relabeled: ColumnConversion.T = {
      ...GENDER_CONVERSION,
      pairs: [
        { code: "1", label: "Man", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
        GENDER_CONVERSION.pairs[1]!,
      ],
    };

    expect(
      getProjectionKey([
        { originalName: "GENDER", valueMapping: GENDER_CONVERSION },
      ]),
    ).not.toBe(
      getProjectionKey([{ originalName: "GENDER", valueMapping: relabeled }]),
    );
  });

  it("changes when the keep-original copy's cast changes", () => {
    const converted = {
      originalName: "GENDER",
      valueMapping: GENDER_CONVERSION,
    };

    expect(getProjectionKey([converted])).not.toBe(
      getProjectionKey([{ ...converted, originalCopyDataType: "BIGINT" }]),
    );
  });

  it("gives a dataset with nothing to replace a key of its own", () => {
    expect(getProjectionKey([])).toBe("[]");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { isDefined } from "@avandar/utils";
import { DuckDbDataTypeUtils } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/DuckDbDataType";
import type { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { ColumnReplacement } from "@/clients/qetl/QueryMediator/QueryMediator.types";

const NO_CONVERSIONS: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnConversion.T> = new Map();

/** A renamed or retyped column's replacement, or undefined when it loads as stored. */
function _toRenameOrCast(
  column: Readonly<DatasetColumn.T>,
): ColumnReplacement | undefined {
  const hasChangedName = column.name !== column.originalName;
  const hasChangedDataType =
    column.dataType !==
    DuckDbDataTypeUtils.toAvaDataType(column.detectedDataType);
  return hasChangedName || hasChangedDataType
    ? {
        originalName: column.originalName,
        alias: hasChangedName ? column.name : undefined,
        dataType: hasChangedDataType
          ? DuckDbDataTypeUtils.fromDatasetColumnType(column.dataType)
          : undefined,
      }
    : undefined;
}

/**
 * The cast a keep-original copy's own catalog row asks for, read from the
 * copy (a keep-original row named `keepsOriginalAs`), or undefined when it
 * loads as stored or no copy is kept.
 */
function _getOriginalCopyDataType(
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[],
  conversion: ColumnConversion.T,
): ColumnReplacement["originalCopyDataType"] {
  const copy = columns.find((candidate) => {
    return (
      candidate.dictionaryBindingId !== undefined &&
      candidate.name === conversion.keepsOriginalAs
    );
  });
  return copy &&
    copy.dataType !== DuckDbDataTypeUtils.toAvaDataType(copy.detectedDataType)
    ? DuckDbDataTypeUtils.fromDatasetColumnType(copy.dataType)
    : undefined;
}

/**
 * The cast a converted column's values take before they are converted: the
 * column's type before converting, when it differs from the type the column
 * loads as. The `CASE` reads the cast value, so text-stored `"01"` typed
 * `bigint` matches code `1`.
 */
function _getInputDataType(
  column: Readonly<DatasetColumn.T>,
  conversion: ColumnConversion.T,
): ColumnReplacement["dataType"] {
  const { inputDataType } = conversion;
  return inputDataType !== undefined &&
    inputDataType !==
      DuckDbDataTypeUtils.toAvaDataType(column.detectedDataType)
    ? DuckDbDataTypeUtils.fromDatasetColumnType(inputDataType)
    : undefined;
}

/**
 * A converted column's replacement: renamed as stored, cast to its type
 * before converting, translated by its conversion (whose output type is what
 * the column becomes), with its keep-original copy cast as the copy's row
 * says.
 */
function _toConversion(
  column: Readonly<DatasetColumn.T>,
  conversion: ColumnConversion.T,
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[],
): ColumnReplacement {
  return {
    originalName: column.originalName,
    alias: column.name !== column.originalName ? column.name : undefined,
    dataType: _getInputDataType(column, conversion),
    valueMapping: conversion,
    originalCopyDataType: _getOriginalCopyDataType(columns, conversion),
  };
}

/**
 * The renames, casts, and conversions that turn a relation's loaded columns
 * into the columns its dataset stores: a column whose stored name differs
 * from its original one is aliased, a column whose stored type differs from
 * the type it loaded as is cast, and a column with a convert binding is
 * translated by its conversion. On a converted column, `dataType` is the cast
 * applied before converting (its type before converting), and the
 * conversion's output type is what it becomes. A `source-schema` relation
 * loads every column as text, so each of its non-text columns is cast to the
 * type its schema declared. A keep-original copy is left out: the conversion
 * it belongs to renders it, cast by `originalCopyDataType` when the copy's
 * own row asks for a cast. `columns` must hold every column of the dataset,
 * copies included, before any narrowing to a loaded subset.
 *
 * @param conversions Each converted column's conversion, by dataset column id.
 * @returns One replacement for each column that needs one.
 */
export function getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[],
  conversions: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnConversion.T> = NO_CONVERSIONS,
): ColumnReplacement[] {
  return columns
    .map((column) => {
      if (column.dictionaryBindingId !== undefined) {
        return undefined;
      }
      const conversion = conversions.get(column.id);
      return conversion
        ? _toConversion(column, conversion, columns)
        : _toRenameOrCast(column);
    })
    .filter(isDefined);
}

/** A value with every object's keys sorted and undefined keys dropped. */
function _toStableValue(value: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map(_toStableValue);
  }
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") {
    return value;
  }
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.keys(record)
      .sort()
      .flatMap((key) => {
        return record[key] === undefined
          ? []
          : [[key, _toStableValue(record[key])]];
      }),
  );
}

/**
 * A key that names a dataset's projection: equal for equal replacements in
 * any order, and different as soon as a rename, cast, pair, override, or
 * output type changes. The queryable tier records it with each loaded view,
 * so a view built with another projection is rebuilt.
 */
export function getProjectionKey(
  replacements: readonly ColumnReplacement[],
): string {
  const sorted = [...replacements].sort((replacementA, replacementB) => {
    return replacementA.originalName < replacementB.originalName ? -1 : 1;
  });
  return JSON.stringify(sorted.map(_toStableValue));
}
```

```ts
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { Model } from "@avandar/models";
import { makeIdLookupRecord } from "@avandar/utils";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getParquetProjectionClauses } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText";
import {
  getColumnReplacementsFromColumns,
  getProjectionKey,
} from "@/clients/qetl/QueryMediator/relationLoading/getColumnReplacementsFromColumns/getColumnReplacementsFromColumns";
import { withDuckDb } from "../../../../../../tests/integration/queries/executedDuckDb";
import type { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { Workspace } from "$/models/Workspace/Workspace";

const PARQUET_FILE = path.join(
  tmpdir(),
  `ava-conversions-${process.pid}.parquet`,
);

function _makeColumn(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  dataType: DatasetColumn.T["dataType"],
): DatasetColumn.T {
  return Model.make("DatasetColumn", {
    id: id as DatasetColumn.Id,
    datasetId: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333" as Dataset.Id,
    workspaceId: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" as Workspace.Id,
    createdAt: "2026-11-13T00:00:00.000Z",
    updatedAt: "2026-11-13T00:00:00.000Z",
    name,
    originalName: name,
    originalDataType: "BIGINT",
    detectedDataType: "BIGINT",
    dataType,
    description: undefined,
    columnIdx: 0,
    dictionaryBindingId: undefined,
  });
}

/** GENDER after a decode convert binding set its type to text. */
const GENDER = _makeColumn("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "GENDER", "varchar");
const CASE_ID = _makeColumn("22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "case_id", "bigint");

function _decodeWith(
  pairs: readonly DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[],
): ColumnConversion.T {
  return {
    datasetColumnId: GENDER.id,
    direction: "decode",
    pairs,
    isOrdered: false,
    overrides: [],
    keepsOriginalAs: undefined,
    outputDataType: "varchar",
    inputDataType: "bigint",
  };
}

const PAIRS_V1 = [
  { code: "1", label: "Male", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
  { code: "2", label: "Female", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
  { code: "9", label: "Unknown", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: true },
];

/** The rows relation loading's view returns for one conversion of GENDER. */
async function _readThroughView(conversion: ColumnConversion.T): Promise<{
  genders: unknown[];
  caseIds: unknown[];
  genderType: string;
}> {
  const replacements = getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
    [CASE_ID, GENDER],
    new Map([[GENDER.id, conversion]]),
  );
  const { excludeClause, replaceClause } = getParquetProjectionClauses(
    makeIdLookupRecord(replacements, { key: "originalName" }),
  );
  return await withDuckDb(async (connection) => {
    await connection.run(
      `COPY (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 9), (4, 7)) AS t(case_id, "GENDER")) TO '${PARQUET_FILE}' (FORMAT parquet)`,
    );
    await connection.run(
      `CREATE VIEW cases AS SELECT * ${excludeClause}${replaceClause} FROM read_parquet('${PARQUET_FILE}')`,
    );
    const rows = await connection.runAndReadAll(
      `SELECT case_id, "GENDER" FROM cases ORDER BY case_id`,
    );
    const described = await connection.runAndReadAll(
      `SELECT column_type FROM (DESCRIBE cases) WHERE column_name = 'GENDER'`,
    );
    return {
      genders: rows.getRowObjects().map((row) => row.GENDER),
      caseIds: rows.getRowObjects().map((row) => Number(row.case_id)),
      genderType: String(described.getRowObjects()[0]?.column_type),
    };
  });
}

describe("conversions through relation loading's projection", () => {
  it("returns labels for a converted column and keeps an unmatched code as text", async () => {
    const { genders, caseIds, genderType } = await _readThroughView(
      _decodeWith(PAIRS_V1),
    );

    expect(genders).toEqual(["Male", "Female", "Unknown", "7"]);
    expect(caseIds).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    expect(genderType).toBe("VARCHAR");
  });

  it("changes the key and the rows when the live list is relabeled", async () => {
    const relabeled = _decodeWith([
      { code: "1", label: "Man", acceptedSpellings: [], isMissing: false },
      ...PAIRS_V1.slice(1),
    ]);
    const keyBefore = getProjectionKey(
      getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
        [GENDER],
        new Map([[GENDER.id, _decodeWith(PAIRS_V1)]]),
      ),
    );
    const keyAfter = getProjectionKey(
      getColumnReplacementsFromColumns([GENDER], new Map([[GENDER.id, relabeled]])),
    );

    const { genders } = await _readThroughView(relabeled);

    expect(keyAfter).not.toBe(keyBefore);
    expect(genders[0]).toBe("Man");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { isDefined, makeBucketRecord, where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import { DataDictionaryCodeListClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeListClient";
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { DatasetColumnClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetColumnClient";
import {
  getColumnReplacementsFromColumns,
  getProjectionKey,
} from "@/clients/qetl/QueryMediator/relationLoading/getColumnReplacementsFromColumns/getColumnReplacementsFromColumns";
import { AvaQueryClient } from "@/config/AvaQueryClient";
import { Logger } from "@/utils/Logger";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { LoadedColumnReplacements } from "@/clients/qetl/QueryMediator/QueryMediator.types";
import type { QueryKey } from "@tanstack/react-query";

const NO_CONVERSIONS: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnConversion.T> = new Map();

/**
 * Reads fresh rows when the cached ones are invalidated or stale, and falls
 * back to the cached rows when that read fails, so a converted dataset keeps
 * converting through a dropped request.
 */
async function _fetchOrCached<Row>(
  options: Readonly<{ queryKey: QueryKey; fetch: () => Promise<Row[]> }>,
): Promise<Row[]> {
  try {
    return await options.fetch();
  } catch (error) {
    const cachedRows = AvaQueryClient.getQueryData<Row[]>(options.queryKey);
    if (cachedRows === undefined) {
      throw error;
    }
    return cachedRows;
  }
}

async function _readConvertBindings(
  datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[],
): Promise<DictionaryBinding.T[]> {
  const params = {
    where: { dataset_id: { in: [...datasetIds] }, mode: { eq: "convert" } },
  } as const;
  return await _fetchOrCached({
    queryKey: DictionaryBindingClient.QueryKeys.getAll(params),
    fetch: () => {
      return DictionaryBindingClient.withCache(AvaQueryClient)
        .withFetchQuery()
        .getAll(params);
    },
  });
}

/** The live code lists the unpinned bindings translate through. */
async function _readLiveCodeLists(
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
): Promise<DataDictionaryCodeList.T[]> {
  const codeListIds = [
    ...new Set(
      bindings
        .filter((binding) => {
          return binding.pinnedPairs === undefined;
        })
        .map((binding) => {
          return binding.codeListId;
        })
        .filter(isDefined),
    ),
  ];
  if (codeListIds.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  const params = where("id", "in", codeListIds);
  return await _fetchOrCached({
    queryKey: DataDictionaryCodeListClient.QueryKeys.getAll(params),
    fetch: () => {
      return DataDictionaryCodeListClient.withCache(AvaQueryClient)
        .withFetchQuery()
        .getAll(params);
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Every convert binding's conversion among the datasets, by dataset column
 * id. A read that fails with nothing cached converts nothing and logs, so the
 * query still runs; the projection key then says "unconverted" and the first
 * successful read rebuilds the view.
 */
async function _readConversions(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[];
    columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
  }>,
): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnConversion.T>> {
  try {
    const bindings = await _readConvertBindings(options.datasetIds);
    if (bindings.length === 0) {
      return NO_CONVERSIONS;
    }
    const codeLists = await _readLiveCodeLists(bindings);
    // Every column of the datasets, keep-original copies included: a
    // conversion finds its copy's name among them, and relation loading
    // narrows to the loaded subset only after the replacements are built.
    return ColumnConversion.fromRows({
      bindings,
      codeLists,
      columns: options.columns,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    Logger.error(
      "Could not read dictionary conversions; the datasets load unconverted",
      { error },
    );
    return NO_CONVERSIONS;
  }
}

/**
 * Each dataset's renames, casts, and conversions, and the projection key the
 * queryable tier checks its loaded view against, read from the dataset
 * catalog with the user's own permissions. Used by the query runner before
 * every workspace query that names a dataset.
 */
export async function loadColumnReplacements(
  datasetIds: readonly Dataset.Id[],
): Promise<LoadedColumnReplacements> {
  if (datasetIds.length === 0) {
    return { replacementsByDatasetId: {}, projectionKeyByDatasetId: {} };
  }
  const columns = await DatasetColumnClient.withCache(AvaQueryClient)
    .withEnsureQueryData()
    .getAll(where("dataset_id", "in", datasetIds));
  // Read whole, never narrowed to the columns a query needs, so each
  // conversion sees its keep-original copy.
  const conversions = await _readConversions({ datasetIds, columns });
  const columnsByDatasetId = makeBucketRecord(columns, { key: "datasetId" });
  const replacementsByDatasetId = Object.fromEntries(
    datasetIds.map((datasetId) => {
      return [
        datasetId,
        getColumnReplacementsFromColumns(
          columnsByDatasetId[datasetId] ?? [],
          conversions,
        ),
      ];
    }),
  );
  return {
    replacementsByDatasetId,
    projectionKeyByDatasetId: Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(replacementsByDatasetId).map(([datasetId, replacements]) => {
        return [datasetId, getProjectionKey(replacements)];
      }),
    ),
  };
}
```

```ts
import {
  isFreshAt,
  normalizeColumns,
} from "$/models/relations/RelationCacheKey/RelationCacheKey";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";

const loadedRelationsByDatasetId = new Map<
  string,
  {
    columns: readonly string[] | "all";
    staleAt: number | undefined;
    projectionKey: string | undefined;
  }
>();

function _remember(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    columns: readonly string[] | "all";
    staleAt: number | undefined;
    projectionKey?: string;
  }>,
): void {
  loadedRelationsByDatasetId.set(options.datasetId, {
    columns: normalizeColumns(options.columns),
    staleAt: options.staleAt,
    projectionKey: options.projectionKey,
  });
}

function _forget(datasetId: Dataset.Id): void {
  loadedRelationsByDatasetId.delete(datasetId);
}

function _getColumns(
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
): readonly string[] | "all" | undefined {
  return loadedRelationsByDatasetId.get(datasetId)?.columns;
}

function _isStale(
  options: Readonly<{ datasetId: Dataset.Id; now: number }>,
): boolean {
  const staleAt = loadedRelationsByDatasetId.get(options.datasetId)?.staleAt;
  return !isFreshAt({ staleAt, now: options.now });
}

function _isProjectionCurrent(
  options: Readonly<{ datasetId: Dataset.Id; projectionKey: string }>,
): boolean {
  const recordedKey = loadedRelationsByDatasetId.get(
    options.datasetId,
  )?.projectionKey;
  return recordedKey === undefined || recordedKey === options.projectionKey;
}

function _clear(): void {
  loadedRelationsByDatasetId.clear();
}

/**
 * This process's record of each dataset's rows currently loaded into DuckDB:
 * which columns they hold, when they go stale, and which projection their
 * view was built with.
 */
export const QueryableRelationColumns = {
  /**
   * Records the column set currently loaded into DuckDB for this dataset,
   * the epoch ms from which those rows are stale (`undefined` for rows that
   * never go stale), and the projection key its view was built with
   * (`undefined` for a `stored` session's load, which has no projection).
   */
  remember: _remember,

  /** Drops the recorded column set for this dataset, if any. */
  forget: _forget,

  /**
   * The column set last loaded into DuckDB for this dataset, or `undefined`
   * when this process has not loaded it.
   */
  getColumns: _getColumns,

  /**
   * Whether the rows loaded into DuckDB for this dataset are stale at `now`,
   * in epoch ms. A relation this process did not record never is.
   */
  isStale: _isStale,

  /**
   * Whether this dataset's view was built with `projectionKey`. A view this
   * process did not record, or recorded without a key, is current, so a
   * table loaded outside this recorder still hits.
   */
  isProjectionCurrent: _isProjectionCurrent,

  /** Forgets every recorded queryable column set. */
  clear: _clear,
};
```

In `src/clients/qetl/QueryMediator/getRelationSources.ts`, replace `probeRelationCache` and its docstring with:

```ts
/** Whether the view loaded for a dataset was built with the projection the query needs. */
function _isProjectionCurrent(
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
  projectionKeyByDatasetId: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined,
): boolean {
  const projectionKey = projectionKeyByDatasetId?.[datasetId];
  return (
    projectionKey === undefined ||
    QueryableRelationColumns.isProjectionCurrent({ datasetId, projectionKey })
  );
}

/**
 * Returns the query's dependencies that the queryable tier cannot serve:
 * missing from DuckDB, present but too narrow for `neededByDatasetId`,
 * present but stale, so a live source's rows are acquired again, or present
 * but built with another projection than `projectionKeyByDatasetId` names,
 * so a changed rename, cast, or conversion rebuilds the view.
 *
 * A present table with no sidecar entry is treated as `"all"`, which is how
 * tables loaded outside this recorder still hit. A caller that passes no
 * projection keys, such as a `stored` session, never compares them.
 */
export async function probeRelationCache(
  queryDependencies: readonly Dataset.Id[],
  neededByDatasetId: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[] | "all">> = {},
  projectionKeyByDatasetId?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): Promise<Dataset.Id[]> {
  if (queryDependencies.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  const inMemoryRelationIds = await DuckDbClient.getTableOrViewNames();
  const inMemoryRelationIdSet = new Set(inMemoryRelationIds);
  const freshnessNow = getRelationFreshnessNow();
  return queryDependencies.filter((datasetId) => {
    if (
      !inMemoryRelationIdSet.has(datasetId) ||
      QueryableRelationColumns.isStale({ datasetId, now: freshnessNow }) ||
      !_isProjectionCurrent(datasetId, projectionKeyByDatasetId)
    ) {
      return true;
    }
    const loaded = QueryableRelationColumns.getColumns(datasetId) ?? "all";
    const needed = neededByDatasetId[datasetId] ?? "all";
    return !coversColumns(loaded, needed);
  });
}
```

```ts
function _isReplacementInLoadedRelation(
  loadedColumns: readonly string[] | "all",
  replacement: Readonly<ColumnReplacement>,
): boolean {
  return (
    loadedColumns === "all" ||
    loadedColumns.includes(replacement.originalName) ||
    (replacement.alias !== undefined &&
      loadedColumns.includes(replacement.alias))
  );
}
```

Replace `_loadRelationBytes` and its docstring with:

```ts
/**
 * Writes newly acquired relations to the storage tier and loads every relation
 * into the queryable tier, each with its own replacements, narrowed to the
 * columns it holds, and records the projection key its view was built with.
 *
 * `relationsToStore` is passed separately rather than derived, because the
 * caller already knows which relations came out of the cache and which were
 * just acquired.
 *
 * A write failure does not fail the query. The bytes are in hand and the
 * queryable tier is about to receive them, so a full disk costs the next
 * query a re-fetch rather than costing this one its result.
 *
 * Nothing here reads the dataset catalog. The runner reads it once per query,
 * and never in a `stored` session, whose visitor may hold no grant on
 * `dataset_columns`.
 */
async function _loadRelationBytes(
  options: Readonly<LoadRelationBytesOptions>,
): Promise<void> {
  await _writeStoredRelationBytes(options);
  await promiseMap(options.relations, async (relation) => {
    const replacements =
      options.columnReplacements?.replacementsByDatasetId[
        relation.datasetId
      ] ?? [];
    await DuckDbClient.loadParquet({
      tableName: relation.datasetId,
      blob: relation.parquetBlob,
      datasetDuckDbLease: options.datasetDuckDbLease,
      // Narrowed here, after the replacements were built from every column
      // of the dataset, so a conversion still knows its keep-original copy.
      columnReplacements: makeIdLookupRecord(
        replacements.filter((replacement) => {
          return _isReplacementInLoadedRelation(relation.columns, replacement);
        }),
        { key: "originalName" },
      ),
    });
    QueryableRelationColumns.remember({
      datasetId: relation.datasetId,
      columns: relation.columns,
      staleAt: relation.staleAt,
      projectionKey:
        options.columnReplacements?.projectionKeyByDatasetId[
          relation.datasetId
        ],
    });
  });
}
```
