- [ ] **Step 6: Run it to see it fail, then create `src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useUnmatchedValues.ts`:**

```ts
import { quoteSqlIdentifier } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import { getRawValuesViewName } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText";
import { WorkspaceQuerySession } from "@/clients/qetl/WorkspaceQuerySession/WorkspaceQuerySession";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { toValueKey } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import { buildMatchConversion } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import { useTaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { ColumnPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { UnmatchedValue } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import type { TaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";

/** The most values listed per column, most rows first. */
export const MAX_UNMATCHED_VALUES = 100;

/** Each coded column's values that no pair matches, by column id. */
export type UnmatchedValues = TaggedRead<
  ReadonlyMap<string, readonly UnmatchedValue[]>
>;

type UnmatchedRequest = {
  column: DatasetColumn.T;
  conversion: ColumnConversion.T;
};

function _buildRequests(
  options: Readonly<{
    columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
    picks: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnPick>>;
    codeLists: ReadonlyMap<string, DataDictionaryCodeList.T>;
  }>,
): UnmatchedRequest[] {
  return options.columns.flatMap((column) => {
    const pick = options.picks[column.id];
    const codeList = pick?.codeListId
      ? options.codeLists.get(pick.codeListId)
      : undefined;
    return pick && codeList
      ? [{ column, conversion: buildMatchConversion({ column, pick, codeList }) }]
      : [];
  });
}

async function _readColumn(
  options: Readonly<{
    workspaceId: string;
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    request: UnmatchedRequest;
  }>,
): Promise<UnmatchedValue[]> {
  const { column, conversion } = options.request;
  const result = await WorkspaceQuerySession.runQuery<{
    value: unknown;
    rows: unknown;
  }>({
    workspaceId: options.workspaceId,
    neededColumnsByDatasetId: { [options.datasetId]: [column.name] },
    rawSql: ColumnConversion.toUnmatchedValuesSql({
      relationSql: quoteSqlIdentifier(getRawValuesViewName(options.datasetId)),
      valueSql: quoteSqlIdentifier(column.name),
      conversion,
      limit: MAX_UNMATCHED_VALUES,
    }),
  });
  return result.data.map((row) => {
    const value = String(row.value);
    return { value, valueKey: toValueKey(value), rowCount: Number(row.rows) };
  });
}

/**
 * Reads, on this device, each picked column's values that no pair in its
 * code list matches, with their row counts: the values the Unmatched
 * values step resolves. It reads the values as stored, and compares them
 * in SQL exactly as the conversion will. A reply for picks that have since
 * changed is dropped.
 */
export function useUnmatchedValues(
  options: Readonly<{
    dataset: Dataset.T | undefined;
    columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[] | undefined;
    picks: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnPick>>;
    codeLists: ReadonlyMap<string, DataDictionaryCodeList.T>;
  }>,
): UnmatchedValues {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { columns, picks, codeLists } = options;
  const datasetId = options.dataset?.id;
  const requests = useMemo(() => {
    return _buildRequests({ columns: columns ?? [], picks, codeLists });
  }, [columns, picks, codeLists]);
  const key =
    datasetId && columns
      ? JSON.stringify([
          datasetId,
          ...requests.map((request) => {
            return [request.column.id, request.column.name, request.conversion];
          }),
        ])
      : undefined;
  return useTaggedRead({
    key,
    devMsg: "Reading unmatched values failed",
    read: async () => {
      const entries = await Promise.all(
        requests.map(async (request) => {
          // `read` runs only with a key, and a key needs a dataset.
          const values = datasetId
            ? await _readColumn({ workspaceId: workspace.id, datasetId, request })
            : [];
          return [request.column.id, values] as const;
        }),
      );
      return new Map(entries);
    },
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Run it to see it fail, then create `src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/usePreviewRows.ts`:**

```ts
import { quoteSqlIdentifier } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import { getRawValuesViewName } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText";
import { WorkspaceQuerySession } from "@/clients/qetl/WorkspaceQuerySession/WorkspaceQuerySession";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { useTaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { TaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";

/** How many rows the preview shows. */
export const PREVIEW_ROW_COUNT = 50;

/** One column of the preview, and the conversion it would get, if any. */
export type PreviewColumn = {
  column: DatasetColumn.T;
  conversion: ColumnConversion.T | undefined;
};

/** One cell: the value as stored, and what it becomes when converted. */
export type PreviewCell = { raw: string; converted: string | undefined };

/** One row's cells, in the order of the preview's columns. */
export type PreviewRow = readonly PreviewCell[];

/**
 * The preview's query: each column's stored value as text, `r<i>`, and
 * for a converted column what it becomes, `c<i>`, over the first rows of
 * the raw-values view. Values are compared as text, the way the
 * conversion keeps an unmatched one.
 */
export function buildPreviewSql(
  options: Readonly<{ datasetId: Dataset.Id; columns: readonly PreviewColumn[] }>,
): string {
  const selects = options.columns.flatMap(({ column, conversion }, index) => {
    const valueSql = quoteSqlIdentifier(column.name);
    const raw = `CAST(${valueSql} AS VARCHAR) AS "r${index}"`;
    if (!conversion) {
      return [raw];
    }
    // Without kept values an ordered list renders as text, which is what a
    // preview of 50 rows wants: its ENUM needs every value in the data.
    const caseSql = ColumnConversion.toCaseSql({ valueSql, conversion });
    return [raw, `${caseSql} AS "c${index}"`];
  });
  const relation = quoteSqlIdentifier(getRawValuesViewName(options.datasetId));
  return `SELECT ${selects.join(", ")} FROM ${relation} LIMIT ${PREVIEW_ROW_COUNT}`;
}

function _toText(value: unknown): string {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
}

function _toPreviewRows(
  data: ReadonlyArray<Record<string, unknown>>,
  columns: readonly PreviewColumn[],
): PreviewRow[] {
  return data.map((row) => {
    return columns.map(({ conversion }, index) => {
      return {
        raw: _toText(row[`r${index}`]),
        converted: conversion ? _toText(row[`c${index}`]) : undefined,
      };
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Reads the preview drawer's rows on this device, only while it is open:
 * the first rows as stored, beside what each converted column turns them
 * into with the picks, resolutions, and added values as they are now.
 */
export function usePreviewRows(
  options: Readonly<{
    dataset: Dataset.T;
    columns: readonly PreviewColumn[];
    isEnabled: boolean;
  }>,
): TaggedRead<PreviewRow[]> {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { dataset, columns } = options;
  const key = options.isEnabled
    ? JSON.stringify([dataset.id, ...columns.map((item) => {
        return [item.column.id, item.column.name, item.conversion ?? null];
      })])
    : undefined;
  return useTaggedRead({
    key,
    devMsg: "Reading the apply preview failed",
    read: async () => {
      const result = await WorkspaceQuerySession.runQuery<Record<string, unknown>>({
        workspaceId: workspace.id,
        neededColumnsByDatasetId: {
          [dataset.id]: columns.map((item) => {
            return item.column.name;
          }),
        },
        rawSql: buildPreviewSql({ datasetId: dataset.id, columns }),
      });
      return _toPreviewRows(result.data, columns);
    },
  });
}
```

### Task 17: Match columns: Convert all, the row chip, and the pane's conversion controls

Load the `impeccable` skill before this task: these controls are a new surface inside an existing task view. Direction: an Operate surface in the Data Sources world, so the controls are the product's own (Mantine `Button`, `Button.Group`, `Checkbox`, the shared `Tooltip`), neutral by default with Brand Blue only on the chosen mode, and no new tokens. Spec section 7.5 places them and section 13 gives every word:

- The chips band gains, on its trailing edge, "For every column" with a two-option `SegmentedControl` (radios), **Convert all** · **Attach dictionaries only as references**, each label with its tooltip. It shows **Convert all** while every coded column converts, the other while none does, and neither for a mix; choosing one sets every coded column. Its labels' tooltips open on hover only, because `SegmentedControl` puts keyboard focus on visually hidden radios; each row's chip and the pane's buttons carry the same text and open on focus.
- The pairing table gains a narrow **Values** column holding a chip, **Convert** or **Reference only**, that switches the row. Its accessible name is its visible text, and the column it belongs to and what clicking does are its description (`aria-describedby`), so a voice user can say what they see. It is not an `aria-pressed` toggle: its label changes with its state, and a toggle's name must not.
- The side pane gains **How to apply the dictionary** as two stacked buttons, **Apply conversions** and **Attach labels only as reference** (`aria-pressed`, one tooltip each, opening on hover and on focus), then the explanation sentence. Only under Apply conversions: the direction switch (**Codes → labels** · **Labels → codes**, with "Chosen from the data" while it was read from the data), the Value in data · Rows · Becomes table with accepted spellings marked, and "Also keep the original values in a new column, <name>_original".
- When the dataset cannot be converted anywhere (Task 15's `canConvert` is false), **Convert all** is a disabled radio, and a chip's switch to Convert and **Apply conversions** stay focusable but inert (`aria-disabled`); every one of them says why in its tooltip.

- [ ] **Step 3: The copy in one place.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/useConversionCopy.ts`. Spec section 13 is the source of every sentence here except `convertUnavailable`, which this plan adds:

```ts
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { canConvert } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyTargets/applyTargets";
import type { ApplyTargets } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyTargets/applyTargets";

/** The words the conversion controls use, translated once. */
export type ConversionCopy = {
  convertAllTooltip: string;
  referenceAllTooltip: string;
  convertTooltip: string;
  referenceTooltip: string;
  convertExplanation: string;
  referenceExplanation: string;
  /** Why nothing in this dataset can be converted, or undefined. */
  convertUnavailable: string | undefined;
};

function useConvertUnavailable(
  datasetName: string,
  targets: Readonly<ApplyTargets> | undefined,
): string | undefined {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (!targets || canConvert(targets) || targets.linked.isAvailable) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return targets.linked.reason === "dataset_limit"
    ? t`Converting ${datasetName} creates a linked dataset, and your plan's dataset limit is reached. You can still attach labels as reference.`
    : t`Converting ${datasetName} creates a linked dataset, and only workspace admins can add datasets. You can still attach labels as reference.`;
}

/**
 * The tooltips and explanations of the conversion controls, and why
 * converting is unavailable when it is.
 */
export function useConversionCopy(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetName: string;
    targets: ApplyTargets | undefined;
  }>,
): ConversionCopy {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return {
    convertAllTooltip: t`Changes the values in every column that has codes, using the labels from your dictionaries. Charts, filters, and downloads show the labels from then on.`,
    referenceAllTooltip: t`Leaves every column exactly as it is. Your dictionaries are attached alongside the data, so anyone can hover a column to see what its values mean, and Ask Avandar can use them to answer questions.`,
    convertTooltip: t`Changes the values in this column using the dictionary. For example, every 1 becomes Male, and charts, filters, and downloads show Male from then on.`,
    referenceTooltip: t`Leaves this column exactly as it is. The dictionary is attached alongside it, so anyone can hover the column to see what each value means, and Ask Avandar can use it to answer questions.`,
    convertExplanation: t`Your data will change. The labels stay attached too, so the column is still explained.`,
    referenceExplanation: t`Your data stays the same, which is what you want for models and exports that need the original values. Hover the column to see the labels.`,
    convertUnavailable: useConvertUnavailable(options.datasetName, options.targets),
  };
}
```

`useConvertUnavailable` returns a reason only when `canConvert` is false, which in Part A means a linked dataset is unavailable; Task 29's wider `canConvert` keeps this right without a change here.

- [ ] **Step 4: Convert all.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/ConvertAllControls.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Group, SegmentedControl, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import { isConvertingPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import type { ConversionCopy } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/useConversionCopy";
import type {
  ApplyDictionariesAction,
  ColumnPick,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  picks: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnPick>>;
  copy: ConversionCopy;
  dispatch: Dispatch<ApplyDictionariesAction>;
};

/**
 * Which option "For every column" shows: `convert` while every coded
 * column converts, `reference` while none does, and none for a mix or
 * when no column has codes.
 */
export function getAllModesValue(
  picks: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnPick>>,
): "convert" | "reference" | "" {
  const coded = Object.values(picks).filter((pick) => {
    return pick.codeListId !== undefined;
  });
  if (coded.length === 0) {
    return "";
  }
  if (coded.every(isConvertingPick)) {
    return "convert";
  }
  return coded.every((pick) => {
    return pick.mode === "reference";
  })
    ? "reference"
    : "";
}

/**
 * "For every column": Convert all, or attach every dictionary only as
 * reference. Choosing one sets every coded column; columns can differ
 * again afterwards, and then neither option shows as chosen. Convert all
 * is disabled, with its reason in the tooltip, when nothing can convert.
 */
export function ConvertAllControls({ picks, copy, dispatch }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  return (
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
      <Text id={labelId} size="sm" c="dimmed">
        <Trans>For every column</Trans>
      </Text>
      <SegmentedControl
        size="xs"
        aria-labelledby={labelId}
        value={getAllModesValue(picks)}
        onChange={(value) => {
          dispatch({
            type: "set_all_modes",
            mode: value === "convert" ? "convert" : "reference",
          });
        }}
        data={[
          {
            value: "convert",
            disabled: copy.convertUnavailable !== undefined,
            label: (
              <Tooltip multiline maw={320} label={copy.convertUnavailable ?? copy.convertAllTooltip}>
                <span>{t`Convert all`}</span>
              </Tooltip>
            ),
          },
          {
            value: "reference",
            label: (
              <Tooltip multiline maw={320} label={copy.referenceAllTooltip}>
                <span>{t`Attach dictionaries only as references`}</span>
              </Tooltip>
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />
    </Group>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The row chip.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/ModeChip.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Stack, Text, UnstyledButton, VisuallyHidden } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/MatchColumnsStep.module.css";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { ConversionCopy } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/useConversionCopy";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  mode: DictionaryBinding.Mode;
  /** The id of the column name this chip is for. */
  nameId: string;
  copy: ConversionCopy;
  onToggle: () => void;
};

/**
 * A row's Values chip: Convert or Reference only, switching to the other
 * on click. Its name is what it shows; the column and what a click does
 * are its description. Switching to Convert is inert, and says why, when
 * nothing in the dataset can be converted.
 */
export function ModeChip({ mode, nameId, copy, onToggle }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const hintId = useId();
  const isConverting = mode === "convert";
  const isLocked = !isConverting && copy.convertUnavailable !== undefined;
  const hint = isConverting
    ? t`Click to attach as reference only instead.`
    : (copy.convertUnavailable ?? t`Click to convert instead.`);
  const tooltip = (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Text size="xs">{isConverting ? copy.convertTooltip : copy.referenceTooltip}</Text>
      <Text size="xs">{hint}</Text>
    </Stack>
  );
  return (
    <>
      <Tooltip multiline maw={320} label={tooltip}>
        <UnstyledButton
          className={css.modeChip}
          data-mode={mode}
          aria-describedby={`${nameId} ${hintId}`}
          aria-disabled={isLocked || undefined}
          onClick={() => {
            if (!isLocked) {
              onToggle();
            }
          }}
        >
          {isConverting ? <Trans>Convert</Trans> : <Trans>Reference only</Trans>}
        </UnstyledButton>
      </Tooltip>
      <VisuallyHidden id={hintId}>{hint}</VisuallyHidden>
    </>
  );
}
```

/** A row's Values cell: the mode chip, for a pick with a code list. */
export function ValuesCell(
  props: Readonly<{
    columnId: DatasetColumn.Id;
    nameId: string;
    pick: ColumnPick | undefined;
    copy: ConversionCopy;
    dispatch: Dispatch<ApplyDictionariesAction>;
  }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { columnId, pick } = props;
  if (!pick?.codeListId) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <ModeChip
      mode={pick.mode}
      nameId={props.nameId}
      copy={props.copy}
      onToggle={() => {
        props.dispatch({
          type: "set_mode",
          columnId,
          mode: pick.mode === "convert" ? "reference" : "convert",
        });
      }}
    />
  );
}

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { ConversionCopy } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/useConversionCopy";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  mode: DictionaryBinding.Mode;
  copy: ConversionCopy;
  onChange: (mode: DictionaryBinding.Mode) => void;
};

function ModeButton(
  props: Readonly<{
    label: string;
    tooltip: string;
    isSelected: boolean;
    isLocked: boolean;
    onSelect: () => void;
  }>,
): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Tooltip multiline maw={280} position="bottom" label={props.tooltip}>
      <Button
        variant={props.isSelected ? "light" : "default"}
        justify="flex-start"
        fullWidth
        aria-pressed={props.isSelected}
        aria-disabled={props.isLocked || undefined}
        data-disabled={props.isLocked || undefined}
        onClick={() => {
          if (!props.isLocked) {
            props.onSelect();
          }
        }}
      >
        {props.label}
      </Button>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

/**
 * How to apply the dictionary to the selected column: Apply conversions or
 * Attach labels only as reference, each with its tooltip, then what the
 * choice does to the data.
 */
export function ModeSwitch({ mode, copy, onChange }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const labelId = useId();
  return (
    <Stack gap={6}>
      <Text id={labelId} size="xs" fw={600} c="dimmed">
        <Trans>How to apply the dictionary</Trans>
      </Text>
      <Button.Group orientation="vertical" aria-labelledby={labelId}>
        <ModeButton
          label={t`Apply conversions`}
          tooltip={copy.convertUnavailable ?? copy.convertTooltip}
          isSelected={mode === "convert"}
          isLocked={copy.convertUnavailable !== undefined}
          onSelect={() => {
            onChange("convert");
          }}
        />
        <ModeButton
          label={t`Attach labels only as reference`}
          tooltip={copy.referenceTooltip}
          isSelected={mode === "reference"}
          isLocked={false}
          onSelect={() => {
            onChange("reference");
          }}
        />
      </Button.Group>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        {mode === "convert" ? copy.convertExplanation : copy.referenceExplanation}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/MatchColumnsStep/DirectionSwitch.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  direction: DictionaryBinding.Direction;
  /** Whether the direction was read from the data rather than chosen. */
  isFromData: boolean;
  onChange: (direction: DictionaryBinding.Direction) => void;
};

/**
 * Which way a converted column is translated: Codes → labels or
 * Labels → codes, with "Chosen from the data" until the user picks.
 */
export function DirectionSwitch({
  direction,
  isFromData,
  onChange,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const options = [
    { value: "decode", label: t`Codes → labels` },
    { value: "encode", label: t`Labels → codes` },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Button.Group aria-label={t`Which way to convert`}>
        {options.map((option) => {
          const isSelected = option.value === direction;
          return (
            <Button
              key={option.value}
              size="xs"
              variant={isSelected ? "light" : "default"}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => {
                onChange(option.value);
              }}
            >
              {option.label}
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </Button.Group>
      {isFromData ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>Chosen from the data</Trans>
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Table, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { ColumnProfile } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnProfile/ColumnProfile";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  values: readonly ColumnProfile.Value[];
  pairs: readonly DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair[];
  direction: DictionaryBinding.Direction;
  mode: DictionaryBinding.Mode;
};

/** The pair a value stands for, and whether an accepted spelling found it. */
type FoundPair = { pair: DataDictionaryCodeList.Pair; isAcceptedSpelling: boolean };

function _isSameValue(spelling: string, key: string): boolean {
  return spelling.trim() !== "" && ColumnProfile.getComparisonKey(spelling) === key;
}

function _findPair(value: string, props: Readonly<Props>): FoundPair | undefined {
  const key = ColumnProfile.getComparisonKey(value);
  for (const pair of props.pairs) {
    if (props.direction === "decode" ? _isSameValue(pair.code, key) : _isSameValue(pair.label, key)) {
      return { pair, isAcceptedSpelling: false };
    }
    if (props.direction === "encode" && pair.acceptedSpellings.some((spelling) => {
      return _isSameValue(spelling, key);
    })) {
      return { pair, isAcceptedSpelling: true };
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function NotInList({ mode }: Readonly<Pick<Props, "mode">>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Text size="sm" c="warning.8">
      {mode === "convert" ? (
        <Trans>Not in the list, kept as is</Trans>
      ) : (
        <Trans>Not in the list</Trans>
      )}
    </Text>
  );
}

function MeaningCell(
  props: Readonly<{ found: FoundPair | undefined; direction: Props["direction"]; mode: Props["mode"] }>,
): ReactNode {
  if (!props.found) {
    return <NotInList mode={props.mode} />;
  }
  const { pair, isAcceptedSpelling } = props.found;
  const code = pair.code;
  if (props.direction === "encode") {
    return (
      <>
        {props.mode === "convert" ? code : <Trans>code {code}</Trans>}
        {isAcceptedSpelling ? (
          <Text span size="xs" c="dimmed">
            {" "}
            <Trans>(accepted spelling)</Trans>
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </>
    );
  }
  return pair.label.trim() === "" ? (
    <Text size="sm" c="dimmed" fs="italic">
      {props.mode === "convert" ? <Trans>No label yet, kept as is</Trans> : <Trans>No label yet</Trans>}
    </Text>
  ) : (
    pair.label
  );
}

/**
 * Each value in a column, its rows, and what the code list says it means,
 * or, when the column converts, what it becomes. Accepted spellings are
 * marked, and a value the list does not hold says it is kept as is.
 */
export function ColumnValuesTable(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  return (
    <Table verticalSpacing={4} fz="sm">
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>Value in data</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th ta="end">
            <Trans>Rows</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th>
            {props.mode === "convert" ? <Trans>Becomes</Trans> : <Trans>Means</Trans>}
          </Table.Th>
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      <Table.Tbody>
        {props.values.map((item) => {
          return (
            <Table.Tr key={item.value}>
              <Table.Td fw={600}>{item.value}</Table.Td>
              <Table.Td ta="end">{i18n.number(item.rowCount)}</Table.Td>
              <Table.Td>
                <MeaningCell
                  found={_findPair(item.value, props)}
                  direction={props.direction}
                  mode={props.mode}
                />
              </Table.Td>
            </Table.Tr>
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

`_findPair` keeps the slice 3 rule that a blank code or spelling never matches, and still uses `ColumnProfile.getComparisonKey` because the profile's values are what the user sees here. The conversion itself compares in SQL (Task 7).

function DirectionNote({
  direction,
}: Readonly<Pick<ColumnPick, "direction">>): ReactNode {

        <Trans>Chosen from the data: these values are codes.</Trans>

      )}
    </Text>

function DescriptionOnly({
  description,
}: Readonly<{ description: string | undefined }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Text size="xs" fw={600} c="dimmed">
        <Trans>Description added to the column</Trans>
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm">{description || <Trans>No description yet</Trans>}</Text>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        <Trans>This entry has no codes, so only its description is attached.</Trans>
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  );
}

function KeepOriginalCheckbox(
  props: Readonly<{ columnName: string; isChecked: boolean; onChange: (isChecked: boolean) => void }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const originalName = `${props.columnName}_original`;
  return (
    <Checkbox
      size="xs"
      label={t`Also keep the original values in a new column, ${originalName}`}
      checked={props.isChecked}
      onChange={(event) => {
        props.onChange(event.currentTarget.checked);
      }}
    />
  );
}

function CodedDetails(
  props: Readonly<Omit<Props, "lookups"> & { codeList: DataDictionaryCodeList.T }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { row, pick, dispatch } = props;
  const columnId = row.column.id;
  const isConverting = pick.mode === "convert";
  const values = row.profile?.values;
  return (
    <>
      <ModeSwitch
        mode={pick.mode}
        copy={props.copy}
        onChange={(mode) => {
          dispatch({ type: "set_mode", columnId, mode });
        }}
      />
      {isConverting ? (
        <DirectionSwitch
          direction={pick.direction}
          isFromData={pick.isDirectionFromData}
          onChange={(direction) => {
            dispatch({ type: "set_direction", columnId, direction });
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <DirectionNote direction={pick.direction} />
      )}
      {values ? (
        <ColumnValuesTable values={values} pairs={props.codeList.pairs} direction={pick.direction} mode={pick.mode} />
      ) : null}
      {isConverting ? (
        <KeepOriginalCheckbox
          columnName={row.column.name}
          isChecked={pick.keepsOriginal}
          onChange={(keepsOriginal) => {
            dispatch({ type: "set_keeps_original", columnId, keepsOriginal });
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * What applying the picked entry does to a column: where it comes from,
 * whether its values convert or stay as they are, and what each value in
 * the column means or becomes.
 */
export function PickedEntryDetails(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { pick, lookups } = props;
  const entry = lookups.entries.get(pick.entryId);
  const codeList = pick.codeListId ? lookups.codeLists.get(pick.codeListId) : undefined;
  return (
    <Stack gap="md">
      <AppliedFrom
        dictionaryName={lookups.dictionaryNames.get(pick.dictionaryId) ?? ""}
        entryName={entry?.name ?? ""}
        codeListName={codeList?.name}
      />
      {codeList ? (
        <CodedDetails {...props} codeList={codeList} />
      ) : (
        <DescriptionOnly description={entry?.description} />
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

### Task 18: Unmatched values

A new step between Match columns and Save as (spec section 7.5). Direction, with the `impeccable` skill loaded: a full-width task step, no rail, two `AppViewSection`s of plain tables, one row per value, and the resolution as a radio group named by the value it resolves, so the step reads as a worklist rather than a form. Nothing is preselected except the default, **Keep as is** (or **Leave unlabeled**), so a user who agrees with the default does nothing.

- **Values being converted** (columns in convert mode): Column, Value, Rows, and **Keep as is** · **Use an existing label** (a Select of the list's labelled pairs) · **Add to list** (a text input: the label when the column holds codes, the code when it holds labels) · **Leave empty**.
- **Values without a label** (reference columns): **Leave unlabeled** · **Add to list**.
- **Add to list** changes the dictionary, so it is disabled with a tooltip for someone who cannot edit dictionaries (`data_sources__can_edit_dictionaries`), and for a code already in the list with a blank label (labelling it is an edit on the dictionary, not an addition). A blank **Add to list** input keeps the value as is.
- A column that encodes to whole numbers (`ColumnConversion.getOutputDataType` is `bigint`) is cast with `TRY_CAST`, so a kept value that is not an integer becomes empty. For such a value the resolution shows **Leave empty** as its default, and **Keep as is** is disabled with "This column becomes whole numbers, so this value can't stay as text." A kept integer (` 7 `) stays as it is. Nothing is stored for the default, which is also what the view does.
- Nothing unmatched: an `AppSlateEmptyState` says so, and the footer's Next moves on. The Next button stays in the footer, where it is on every step, rather than also sitting in the empty state.
- While the values are read: a loader. If they cannot be read: a `Callout` saying so, and Next still works, since every unmatched value is kept by default.

- [ ] **Step 2: Run it to see it fail, then create `buildUnmatchedRows.ts`.** `pnpm vitest run src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/buildUnmatchedRows.test.ts` fails (no module). Create it:

```ts
import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import { toValueKey } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { ColumnPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { UnmatchedValue } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";

/** One value to resolve, with its column and how that column is applied. */
export type UnmatchedRow = {
  column: DatasetColumn.T;
  pick: ColumnPick;
  codeList: DataDictionaryCodeList.T;
  item: UnmatchedValue;
  /** The value is a code already in the list, with a blank label. */
  isInListWithoutLabel: boolean;
  /**
   * The column encodes to whole numbers and the value is not one, so the
   * conversion empties it: it cannot be kept as it is.
   */
  cannotStayAsText: boolean;
};

/** A whole number as the conversion's `TRY_CAST` to `BIGINT` reads it. */
const WHOLE_NUMBER = /^ *-?[0-9]{1,18} *$/;

function _cannotStayAsText(
  item: UnmatchedValue,
  pick: ColumnPick,
  codeList: DataDictionaryCodeList.T,
): boolean {
  const outputDataType = ColumnConversion.getOutputDataType({
    direction: pick.direction,
    pairs: codeList.pairs,
  });
  return (
    pick.mode === "convert" &&
    outputDataType === "bigint" &&
    !WHOLE_NUMBER.test(item.value)
  );
}

function _isInListWithoutLabel(
  item: UnmatchedValue,
  pick: ColumnPick,
  codeList: DataDictionaryCodeList.T,
): boolean {
  return (
    pick.direction === "decode" &&
    codeList.pairs.some((pair) => {
      return toValueKey(pair.code) === item.valueKey && pair.label.trim() === "";
    })
  );
}

/**
 * The Unmatched values step's rows, in the dataset's column order: values
 * of converted columns, and values of reference columns, which have no
 * label to show.
 */
export function buildUnmatchedRows(
  options: Readonly<{
    columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
    picks: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnPick>>;
    codeLists: ReadonlyMap<string, DataDictionaryCodeList.T>;
    unmatchedByColumnId: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly UnmatchedValue[]>;
  }>,
): { converted: UnmatchedRow[]; reference: UnmatchedRow[] } {
  const rows = options.columns.flatMap((column) => {
    const pick = options.picks[column.id];
    const codeList = pick?.codeListId ? options.codeLists.get(pick.codeListId) : undefined;
    if (!pick || !codeList) {
      return [];
    }
    return (options.unmatchedByColumnId.get(column.id) ?? []).map((item) => {
      return {
        column,
        pick,
        codeList,
        item,
        isInListWithoutLabel: _isInListWithoutLabel(item, pick, codeList),
        cannotStayAsText: _cannotStayAsText(item, pick, codeList),
      };
    });
  });
  return {
    converted: rows.filter((row) => {
      return row.pick.mode === "convert";
    }),
    reference: rows.filter((row) => {
      return row.pick.mode === "reference";
    }),
  };
}
```

        [COUNTY.id, [{ value: "Kings", valueKey: "kings", rowCount: 2 }]],
      ]),
    },
    ...overrides,
  });
}

function _render(flow: ApplyFlow): void {
  const state = {
    ...flow.state,
    picks: { ...flow.state.picks, [COUNTY.id]: { ...SEX_PICK, mode: "reference" as const } },
  };
  render(
    <UnmatchedValuesStep
      dataset={DATASET}
      columns={[GENDER, COUNTY]}
      flow={{ ...flow, state }}
      lookups={makeApplyLookups()}
      preview={null}
    />,
  );
}

describe("UnmatchedValuesStep", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mocks.canEditDictionaries = true;
  });

  it("lists converted values and reference values in their own sections", () => {
    _render(_flow());

    const section = screen.getByRole("region", { name: "Values being converted" });
    expect(within(section).getByRole("row", { name: /GENDER 7 3/ })).toBeInTheDocument();

    const converted = screen.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "What to do with 7 in GENDER" });
    expect(within(converted).getByRole("radio", { name: "Keep as is" })).toBeChecked();
    expect(within(converted).getAllByRole("radio")).toHaveLength(4);
    const reference = screen.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "What to do with Kings in county" });
    expect(within(reference).getByRole("radio", { name: "Leave unlabeled" })).toBeChecked();
    expect(within(reference).getAllByRole("radio")).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it("resolves a value, and asks for the label to add", () => {
    const flow = _flow({
      state: {
        ...makeApplyFlow().state,
        resolutions: { [GENDER.id]: { "7": { action: "add", text: "" } } },
      },
    });
    _render(flow);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: "Leave empty" }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Label for 7" }), {
      target: { value: "Other" },
    });

    expect(flow.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      type: "resolve_value",
      columnId: GENDER.id,
      valueKey: "7",
      resolution: { action: "empty" },
    });
    expect(flow.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      type: "resolve_value",
      columnId: GENDER.id,
      valueKey: "7",
      resolution: { action: "add", text: "Other" },
    });
  });

  it("uses the first labelled pair when an existing label is chosen", () => {
    const flow = _flow();
    _render(flow);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: "Use an existing label" }));

    expect(flow.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      type: "resolve_value",
      columnId: GENDER.id,
      valueKey: "7",
      resolution: { action: "map", code: "1" },
    });
  });

  it("leaves a value empty by default when a whole-number column cannot keep it", () => {
    const flow = makeApplyFlow({
      unmatched: {
        status: "ready",
        result: new Map([[GENDER.id, [{ value: "X", valueKey: "x", rowCount: 2 }]]]),
      },
    });
    _render({
      ...flow,
      state: {
        ...flow.state,
        picks: { [GENDER.id]: { ...SEX_PICK, direction: "encode" } },
      },
    });

    const group = screen.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "What to do with X in GENDER" });
    expect(within(group).getByRole("radio", { name: "Leave empty" })).toBeChecked();
    expect(within(group).getByRole("radio", { name: "Keep as is" })).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("disables Add to list without edit access to dictionaries", () => {
    mocks.canEditDictionaries = false;
    _render(_flow());

    for (const radio of screen.getAllByRole("radio", { name: "Add to list" })) {
      expect(radio).toBeDisabled();
    }
  });

  it("says so when nothing is unmatched, and moves on", () => {
    const flow = _flow({ unmatched: { status: "ready", result: new Map() } });
    _render(flow);

    expect(screen.getByText("Nothing is unmatched")).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Next: save as" }));
    expect(flow.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ type: "go_to_step", step: "save" });
  });
});

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from "@avandar/ui";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Group, Radio, Select, Stack, TextInput } from "@mantine/core";
import type { UnmatchedRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/buildUnmatchedRows";
import type {
  ApplyDictionariesAction,
  ValueResolution,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Action = ValueResolution["action"];

type Props = {
  row: UnmatchedRow;
  resolution: ValueResolution | undefined;
  canEditDictionaries: boolean;
  dispatch: Dispatch<ApplyDictionariesAction>;
};

const CONVERTED_ACTIONS: readonly Action[] = ["keep", "map", "add", "empty"];
const REFERENCE_ACTIONS: readonly Action[] = ["keep", "add"];

/** The radio labels, by action. Keep reads differently without conversion. */
function useActionLabels(isConverting: boolean): Record<Action, string> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return {
    keep: isConverting ? t`Keep as is` : t`Leave unlabeled`,
    map: t`Use an existing label`,
    add: t`Add to list`,
    empty: t`Leave empty`,
  };
}

/** Why each action is unavailable for this value, if it is. */
function useBlockers(
  row: UnmatchedRow,
  canEditDictionaries: boolean,
): Partial<Record<Action, string>> {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { value } = row.item;
  const addBlocker = !canEditDictionaries
    ? t`Adding a value changes the dictionary, so it needs edit access to dictionaries.`
    : row.isInListWithoutLabel
      ? t`${value} is already in the list, without a label. Label it on the dictionary.`
      : undefined;
  const keepBlocker = row.cannotStayAsText
    ? t`This column becomes whole numbers, so this value can't stay as text.`
    : undefined;
  return { add: addBlocker, keep: keepBlocker };
}

/** The resolution an action starts with when it is chosen. */
function _startResolution(action: Action, row: UnmatchedRow): ValueResolution {
  switch (action) {
    case "map": {
      const firstLabelled = row.codeList.pairs.find((pair) => {
        return pair.label.trim() !== "";
      });
      return { action: "map", code: firstLabelled?.code ?? "" };
    }
    case "add":
      return { action: "add", text: "" };
    case "keep":
    case "empty":
      return { action };
  }
}

function ActionRadio(
  props: Readonly<{ name: string; label: string; isChecked: boolean; blocker: string | undefined; onSelect: () => void }>,
): ReactNode {
  const radio = (
    <Radio
      size="xs"
      name={props.name}
      label={props.label}
      checked={props.isChecked}
      disabled={props.blocker !== undefined}
      onChange={props.onSelect}
    />
  );
  return props.blocker ? (
    <Tooltip multiline maw={280} label={props.blocker}>
      <span>{radio}</span>
    </Tooltip>
  ) : (
    radio
  );
}

/** The Select or input a chosen action needs: an existing label, or text to add. */
function ResolutionDetail(
  props: Readonly<{ row: UnmatchedRow; resolution: ValueResolution | undefined; onResolve: (resolution: ValueResolution) => void }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { row, resolution } = props;
  const { value } = row.item;
  if (resolution?.action === "map") {
    const options = row.codeList.pairs
      .filter((pair) => {
        return pair.label.trim() !== "";
      })
      .map((pair) => {
        return { value: pair.code, label: pair.label };
      });
    return (
      <Select
        size="xs"
        maw={280}
        aria-label={t`Label to use for ${value}`}
        data={options}
        value={resolution.code}
        allowDeselect={false}
        onChange={(code) => {
          props.onResolve({ action: "map", code: code ?? "" });
        }}
      />
    );
  }
  if (resolution?.action === "add") {
    const isLabel = row.pick.direction === "decode";
    return (
      <TextInput
        size="xs"
        maw={280}
        aria-label={isLabel ? t`Label for ${value}` : t`Code for ${value}`}
        placeholder={isLabel ? t`Label` : t`Code`}
        value={resolution.text}
        onChange={(event) => {
          props.onResolve({ action: "add", text: event.currentTarget.value });
        }}
      />
    );
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * How one unmatched value is resolved: a radio group named by the value,
 * and, for Use an existing label or Add to list, the Select or input that
 * completes it. Nothing chosen means the default: Keep as is, or Leave
 * empty for a value a whole-number column cannot keep.
 */
export function ResolutionControl(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { row, dispatch } = props;
  const { value, valueKey } = row.item;
  const columnName = row.column.name;
  const isConverting = row.pick.mode === "convert";
  const labels = useActionLabels(isConverting);
  const blockers = useBlockers(row, props.canEditDictionaries);
  // What the conversion does with no resolution stored: keep the value, or
  // empty it when a whole-number column cannot keep it.
  const current = props.resolution?.action ?? (row.cannotStayAsText ? "empty" : "keep");
  const resolve = (resolution: ValueResolution): void => {
    dispatch({ type: "resolve_value", columnId: row.column.id, valueKey, resolution });
  };
  return (
    <Stack gap={6}>
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={t`What to do with ${value} in ${columnName}`}>
        <Group gap="md">
          {(isConverting ? CONVERTED_ACTIONS : REFERENCE_ACTIONS).map((action) => {
            return (
              <ActionRadio
                key={action}
                name={`resolve-${row.column.id}-${valueKey}`}
                label={labels[action]}
                isChecked={current === action}
                blocker={blockers[action]}
                onSelect={() => {
                  resolve(_startResolution(action, row));
                }}
              />
            );
          })}
        </Group>
      </div>
      <ResolutionDetail row={row} resolution={props.resolution} onResolve={resolve} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

A list with no labelled pair starts **Use an existing label** with no code; Task 15's `_toOverrides` writes no override for it, so the value is kept as is.

import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Table } from "@mantine/core";
import { ResolutionControl } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/ResolutionControl";
import type { UnmatchedRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/buildUnmatchedRows";
import type {
  ApplyDictionariesAction,
  ApplyDictionariesState,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  rows: readonly UnmatchedRow[];
  resolutions: ApplyDictionariesState["resolutions"];
  canEditDictionaries: boolean;
  dispatch: Dispatch<ApplyDictionariesAction>;
};

/** One row per unmatched value: its column, the value, its rows, and what to do. */
export function UnmatchedValuesTable(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  return (
    <Table layout="fixed" verticalSpacing="sm">
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          <Table.Th w="16%">
            <Trans>Column</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="16%">
            <Trans>Value</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th w="8%" ta="end">
            <Trans>Rows</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>What to do</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      <Table.Tbody>
        {props.rows.map((row) => {
          const { column, item } = row;
          return (
            <Table.Tr key={`${column.id}:${item.valueKey}`}>
              <Table.Td>{column.name}</Table.Td>
              <Table.Td fw={600}>{item.value}</Table.Td>
              <Table.Td ta="end">{i18n.number(item.rowCount)}</Table.Td>
              <Table.Td>
                <ResolutionControl
                  row={row}
                  resolution={props.resolutions[column.id]?.[item.valueKey]}
                  canEditDictionaries={props.canEditDictionaries}
                  dispatch={props.dispatch}
                />
              </Table.Td>
            </Table.Tr>
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}

import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Button } from "@mantine/core";
import { NewDictionaryFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/NewDictionaryFromDatasetsView/NewDictionaryFooter/NewDictionaryFooter";
import type { ApplyDictionariesAction } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** Whether any column converts, which names the last step Save as. */
  isConverting: boolean;
  /** Whether the dataset is a linked dataset, whose last step is Save. */
  isLinkedDataset: boolean;
  dispatch: Dispatch<ApplyDictionariesAction>;
};

/** Back to Match columns, and Next to the last step, by its name. */
export function UnmatchedValuesFooter({
  isConverting,
  isLinkedDataset,
  dispatch,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const nextLabel = !isConverting ? (
    <Trans>Next: attach</Trans>
  ) : isLinkedDataset ? (
    <Trans>Next: save</Trans>
  ) : (
    <Trans>Next: save as</Trans>
  );
  return (
    <NewDictionaryFooter
      start={
        <Button
          variant="default"
          onClick={() => {
            dispatch({ type: "go_to_step", step: "match" });
          }}
        >
          <Trans>Back</Trans>
        </Button>
      }
    >
      <Button
        onClick={() => {
          dispatch({ type: "go_to_step", step: "save" });
        }}
      >
        {nextLabel}
      </Button>
    </NewDictionaryFooter>
  );
}

```tsx
import { Callout } from "@avandar/ui";
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Center, Loader, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconCircleCheck } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useId } from "react";
import { AppSlateEmptyState } from "@/components/AppSlateEmptyState/AppSlateEmptyState";
import { AppViewBody } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewBody/AppViewBody";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import { useHasPermission } from "@/hooks/permissions/useHasPermission/useHasPermission";
import { isConvertingPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import { buildUnmatchedRows } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/buildUnmatchedRows";
import { UnmatchedValuesFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/UnmatchedValuesFooter";
import { UnmatchedValuesTable } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/UnmatchedValuesTable";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { UnmatchedRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/UnmatchedValuesStep/buildUnmatchedRows";
import type { ApplyLookups } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyLookups";
import type { ApplyFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFlow";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
  flow: ApplyFlow;
  lookups: ApplyLookups;
  /** The preview drawer, between the body and the footer. */
  preview: ReactNode;
};

/**
 * One section of values, a region named by its heading, so a screen
 * reader can jump between the two lists.
 */
function ValuesSection(
  props: Readonly<{ title: ReactNode; rows: readonly UnmatchedRow[]; flow: ApplyFlow; canEditDictionaries: boolean }>,
): ReactNode {
  const headingId = useId();
  if (props.rows.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }
  const countText = plural(props.rows.length, { one: "# value", other: "# values" });
  return (
    <div role="region" aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <AppViewSection title={<span id={headingId}>{props.title}</span>} meta={countText}>
        <UnmatchedValuesTable
          rows={props.rows}
          resolutions={props.flow.state.resolutions}
          canEditDictionaries={props.canEditDictionaries}
          dispatch={props.flow.dispatch}
        />
      </AppViewSection>
    </div>
  );
}

function ReadyBody(props: Readonly<Props & { canEditDictionaries: boolean }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { unmatched } = props.flow;
  const rows = buildUnmatchedRows({
    columns: props.columns,
    picks: props.flow.state.picks,
    codeLists: props.lookups.codeLists,
    unmatchedByColumnId: unmatched.status === "ready" ? unmatched.result : new Map(),
  });
  if (rows.converted.length === 0 && rows.reference.length === 0) {
    return (
      <AppSlateEmptyState
        icon={<IconCircleCheck size={32} stroke={1.5} aria-hidden />}
        title={t`Nothing is unmatched`}
        message={<Trans>Every value in the columns you picked is in its code list.</Trans>}
      />
    );
  }
  const shared = { flow: props.flow, canEditDictionaries: props.canEditDictionaries };
  return (
    <Stack gap="xl">
      <ValuesSection {...shared} title={<Trans>Values being converted</Trans>} rows={rows.converted} />
      <ValuesSection {...shared} title={<Trans>Values without a label</Trans>} rows={rows.reference} />
    </Stack>
  );
}

function UnmatchedBody(props: Readonly<Props & { canEditDictionaries: boolean }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { status } = props.flow.unmatched;
  if (status === "reading") {
    return (
      <Center p="xxl">
        <Stack align="center" gap="sm">
          <Loader size="sm" />
          <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
            <Trans>Finding values that are not in the code lists</Trans>
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Center>
    );
  }
  if (status === "failed") {
    return (
      <Callout
        maw={560}
        title={t`The values could not be read`}
        message={t`Avandar could not read which values are missing from the code lists. You can go on: every value no pair matches is kept as it is.`}
      />
    );
  }
  return <ReadyBody {...props} />;
}

/**
 * The Unmatched values step: every value of a picked column that its code
 * list does not hold, with its rows and how to resolve it. Converted
 * columns can keep, map, add, or empty a value; reference columns can leave
 * it unlabeled or add it to the list.
 */
export function UnmatchedValuesStep(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const canEditDictionaries = useHasPermission("data_sources__can_edit_dictionaries");
  const isConverting = Object.values(props.flow.state.picks).some(isConvertingPick);
  return (
    <>
      <AppViewBody>
        <UnmatchedBody {...props} canEditDictionaries={canEditDictionaries} />
      </AppViewBody>
      {props.preview}
      <UnmatchedValuesFooter
        isConverting={isConverting}
        isLinkedDataset={props.flow.targets?.isLinkedDataset ?? false}
        dispatch={props.flow.dispatch}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

`p="xxl"` uses the theme's spacing scale (DESIGN.md's empty-state step); `AppSlateEmptyState` sits flush on the body's surface, as `NoDictionaryInUse` does.

### Task 19: The preview drawer

**Preview data** (in the header, Task 21) opens a drawer that rises from the footer bar at any step (spec section 7.5). Direction, with the `impeccable` skill loaded: the drawer is a region of the same lit surface, not a floating card, so it takes the lower 46% of the view as a flex item between the step's body and its footer, separated by a hairline, and the body above simply gets shorter and keeps scrolling. Its one motion is a short rise and fade at the drawer duration (`--ava-animation-duration-moderate`, 270 ms), none under reduced motion. It holds a plain Mantine `Table`, not the ag-grid `DataGrid`: 50 rows need no virtualization, and each cell needs markup the grid would take a custom renderer for (`<del>` and `<ins>` for a changed value, a tint plus a dotted underline and hidden text for an unmatched one, a tag in a reference column's header), which a table renders as plain, accessible HTML.

- A changed cell reads `~~1~~ Male`: the stored value in `<del>`, what it becomes in `<ins>`. A value emptied by **Leave empty** shows a dimmed "empty".
- An unmatched value (kept as is) is tinted and underlined, with "not in the list" for screen readers, so color is not the only signal.
- A reference-only column is unchanged, with a tag in its header.
- **Only columns this touches** hides columns with no pick. Toggling it filters what is already read; it does not query again.
- The drawer is a region named by its heading, "Preview data". It takes focus when it opens; Escape inside it closes it, and the flow returns focus to **Preview data** (Task 21).

describe("previewColumns", () => {

```ts
import { toValueKey } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import {
  buildDraftConversion,
  isConvertingPick,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import type { DataDictionaryCodeList } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionaryCodeList/DataDictionaryCodeList";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type {
  ApplyDictionariesState,
  ColumnPick,
  ValueResolution,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { UnmatchedValue } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import type {
  PreviewCell,
  PreviewColumn,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/usePreviewRows";

/** One preview column, how the apply treats it, and what to tint. */
export type PreviewColumnPlan = PreviewColumn & {
  /** Has a pick: "Only columns this touches" keeps it. */
  isTouched: boolean;
  /** Attached as reference: unchanged, with a tag in its header. */
  isReference: boolean;
  /** Keys of the values still unmatched once resolved, to tint. */
  unmatchedKeys: ReadonlySet<string>;
};

/** How a preview cell is drawn. */
export type PreviewCellStatus = "changed" | "unmatched" | "plain";

/** Whether a resolution still leaves its value as it is. */
function _isStillUnmatched(resolution: ValueResolution | undefined): boolean {
  if (!resolution || resolution.action === "keep") {
    return true;
  }
  return (
    (resolution.action === "add" && resolution.text.trim() === "") ||
    (resolution.action === "map" && resolution.code === "")
  );
}

function _toPlan(
  column: DatasetColumn.T,
  pick: ColumnPick | undefined,
  options: Readonly<Omit<Parameters<typeof buildPreviewColumns>[0], "columns">>,
): PreviewColumnPlan {
  const codeList = pick?.codeListId ? options.codeLists.get(pick.codeListId) : undefined;
  const resolutions = options.resolutions[column.id];
  const unmatched = options.unmatchedByColumnId.get(column.id);
  const conversion =
    isConvertingPick(pick) && codeList
      ? buildDraftConversion({ column, pick, codeList, resolutions, unmatched })
      : undefined;
  const unmatchedKeys = new Set(
    (unmatched ?? [])
      .filter((item) => {
        return _isStillUnmatched(resolutions?.[item.valueKey]);
      })
      .map((item) => {
        return item.valueKey;
      }),
  );
  return {
    column,
    conversion,
    isTouched: pick !== undefined,
    isReference: codeList !== undefined && conversion === undefined,
    unmatchedKeys,
  };
}

/**
 * Every column of the preview, in the dataset's order, with the
 * conversion it would get if saved now and the values it would leave
 * unmatched.
 */
export function buildPreviewColumns(
  options: Readonly<{
    columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
    picks: ApplyDictionariesState["picks"];
    codeLists: ReadonlyMap<string, DataDictionaryCodeList.T>;
    resolutions: ApplyDictionariesState["resolutions"];
    unmatchedByColumnId: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly UnmatchedValue[]>;
  }>,
): PreviewColumnPlan[] {
  return options.columns.map((column) => {
    return _toPlan(column, options.picks[column.id], options);
  });
}

/**
 * Changed when the conversion gives the cell a different value; otherwise
 * unmatched when its value is one no pair matches, else plain.
 */
export function getPreviewCellStatus(
  cell: PreviewCell,
  unmatchedKeys: ReadonlySet<string>,
): PreviewCellStatus {
  if (cell.converted !== undefined && cell.converted !== cell.raw) {
    return "changed";
  }
  return unmatchedKeys.has(toValueKey(cell.raw)) ? "unmatched" : "plain";
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Group, Table, VisuallyHidden } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconTag } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/ApplyPreviewDrawer.module.css";
import { getPreviewCellStatus } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/previewColumns";
import type {
  PreviewCellStatus,
  PreviewColumnPlan,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/previewColumns";
import type {
  PreviewCell,
  PreviewRow,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/usePreviewRows";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** The columns to show, with their index in every row. */
  shown: ReadonlyArray<{ index: number; plan: PreviewColumnPlan }>;
  rows: readonly PreviewRow[];
};

const EMPTY_CELL: PreviewCell = { raw: "", converted: undefined };

function PreviewHeader({ plan }: Readonly<{ plan: PreviewColumnPlan }>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Table.Th>
      <Group gap={4} wrap="nowrap">
        {plan.column.name}
        {plan.isReference ? (
          <>
            <IconTag size={12} aria-hidden />
            <VisuallyHidden>
              <Trans>attached as reference</Trans>
            </VisuallyHidden>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </Group>
    </Table.Th>
  );
}

function CellValue(props: Readonly<{ cell: PreviewCell; status: PreviewCellStatus }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { cell, status } = props;
  if (status === "changed") {
    return (
      <>
        <del className={css.previewOld}>{cell.raw}</del>{" "}
        <ins className={css.previewNew}>
          {cell.converted === "" ? <span className={css.previewEmpty}>{t`empty`}</span> : cell.converted}
        </ins>
      </>
    );
  }
  if (status === "unmatched") {
    return (
      <>
        {cell.raw}
        <VisuallyHidden>{t`, not in the list`}</VisuallyHidden>
      </>
    );
  }
  return cell.raw;
}

/**
 * The preview's rows: each shown column's stored values, what converted
 * columns turn them into, and which values stay unmatched.
 */
export function PreviewTable({ shown, rows }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Table stickyHeader fz="xs" verticalSpacing={4} horizontalSpacing="sm">
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          {shown.map(({ index, plan }) => {
            return <PreviewHeader key={index} plan={plan} />;
          })}
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      <Table.Tbody>
        {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => {
          return (
            // The rows have no identity of their own; their order is fixed.
            <Table.Tr key={rowIndex}>
              {shown.map(({ index, plan }) => {
                const cell = row[index] ?? EMPTY_CELL;
                const status = getPreviewCellStatus(cell, plan.unmatchedKeys);
                return (
                  <Table.Td key={index} className={css.previewCell} data-status={status}>
                    <CellValue cell={cell} status={status} />
                  </Table.Td>
                );
              })}
            </Table.Tr>
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Callout } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Center, CloseButton, Group, Loader, Switch, Text, Title } from "@mantine/core";
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/ApplyPreviewDrawer.module.css";
import { buildPreviewColumns } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/previewColumns";
import { PreviewTable } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/PreviewTable";
import {
  PREVIEW_ROW_COUNT,
  usePreviewRows,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/usePreviewRows";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { PreviewColumnPlan } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/previewColumns";
import type { ApplyLookups } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyLookups";
import type { ApplyFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFlow";
import type { TaggedRead } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useTaggedRead";
import type { PreviewRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/usePreviewRows";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** The drawer's id, for the Preview data button's `aria-controls`. */
export const PREVIEW_DRAWER_ID = "apply-dictionaries-preview";

type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
  flow: ApplyFlow;
  lookups: ApplyLookups;
  onClose: () => void;
};

/** Every column's plan, from the picks, resolutions, and unmatched values. */
function usePreviewPlans(props: Readonly<Props>): PreviewColumnPlan[] {
  const { columns, flow, lookups } = props;
  const { picks, resolutions } = flow.state;
  const { unmatched } = flow;
  return useMemo(() => {
    return buildPreviewColumns({
      columns,
      picks,
      codeLists: lookups.codeLists,
      resolutions,
      unmatchedByColumnId: unmatched.status === "ready" ? unmatched.result : new Map(),
    });
  }, [columns, picks, resolutions, unmatched, lookups.codeLists]);
}

function DrawerHeader(
  props: Readonly<{ headingId: string; isOnlyTouched: boolean; onOnlyTouchedChange: (isOnlyTouched: boolean) => void; onClose: () => void }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  const rowCountText = i18n.number(PREVIEW_ROW_COUNT);
  return (
    <Group className={css.applyPreviewHeader} justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap">
      <Group gap="xs" align="baseline" wrap="nowrap">
        <Title order={2} size="h6" id={props.headingId}>
          <Trans>Preview data</Trans>
        </Title>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
          {t`First ${rowCountText} rows`}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Group gap="md" wrap="nowrap">
        <Switch
          size="xs"
          label={t`Only columns this touches`}
          checked={props.isOnlyTouched}
          onChange={(event) => {
            props.onOnlyTouchedChange(event.currentTarget.checked);
          }}
        />
        <CloseButton aria-label={t`Close preview`} onClick={props.onClose} />
      </Group>
    </Group>
  );
}

function DrawerBody(
  props: Readonly<{ rows: TaggedRead<PreviewRow[]>; shown: ReadonlyArray<{ index: number; plan: PreviewColumnPlan }> }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (props.rows.status === "reading") {
    return (
      <Center p="lg">
        <Loader size="sm" />
      </Center>
    );
  }
  if (props.rows.status === "failed") {
    return (
      <Center p="lg">
        <Callout
          maw={520}
          title={t`The preview could not be read`}
          message={t`Avandar could not read this dataset's first rows. Saving still works.`}
        />
      </Center>
    );
  }
  return <PreviewTable shown={props.shown} rows={props.rows.result} />;
}

/**
 * The preview drawer: the dataset's first rows as they would look if saved
 * now, open at any step. It takes focus when it opens and closes on
 * Escape; the flow returns focus to Preview data.
 */
export function ApplyPreviewDrawer(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const headingId = useId();
  const regionRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [isOnlyTouched, setIsOnlyTouched] = useState(false);
  const plans = usePreviewPlans(props);
  const rows = usePreviewRows({ dataset: props.dataset, columns: plans, isEnabled: true });
  useEffect(() => {
    regionRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);
  const shown = plans.flatMap((plan, index) => {
    return !isOnlyTouched || plan.isTouched ? [{ index, plan }] : [];
  });
  return (
    <section
      id={PREVIEW_DRAWER_ID}
      ref={regionRef}
      tabIndex={-1}
      aria-labelledby={headingId}
      className={css.applyPreviewDrawer}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
          event.stopPropagation();
          props.onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DrawerHeader
        headingId={headingId}
        isOnlyTouched={isOnlyTouched}
        onOnlyTouchedChange={setIsOnlyTouched}
        onClose={props.onClose}
      />
      <div className={css.applyPreviewBody}>
        <DrawerBody rows={rows} shown={shown} />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

A `<section>` named by `aria-labelledby` is a `region` landmark. The preview reads every column once and the switch only filters, so toggling it never queries again; a change of pick, resolution, or direction changes the plans and so the read's key.

### Task 20: Save as: the linked dataset card, Attach, and saving

The last step (spec section 7.5). With no column converting it is the slice 3 **Attach** step, unchanged except that it now also sends the values added to code lists. With conversions it becomes **Save as**: where the converted values go, a summary of what happens to each column, and one primary button. A linked dataset's own apply has no choice to make, so it shows **Update <dataset>** instead of cards. Direction, with the `impeccable` skill loaded: the choice is Mantine `Radio.Card`s in a column no wider than the measure (`72ch`), a control rather than a container, so they follow the Data Sources surfaces (hairline border, `radius="sm"`, Brand Blue only on the chosen card), with the name field directly under the cards while the linked card is chosen.

This task builds the linked card only. Task 29 adds the **Change <dataset>** card beside it; nothing else here changes then, because the request builder, the pinned inputs, the save blocker for an unconfirmed synced change, and the **Change n columns** label are already in place.

- [ ] **Step 1: Every refusal in words.** Create `src/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyErrorMessage.ts`. `DictionaryBinding.toApplyErrorHint` knows every hint in the Contracts once Task 6 adds them to its list:

```ts
import { getIsOnline } from "@avandar/browser-utils";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";

/**
 * The toast for a refused apply, link, or re-apply, from the RPC's hint,
 * or the offline message when the connection dropped.
 */
export function useApplyErrorMessage(datasetName: string): (error: unknown) => string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const changedWhileApplying = t`A dictionary changed while you were applying it. Reload the page and try again.`;
  const messages: Record<DictionaryBinding.ApplyErrorHint, string> = {
    dataset_editor_required: t`You need edit access to ${datasetName} to apply a dictionary.`,
    dictionary_viewer_required: t`You can no longer read one of these dictionaries, so nothing was saved. Ask an admin for access to dictionaries.`,
    binding_payload_invalid: changedWhileApplying,
    column_not_in_dataset: changedWhileApplying,
    entry_not_in_dictionary: changedWhileApplying,
    code_list_not_in_entry: changedWhileApplying,
    binding_mode_unsupported: t`${datasetName} can't be changed in place, so nothing was saved. Create a linked dataset instead.`,
    convert_needs_code_list: t`A column set to convert has no code list. Attach it as reference only, or pick an entry with a code list.`,
    dataset_has_linked_datasets: t`A linked dataset reads ${datasetName}, so it can't be changed in place. Convert in the linked dataset instead.`,
    dictionary_editor_required: t`Adding values to a code list needs edit access to dictionaries, so nothing was saved. Choose another way to handle those values.`,
    code_pair_incomplete: t`A value you added to a code list is missing its label or code.`,
    codes_not_unique: t`A value you added is already in its code list, perhaps with different capitalization.`,
    labels_not_unique: t`A label you added is already used in its code list.`,
    dataset_creator_required: t`Only workspace admins can add datasets, so the linked dataset was not created.`,
    nothing_to_reapply: t`${datasetName} is already up to date.`,
  };
  const fallback = t`Nothing was saved. Please try again.`;
  const offline = t`You're offline. Reconnect to save this.`;
  return (error) => {
    if (!getIsOnline()) {
      return offline;
    }
    const hint = DictionaryBinding.toApplyErrorHint(error);
    return hint ? messages[hint] : fallback;
  };
}
```
