```ts
import { getIsOnline } from "@avandar/browser-utils";
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { uuid } from "$/lib/uuid";
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import { useIsMounted } from "@/lib/hooks/state/useIsMounted";
import { Logger } from "@/utils/Logger";
import { notifyError, notifySuccess } from "@/utils/notifications/notify";
import { invalidateAfterApply } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/invalidateAfterApply/invalidateAfterApply";
import { useApplyErrorMessage } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyErrorMessage";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { MutableRefObject } from "react";

type SaveContents = {
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.Input[];
  addedPairs: readonly DictionaryBinding.AddedPair[];
};

/**
 * One save of the apply flow: attach (nothing converts), change the
 * dataset in place, update a linked dataset's live conversions, or create
 * a new linked dataset.
 */
export type ApplySaveRequest =
  | (SaveContents & { kind: "attach" | "in_place" | "update_linked" })
  | (SaveContents & { kind: "linked"; linkedDatasetName: string });

type SaveRefs = {
  isSavingRef: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  requestRef: MutableRefObject<ApplySaveRequest | undefined>;
};

/** The success toast for a request. */
function useSuccessMessage(datasetName: string): (request: ApplySaveRequest) => string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (request) => {
    switch (request.kind) {
      case "attach":
        return request.bindings.length === 0
          ? t`Removed the dictionaries from ${datasetName}. The data is unchanged.`
          : t`Attached to ${datasetName}. The data is unchanged.`;
      case "in_place": {
        const convertedCount = request.bindings.filter((binding) => {
          return binding.mode === "convert";
        }).length;
        return plural(convertedCount, {
          one: `Changed # column of ${datasetName}.`,
          other: `Changed # columns of ${datasetName}.`,
        });
      }
      case "update_linked":
        return t`Updated ${datasetName}.`;
      case "linked": {
        const linkedName = request.linkedDatasetName.trim();
        return t`Created ${linkedName}. The code lists are attached to ${datasetName} for reference.`;
      }
    }
  };
}

/** Opens a dataset's page, unless the user already left the view. */
function useOpenDataset(): (datasetId: Dataset.Id, datasetName: string) => void {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const isMountedRef = useIsMounted();
  return (datasetId, datasetName) => {
    if (isMountedRef.current) {
      navigate(
        AppLinks.dataManagerDatasetView({ workspaceSlug: workspace.slug, datasetId, datasetName }),
      );
    }
  };
}

/**
 * What a successful save does: refresh what it changed, say so, and open
 * the dataset. A new linked dataset is opened by its own mutation, which
 * knows its id.
 */
function useOnSaved(dataset: Dataset.T): (request: ApplySaveRequest) => void {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const toMessage = useSuccessMessage(dataset.name);
  const openDataset = useOpenDataset();
  return (request) => {
    invalidateAfterApply(queryClient, {
      hasAddedPairs: request.addedPairs.length > 0,
    }).catch((error: unknown) => {
      Logger.error(error, { devMsg: "Refreshing after an apply failed" });
    });
    notifySuccess(toMessage(request));
    if (request.kind !== "linked") {
      openDataset(dataset.id, dataset.name);
    }
  };
}

/** The two apply mutations, sharing their failure and settle handling. */
function useSaveMutations(dataset: Dataset.T, refs: SaveRefs) {
  const onSaved = useOnSaved(dataset);
  const openDataset = useOpenDataset();
  const toErrorMessage = useApplyErrorMessage(dataset.name);
  const callbacks = {
    onError: (error: unknown) => {
      Logger.error(error, { devMsg: "Saving an apply failed" });
      notifyError(toErrorMessage(error));
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      refs.isSavingRef.current = false;
    },
  };
  const notifySaved = (): void => {
    if (refs.requestRef.current) {
      onSaved(refs.requestRef.current);
    }
  };
  const [applyToDataset, isApplying] = DictionaryBindingClient.useApplyToDataset({
    ...callbacks,
    onSuccess: notifySaved,
  });
  const [applyAsLinked, isLinking] = DictionaryBindingClient.useApplyAsLinkedDataset({
    ...callbacks,
    onSuccess: (linkedDatasetId, variables) => {
      notifySaved();
      openDataset(linkedDatasetId, variables.linkedDatasetName);
    },
  });
  return { applyToDataset, applyAsLinked, isSaving: isApplying || isLinking };
}

/**
 * Saves the apply flow's request in one call, then refreshes what it
 * changed, says what happened, and opens the dataset, or the new linked
 * dataset. A second press while one is in flight is ignored, a save while
 * offline says so and sends nothing, a refusal is explained from its hint,
 * and nothing navigates once the user has left the view.
 */
export function useSaveApply(
  dataset: Dataset.T,
): [save: (request: ApplySaveRequest) => void, isSaving: boolean] {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const isSavingRef = useRef(false);
  const requestRef = useRef<ApplySaveRequest | undefined>(undefined);
  const mutations = useSaveMutations(dataset, { isSavingRef, requestRef });
  const save = (request: ApplySaveRequest): void => {
    if (isSavingRef.current) {
      return;
    }
    if (!getIsOnline()) {
      notifyError(t`You're offline. Reconnect to save this.`);
      return;
    }
    isSavingRef.current = true;
    requestRef.current = request;
    const { bindings, addedPairs } = request;
    if (request.kind === "linked") {
      mutations.applyAsLinked({
        sourceDatasetId: dataset.id,
        linkedDatasetId: uuid<Dataset.Id>(),
        linkedDatasetName: request.linkedDatasetName.trim(),
        bindings,
        addedPairs,
      });
      return;
    }
    mutations.applyToDataset({ datasetId: dataset.id, bindings, addedPairs });
  };
  return [save, mutations.isSaving];
}
```

```ts
import {
  buildAddedPairs,
  buildBindingInputs,
  isConvertingPick,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type {
  ApplyDictionariesState,
  ColumnPick,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { ApplyTargets } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyTargets/applyTargets";
import type { UnmatchedValues } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useUnmatchedValues";
import type { ApplySaveRequest } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useSaveApply";

/** Why the primary button is disabled. */
export type SaveBlocker = "no_target" | "no_name" | "needs_confirmation";

/** What saving does to one column, for the summary table. */
export type WhatHappens =
  | { kind: "decode" | "encode"; restoresSource: boolean }
  | { kind: "reference" | "restored" | "described" }
  | { kind: "removed"; restoresValues: boolean };

/**
 * The save the step's state stands for, or undefined while there is no
 * target. A linked dataset updates its own live conversions; otherwise the
 * chosen target decides, and changing in place pins the conversions.
 */
export function buildSaveRequest(
  options: Readonly<{
    state: ApplyDictionariesState;
    columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
    unmatched: UnmatchedValues;
    isLinkedDataset: boolean;
    linkedDatasetName: string;
  }>,
): ApplySaveRequest | undefined {
  const { state } = options;
  const target = options.isLinkedDataset ? "update_linked" : state.saveTarget;
  if (!target) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const unmatchedByColumnId =
    options.unmatched.status === "ready" ? options.unmatched.result : new Map();
  const shared = {
    picks: state.picks,
    resolutions: state.resolutions,
    unmatchedByColumnId,
  };
  const bindings = buildBindingInputs({
    ...shared,
    columns: options.columns,
    isPinned: target === "in_place",
  });
  const addedPairs = buildAddedPairs(shared);
  return target === "linked"
    ? { kind: "linked", linkedDatasetName: options.linkedDatasetName, bindings, addedPairs }
    : { kind: target, bindings, addedPairs };
}

/**
 * Why the request cannot be saved yet: no target chosen, a linked dataset
 * with no name, or a synced upload changed in place without the
 * confirmation ticked.
 */
export function getSaveBlocker(
  options: Readonly<{
    request: ApplySaveRequest | undefined;
    targets: ApplyTargets | undefined;
    hasConfirmedWorkspaceChange: boolean;
  }>,
): SaveBlocker | undefined {
  const { request } = options;
  if (!request) {
    return "no_target";
  }
  if (request.kind === "linked" && request.linkedDatasetName.trim() === "") {
    return "no_name";
  }
  const isSynced = options.targets?.inPlace.storage === "synced";
  return request.kind === "in_place" && isSynced && !options.hasConfirmedWorkspaceChange
    ? "needs_confirmation"
    : undefined;
}

/**
 * What saving does to one column: it converts (and, for a source that was
 * converted in place, goes back to its values there), stays as reference,
 * goes back to its values, gets a description, or loses its dictionary.
 */
export function getWhatHappens(
  options: Readonly<{
    pick: ColumnPick | undefined;
    existing: DictionaryBinding.T | undefined;
  }>,
): WhatHappens {
  const { pick, existing } = options;
  const wasConverted = existing?.mode === "convert";
  if (!pick) {
    return { kind: "removed", restoresValues: wasConverted };
  }
  if (isConvertingPick(pick)) {
    return { kind: pick.direction, restoresSource: wasConverted };
  }
  if (!pick.codeListId) {
    return { kind: "described" };
  }
  return { kind: wasConverted ? "restored" : "reference" };
}
```

`restoresSource` matters only when the target is a linked dataset: the source's bindings become reference, so a column converted there in place goes back to its values. The summary table shows that line only for the linked target.

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Group, Radio, Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useId } from "react";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/SaveAsStep.module.css";
import type { ApplyTargets } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyTargets/applyTargets";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  datasetName: string;
  linked: ApplyTargets["linked"];
};

function useDescription(datasetName: string, linked: ApplyTargets["linked"]): string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (linked.isAvailable) {
    return t`A new dataset that reads ${datasetName} and converts its values as it loads. Later edits to the dictionaries show up in it right away.`;
  }
  return linked.reason === "dataset_limit"
    ? t`Your plan's dataset limit is reached, so a linked dataset can't be added.`
    : t`Only workspace admins can add datasets, so you can't create a linked dataset.`;
}

/**
 * The Create a new linked dataset card: named by its title, described by
 * what it does, or by why it is unavailable.
 */
export function LinkedDatasetCard({ datasetName, linked }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const titleId = useId();
  const descriptionId = useId();
  const description = useDescription(datasetName, linked);
  return (
    <Radio.Card
      value="linked"
      disabled={!linked.isAvailable}
      className={css.saveTargetCard}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      aria-describedby={descriptionId}
    >
      <Group wrap="nowrap" align="flex-start" gap="sm">
        <Radio.Indicator disabled={!linked.isAvailable} />
        <Stack gap={2}>
          <Text id={titleId} fw={600} size="sm">
            <Trans>Create a new linked dataset</Trans>
          </Text>
          <Text id={descriptionId} size="xs" c="dimmed">
            {description}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
    </Radio.Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Radio, Stack, Text, TextInput } from "@mantine/core";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import { LinkedDatasetCard } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/LinkedDatasetCard";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type {
  ApplyDictionariesAction,
  ApplyDictionariesState,
  SaveTarget,
} from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { ApplyTargets } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyTargets/applyTargets";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  targets: ApplyTargets;
  state: ApplyDictionariesState;
  /** The linked dataset's name as typed, or its default. */
  linkedDatasetName: string;
  dispatch: Dispatch<ApplyDictionariesAction>;
};

/**
 * Where the converted values go, as radio cards, then the linked
 * dataset's name while that card is chosen, and the reminder that the
 * code lists are attached to the dataset either way.
 */
export function SaveTargetCards(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { dataset, targets, state, dispatch } = props;
  const datasetName = dataset.name;
  return (
    <AppViewSection title={<Trans>Save the conversions as</Trans>}>
      <Stack gap="md" maw="72ch">
        <Radio.Group
          value={state.saveTarget ?? ""}
          onChange={(value) => {
            dispatch({ type: "set_save_target", saveTarget: value as SaveTarget });
          }}
        >
          <Stack gap="sm">
            <LinkedDatasetCard datasetName={datasetName} linked={targets.linked} />
          </Stack>
        </Radio.Group>
        {state.saveTarget === "linked" ? (
          <TextInput
            label={t`Name`}
            value={props.linkedDatasetName}
            onChange={(event) => {
              dispatch({ type: "set_linked_name", name: event.currentTarget.value });
            }}
          />
        ) : null}
        <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
          {t`Either way, the code lists and descriptions are attached to ${datasetName} for reference.`}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </AppViewSection>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Group, Stack, Table, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconTag } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { getWhatHappens } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/saveRequest";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { WhatHappens } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/saveRequest";
import type { ColumnPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { ApplyLookups } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyLookups";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  datasetName: string;
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
  picks: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnPick>>;
  existingBindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[];
  lookups: ApplyLookups;
  /** Whether the conversions go to a new linked dataset. */
  isLinkedTarget: boolean;
};

function useConversionText(happens: Extract<WhatHappens, { kind: "decode" | "encode" }>, isLinkedTarget: boolean): string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  if (happens.kind === "decode") {
    return isLinkedTarget ? t`Codes become labels in the linked dataset` : t`Codes become labels`;
  }
  return isLinkedTarget ? t`Labels become codes in the linked dataset` : t`Labels become codes`;
}

function ConversionCell(
  props: Readonly<{ happens: Extract<WhatHappens, { kind: "decode" | "encode" }>; pick: ColumnPick; columnName: string; datasetName: string; isLinkedTarget: boolean }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const text = useConversionText(props.happens, props.isLinkedTarget);
  const originalName = `${props.columnName}_original`;
  const datasetName = props.datasetName;
  return (
    <Stack gap={2}>
      <Text size="sm">{text}</Text>
      {props.pick.keepsOriginal ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{t`Keeps the original values in ${originalName}`}</Text>
      ) : null}
      {props.isLinkedTarget && props.happens.restoresSource ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{t`Back to the original values in ${datasetName}`}</Text>
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function WhatHappensCell(
  props: Readonly<{ happens: WhatHappens; pick: ColumnPick | undefined; columnName: string; datasetName: string; isLinkedTarget: boolean }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { happens } = props;
  switch (happens.kind) {
    case "decode":
    case "encode":
      return props.pick ? <ConversionCell {...props} happens={happens} pick={props.pick} /> : null;
    case "reference":
      return (
        <Group gap={6} wrap="nowrap">
          <IconTag size={14} aria-hidden />
          <Trans>Attached as reference, values unchanged</Trans>
        </Group>
      );
    case "restored":
      return <Trans>Back to the original values</Trans>;
    case "described":
      return <Trans>Description added</Trans>;
    case "removed":
      return happens.restoresValues ? <Trans>Removed, back to the original values</Trans> : <Trans>Removed</Trans>;
  }
}

function SummaryRow(
  props: Readonly<
    Pick<Props, "datasetName" | "lookups" | "isLinkedTarget"> & {
      column: DatasetColumn.T;
      pick: ColumnPick | undefined;
      existing: DictionaryBinding.T | undefined;
    }
  >,
): ReactNode {
  const { column, pick, existing, lookups } = props;
  const dictionaryId = pick?.dictionaryId ?? existing?.dictionaryId;
  const entryId = pick?.entryId ?? existing?.entryId;
  const dictionaryName = dictionaryId ? (lookups.dictionaryNames.get(dictionaryId) ?? "") : "";
  const entryName = entryId ? (lookups.entries.get(entryId)?.name ?? "") : "";
  return (
    <Table.Tr>
      <Table.Td fw={500}>{column.name}</Table.Td>
      <Table.Td>
        <Trans>
          {dictionaryName} › {entryName}
        </Trans>
      </Table.Td>
      <Table.Td>
        <WhatHappensCell
          happens={getWhatHappens({ pick, existing })}
          pick={pick}
          columnName={column.name}
          datasetName={props.datasetName}
          isLinkedTarget={props.isLinkedTarget}
        />
      </Table.Td>
    </Table.Tr>
  );
}

/**
 * One row per column the save touches, in the dataset's order: where its
 * entry comes from and what happens to it. A column losing its dictionary
 * is listed too.
 */
export function SaveSummaryTable(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const existingByColumnId = new Map(
    props.existingBindings.map((binding) => {
      return [binding.datasetColumnId, binding] as const;
    }),
  );
  const touched = props.columns.filter((column) => {
    return props.picks[column.id] !== undefined || existingByColumnId.has(column.id);
  });
  return (
    <Table layout="fixed" verticalSpacing="xs">
      <Table.Thead>
        <Table.Tr>
          <Table.Th w="24%">
            <Trans>Column</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>From</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
          <Table.Th>
            <Trans>What happens</Trans>
          </Table.Th>
        </Table.Tr>
      </Table.Thead>
      <Table.Tbody>
        {touched.map((column) => {
          return (
            <SummaryRow
              key={column.id}
              {...props}
              column={column}
              pick={props.picks[column.id]}
              existing={existingByColumnId.get(column.id)}
            />
          );
        })}
      </Table.Tbody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { plural } from "@lingui/core/macro";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { AppViewBody } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewBody/AppViewBody";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import { isConvertingPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import { AttachStep } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/AttachStep/AttachStep";
import { buildSaveRequest, getSaveBlocker } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/saveRequest";
import { SaveFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/SaveFooter";
import { SaveSummaryTable } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/SaveSummaryTable";
import { SaveTargetCards } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/SaveAsStep/SaveTargetCards";
import { useDefaultLinkedName } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useDefaultLinkedName";
import { useSaveApply } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useSaveApply";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { ApplyLookups } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyLookups";
import type { ApplyCounts } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFacts";
import type { ApplyFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFlow";
import type { ApplySaveRequest } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useSaveApply";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
  existingBindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[];
  flow: ApplyFlow;
  counts: ApplyCounts;
  lookups: ApplyLookups;
  summary: string;
  /** The preview drawer, between the body and the footer. */
  preview: ReactNode;
};

/** The primary button's words for a request. */
function useSaveLabel(datasetName: string, request: ApplySaveRequest | undefined): string {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  switch (request?.kind) {
    case "linked":
      return t`Create linked dataset`;
    case "in_place": {
      const convertedCount = request.bindings.filter((binding) => {
        return binding.mode === "convert";
      }).length;
      return plural(convertedCount, { one: "Change # column", other: "Change # columns" });
    }
    case "update_linked":
      return t`Update ${datasetName}`;
    default:
      return t`Save`;
  }
}

function UpdateLinkedSection({ datasetName }: Readonly<{ datasetName: string }>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  return (
    <AppViewSection title={t`Update ${datasetName}`}>
      <Text size="sm" maw="72ch">
        <Trans>Its conversions follow the dictionaries, so later edits to them show up here right away.</Trans>
      </Text>
    </AppViewSection>
  );
}

function SaveAsBody(
  props: Readonly<Props & { linkedDatasetName: string; isLinkedTarget: boolean }>,
): ReactNode {
  const { dataset, flow } = props;
  const { state, targets } = flow;
  return (
    <AppViewBody>
      <Stack gap="xl">
        {targets && !targets.isLinkedDataset ? (
          <SaveTargetCards
            dataset={dataset}
            targets={targets}
            state={state}
            linkedDatasetName={props.linkedDatasetName}
            dispatch={flow.dispatch}
          />
        ) : (
          <UpdateLinkedSection datasetName={dataset.name} />
        )}
        <AppViewSection title={<Trans>Summary</Trans>} meta={props.summary}>
          <SaveSummaryTable
            datasetName={dataset.name}
            columns={props.columns}
            picks={state.picks}
            existingBindings={props.existingBindings}
            lookups={props.lookups}
            isLinkedTarget={props.isLinkedTarget}
          />
        </AppViewSection>
      </Stack>
    </AppViewBody>
  );
}

function ConvertingSave(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { dataset, flow } = props;
  const { state, targets } = flow;
  const defaultName = useDefaultLinkedName(dataset.name, state.picks);
  const linkedDatasetName = state.linkedDatasetName ?? defaultName;
  const request = buildSaveRequest({
    state,
    columns: props.columns,
    unmatched: flow.unmatched,
    isLinkedDataset: targets?.isLinkedDataset ?? false,
    linkedDatasetName,
  });
  const blocker = getSaveBlocker({
    request,
    targets,
    hasConfirmedWorkspaceChange: state.hasConfirmedWorkspaceChange,
  });
  const label = useSaveLabel(dataset.name, request);
  const [save, isSaving] = useSaveApply(dataset);
  return (
    <>
      <SaveAsBody
        {...props}
        linkedDatasetName={linkedDatasetName}
        isLinkedTarget={request?.kind === "linked"}
      />
      {props.preview}
      <SaveFooter
        label={label}
        isDisabled={blocker !== undefined}
        isSaving={isSaving}
        onBack={() => {
          flow.dispatch({ type: "go_to_step", step: "unmatched" });
        }}
        onSave={() => {
          if (request) {
            save(request);
          }
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The last step of applying: Attach when nothing converts; otherwise Save
 * as, with where the conversions go, what happens to each column, and the
 * button that saves it all in one call.
 */
export function SaveAsStep(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const isConverting = Object.values(props.flow.state.picks).some(isConvertingPick);
  return isConverting ? <ConvertingSave {...props} /> : <AttachStep {...props} />;
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Stack } from "@mantine/core";
import { AppViewBody } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewBody/AppViewBody";
import { AppViewSection } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewSection/AppViewSection";
import { buildAddedPairs, buildBindingInputs } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import { AttachFooter } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/AttachStep/AttachFooter";
import { AttachSummaryTable } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/AttachStep/AttachSummaryTable";
import { AttachSummaryText } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/AttachStep/AttachSummaryText";
import { useSaveApply } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useSaveApply";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { DatasetColumn } from "$/models/datasets/DatasetColumn/DatasetColumn";
import type { ColumnPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { ApplyLookups } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyLookups";
import type { ApplyCounts } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFacts";
import type { ApplyFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFlow";
import type { ApplySaveRequest } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useSaveApply";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  columns: readonly DatasetColumn.T[];
  existingBindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[];
  flow: ApplyFlow;
  counts: ApplyCounts;
  lookups: ApplyLookups;
  summary: string;
  /** The preview drawer, between the body and the footer. */
  preview: ReactNode;
};

/** The picked columns, how many bound columns lose their dictionary, and the save. */
function useAttachRequest(props: Readonly<Props>): {
  picked: Array<{ column: DatasetColumn.T; pick: ColumnPick }>;
  removedCount: number;
  request: ApplySaveRequest;
} {
  const { state, unmatched } = props.flow;
  const picked = props.columns.flatMap((column) => {
    const pick = state.picks[column.id];
    return pick ? [{ column, pick }] : [];
  });
  const removedCount = props.existingBindings.filter((binding) => {
    return state.picks[binding.datasetColumnId] === undefined;
  }).length;
  const unmatchedByColumnId = unmatched.status === "ready" ? unmatched.result : new Map();
  const shared = { picks: state.picks, resolutions: state.resolutions, unmatchedByColumnId };
  const request: ApplySaveRequest = {
    kind: "attach",
    bindings: buildBindingInputs({ ...shared, columns: props.columns, isPinned: false }),
    addedPairs: buildAddedPairs(shared),
  };
  return { picked, removedCount, request };
}

/**
 * The Attach step, when nothing converts: what attaching does, one row per
 * picked column, and the button that writes every binding, and any value
 * added to a code list, at once. Attaching needs a connection.
 */
export function AttachStep(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const datasetName = props.dataset.name;
  const { picked, removedCount, request } = useAttachRequest(props);
  const [save, isAttaching] = useSaveApply(props.dataset);
  return (
    <>
      <AppViewBody>
        <Stack gap="xl">
          <AppViewSection title={t`Attach to ${datasetName}`}>
            <AttachSummaryText counts={props.counts} removedCount={removedCount} />
          </AppViewSection>
          {picked.length > 0 ? (
            <AppViewSection title={<Trans>Summary</Trans>} meta={props.summary}>
              <AttachSummaryTable picked={picked} lookups={props.lookups} />
            </AppViewSection>
          ) : null}
        </Stack>
      </AppViewBody>
      {props.preview}
      <AttachFooter
        datasetName={datasetName}
        pickedCount={picked.length}
        removedCount={removedCount}
        isAttaching={isAttaching}
        onBack={() => {
          props.flow.dispatch({ type: "go_to_step", step: "unmatched" });
        }}
        onAttach={() => {
          save(request);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Task 21: The apply view: three steps, facts, and the step bar

Wires Tasks 15 to 20 into the view. The step bar reads **Match columns · Unmatched values (n) · Save as**, where `n` is how many values no pair matches once they are read; the last step is **Attach** when no column converts, and **Save** for a linked dataset's own apply. The header's facts follow spec section 7.5 (`6 converted · 1 attached as reference · 3 described · of 22 columns · from 2 of 2 dictionaries`) and its actions gain **Preview data**, which toggles the drawer (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`); closing the drawer, by Escape or its close button, returns focus to **Preview data**. Focus still moves to the step's heading on a step change. The reference e2e spec walks the new steps.

- [ ] **Step 2: Labels and facts.** Replace `useApplyStepLabels.ts`:

```ts
import { useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import type { ApplyStep } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";

/**
 * The name of each apply step, as the step bar and its heading say it:
 * Unmatched values with its count once read, and the last step Save as
 * when a column converts, Save for a linked dataset's own conversions, and
 * Attach when nothing converts.
 */
export function useApplyStepLabels(
  options: Readonly<{
    isConverting: boolean;
    isLinkedDataset: boolean;
    /** Values no pair matches; undefined while they are read. */
    unmatchedCount: number | undefined;
  }>,
): Record<ApplyStep, string> {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  const countText =
    options.unmatchedCount === undefined ? undefined : i18n.number(options.unmatchedCount);
  const save = !options.isConverting
    ? t`Attach`
    : options.isLinkedDataset
      ? t`Save`
      : t`Save as`;
  return {
    match: t`Match columns`,
    unmatched: countText === undefined ? t`Unmatched values` : t`Unmatched values (${countText})`,
    save,
  };
}
```

```ts
/** Counts the picks: conversions, code lists, descriptions, and dictionaries used. */
export function countPicks(
  picks: Readonly<Record<string, ColumnPick>>,
): ApplyCounts {
  const all = Object.values(picks);
  const convertedCount = all.filter(isConvertingPick).length;
  const codedCount = all.filter((pick) => {
    return pick.codeListId !== undefined;
  }).length;
  return {
    convertedCount,
    attachedCount: codedCount - convertedCount,
    describedCount: all.length - codedCount,
    usedDictionaryCount: new Set(
      all.map((pick) => {
        return pick.dictionaryId;
      }),
    ).size,
  };
}
```

Replace `useApplyFacts` with these two functions, so a conversion count leads the facts:

```ts
/** The facts about the picks, each left out when it is zero. */
function usePickedFacts(counts: Readonly<ApplyCounts>): string[] {
  const { convertedCount, attachedCount, describedCount } = counts;
  const convertedText = plural(convertedCount, { one: "# converted", other: "# converted" });
  const attachedText = plural(attachedCount, {
    one: "# attached as reference",
    other: "# attached as reference",
  });
  const describedText = plural(describedCount, { one: "# described", other: "# described" });
  return [
    ...(convertedCount > 0 ? [convertedText] : []),
    ...(attachedCount > 0 ? [attachedText] : []),
    ...(describedCount > 0 ? [describedText] : []),
  ];
}

/**
 * The apply header's facts: `6 converted · 1 attached as reference · 3
 * described · of 22 columns · from 2 of 2 dictionaries`. Counts that are
 * zero are left out.
 */
export function useApplyFacts(
  options: Readonly<{
    counts: ApplyCounts;
    columnCount: number;
    dictionaryCount: number;
  }>,
): string[] {
  const { t, i18n } = useLingui();
  const pickedFacts = usePickedFacts(options.counts);
  const usedText = i18n.number(options.counts.usedDictionaryCount);
  const columnsText = plural(options.columnCount, {
    one: "of # column",
    other: "of # columns",
  });
  const dictionariesText = plural(options.dictionaryCount, {
    one: `from ${usedText} of # dictionary`,
    other: `from ${usedText} of # dictionaries`,
  });
  return [
    ...(pickedFacts.length > 0 ? pickedFacts : [t`Nothing picked yet`]),
    columnsText,
    dictionariesText,
  ];
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Route the three steps.** Replace `ApplyStepBody.tsx`'s `Props` and exported component:

```tsx
type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  data: ApplyDictionariesData;
  flow: ApplyFlow;
  counts: ApplyCounts;
  lookups: ApplyLookups;
  summary: string;
  /** The preview drawer, or null while it is closed. */

};

/** The current step, or why it cannot show yet. */
export function ApplyStepBody(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const { flow } = props;
  if (flow.hasReadFailed) {
    return (
      <Center flex={1} p="lg">
        <Callout
          maw={520}
          title={t`The columns could not be read`}
          message={t`Avandar could not read this dataset's columns to match them. Please try again later or reach out to support.`}
        />
      </Center>
    );
  }
  if (flow.isMatching || flow.state.dictionaryIds === undefined) {
    return <ReadingColumns datasetName={props.dataset.name} />;
  }
  return <CurrentStep {...props} />;
}
```

```tsx
function CurrentStep(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { dataset, data, flow, lookups, preview } = props;
  const columns = data.columns ?? [];
  switch (flow.state.step) {
    case "match":
      return (
        <MatchColumnsStep
          flow={flow}
          dataset={dataset}
          dictionaries={data.dictionaries}
          lookups={lookups}
          summary={props.summary}
          preview={preview}
        />
      );
    case "unmatched":
      return (
        <UnmatchedValuesStep dataset={dataset} columns={columns} flow={flow} lookups={lookups} preview={preview} />
      );
    case "save":
      return (
        <SaveAsStep
          dataset={dataset}
          columns={columns}
          existingBindings={data.existingBindings}
          flow={flow}
          counts={props.counts}
          lookups={lookups}
          summary={props.summary}
          preview={preview}
        />
      );
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The flow view.** Replace `ApplyDictionariesFlowView.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { AppView } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppView";
import { ApplyDictionariesHeader } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/ApplyDictionariesHeader";
import { ApplyDictionariesStepHeading } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/ApplyDictionariesStepHeading";
import { ApplyDictionariesStepper } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/ApplyDictionariesStepper";
import { isConvertingPick } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyInputs/applyInputs";
import { makeApplyLookups } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyLookups";
import { ApplyStepBody } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/ApplyStepBody";
import { ApplyPreviewDrawer } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/PreviewDrawer/ApplyPreviewDrawer";
import { useApplyFacts, countPicks } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFacts";
import { useApplyFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFlow";
import { useApplyStepLabels } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyStepLabels";
import { useApplyTargets } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyTargets";
import type { DataDictionary } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionary/DataDictionary";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { ApplyStep } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyDictionariesReducer/applyDictionariesReducer";
import type { ApplyLookups } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/applyLookups";
import type { ApplyDictionariesData } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyDictionariesData";
import type { ApplyCounts } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFacts";
import type { ApplyFlow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/ApplyDictionariesView/useApplyFlow";
import type { ReactNode, RefObject } from "react";

type Props = {
  dataset: Dataset.T;
  data: ApplyDictionariesData;
  preselectedDictionaryId: DataDictionary.Id | undefined;
};

/** How many values no pair matches, once they are read. */
function _countUnmatched(flow: ApplyFlow): number | undefined {
  if (flow.unmatched.status !== "ready") {
    return undefined;
  }
  return [...flow.unmatched.result.values()].reduce((total, values) => {
    return total + values.length;
  }, 0);
}

/** The drawer while it is open; closing it returns focus to Preview data. */
function usePreview(
  props: Readonly<Props & { flow: ApplyFlow; lookups: ApplyLookups }>,
): { preview: ReactNode; buttonRef: RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null> } {
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const { flow } = props;
  const close = (): void => {
    flow.dispatch({ type: "set_preview_open", isOpen: false });
    buttonRef.current?.focus();
  };
  const preview = flow.state.isPreviewOpen ? (
    <ApplyPreviewDrawer
      dataset={props.dataset}
      columns={props.data.columns ?? []}
      flow={flow}
      lookups={props.lookups}
      onClose={close}
    />
  ) : null;
  return { preview, buttonRef };
}

/** The labels, facts, and lookups the frame shows. */
function useFrame(props: Readonly<Props & { flow: ApplyFlow }>): {
  counts: ApplyCounts;
  facts: string[];
  labels: Record<ApplyStep, string>;
  lookups: ApplyLookups;
} {
  const { flow, data } = props;
  const counts = countPicks(flow.state.picks);
  const facts = useApplyFacts({
    counts,
    columnCount: data.columns?.length ?? 0,
    dictionaryCount: flow.state.dictionaryIds?.length ?? 0,
  });
  const labels = useApplyStepLabels({
    isConverting: Object.values(flow.state.picks).some(isConvertingPick),
    isLinkedDataset: flow.targets?.isLinkedDataset ?? false,
    unmatchedCount: _countUnmatched(flow),
  });
  const { dictionaries, entries, codeLists } = data;
  const lookups = useMemo(() => {
    return makeApplyLookups({ dictionaries, entries, codeLists });
  }, [dictionaries, entries, codeLists]);
  return { counts, facts, labels, lookups };
}

/**
 * The apply flow once everything it reads has loaded: the header with what
 * the picks add up to and Preview data, the step bar, the current step,
 * and the preview drawer between the step and its footer.
 */
export function ApplyDictionariesFlowView(props: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const targets = useApplyTargets({
    dataset: props.dataset,
    existingBindings: props.data.existingBindings,
  });
  const flow = useApplyFlow({
    data: props.data,
    preselectedDictionaryId: props.preselectedDictionaryId,
    targets,
  });
  const { counts, facts, labels, lookups } = useFrame({ ...props, flow });
  const { preview, buttonRef } = usePreview({ ...props, flow, lookups });
  return (
    <AppView>
      <ApplyDictionariesHeader
        dataset={props.dataset}
        facts={facts}
        isPreviewOpen={flow.state.isPreviewOpen}
        isPreviewAvailable={!flow.isMatching}
        onTogglePreview={() => {
          flow.dispatch({ type: "set_preview_open", isOpen: !flow.state.isPreviewOpen });
        }}
        previewButtonRef={buttonRef}
      />
      <ApplyDictionariesStepper step={flow.state.step} labels={labels} dispatch={flow.dispatch} />
      <ApplyDictionariesStepHeading step={flow.state.step} labels={labels} />
      <ApplyStepBody
        dataset={props.dataset}
        data={props.data}
        flow={flow}
        counts={counts}
        lookups={lookups}
        summary={facts.join(" · ")}
        preview={preview}
      />
    </AppView>
  );
}
```

Only someone who can edit the dataset and read dictionaries gets in."

### Task 22: The dataset page: menu sub-line, rail, popover, read-only type, linked source, and delete confirm

Everything a dataset page says about conversions. The ⋯ menu's **Apply a dictionary** gets back the spec's "Turn codes into labels and add column descriptions" (slice 3 owner decision 6). The rail's Dictionaries group says, per dictionary, every way it reaches this dataset: attached as reference, converted as it loads (a linked dataset's own conversions), converted in place with the version it was given, and each linked dataset that reads this one. A linked dataset's Source group names the dataset it reads. The code-list popover says the values were converted, and with which version, and, read only when it opens, how many values in the data have no label (spec 14). The Type cell of a converted column is read-only and says which dictionary set it. Deleting a dataset that linked datasets read names them first (owner question 7).

Linked datasets are found through the cached `VirtualDatasetClient` (`where("linked_source_dataset_id", "eq", datasetId)`), with `VirtualDataset.T["linkedSourceDatasetId"]` from Task 6. `ColumnCodes.T` comes from Task 13: for a `convert` binding, `direction` is the side the column holds once converted (`encode` means it now holds labels), and `isPinned`, `appliedDictionaryVersion`, `currentDictionaryVersion`, `isSourceDeleted`, and `keepsOriginal` say the rest.

A linked dataset whose source was deleted has `linkedSourceDatasetId` undefined, exactly like a plain virtual dataset. Only a linked dataset can hold live (unpinned) convert bindings (Task 4's apply rules), and deleting a source pins nothing, so the rail tells the two apart by that: a virtual dataset with no source id and a live conversion says "The dataset it reads was deleted.".

```ts
import { prop, where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { VirtualDatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/source-datasets/VirtualDatasetClient";
import { ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT } from "@/config/queryOptions.constants";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";

/** One linked dataset that reads another dataset. */
export type LinkedDataset = {
  id: Dataset.Id;
  name: string;
  /** The dictionaries its conversions come from. */
  dictionaryIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
};

/** The linked datasets that read one dataset, sorted by name. */
export type LinkedDatasets = {
  linkedDatasets: readonly LinkedDataset[];
  isLoading: boolean;
};

const NO_LINKED_DATASETS: readonly LinkedDataset[] = [];

function _getConvertingDictionaryIds(
  datasetId: Dataset.Id,
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
): Set<string> {
  return new Set(
    bindings.flatMap((binding) => {
      return binding.datasetId === datasetId &&
        binding.mode === "convert" &&
        binding.dictionaryId !== undefined
        ? [binding.dictionaryId]
        : [];
    }),
  );
}

function _toLinkedDatasets(
  datasets: readonly Dataset.T[],
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
): LinkedDataset[] {
  return datasets
    .map((dataset) => {
      return {
        id: dataset.id,
        name: dataset.name,
        dictionaryIds: _getConvertingDictionaryIds(dataset.id, bindings),
      };
    })
    .sort((datasetA, datasetB) => {
      return datasetA.name.localeCompare(datasetB.name);
    });
}

/**
 * The linked datasets that read one dataset, that the user can see, each
 * with the dictionaries it converts with. A linked dataset created a
 * moment ago is listed, since the virtual datasets refetch on mount. Used
 * by the dataset's rail and its delete confirmation.
 */
export function useLinkedDatasets(
  datasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined,
): LinkedDatasets {
  const [virtualDatasets, isLoadingVirtual] = VirtualDatasetClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("linked_source_dataset_id", "eq", datasetId),
    useQueryOptions: {
      ...ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT,
      enabled: datasetId !== undefined,
    },
  });
  const linkedIds = useMemo(() => {
    return (virtualDatasets ?? []).map(prop("datasetId"));
  }, [virtualDatasets]);
  const hasLinked = linkedIds.length > 0;
  const [datasets, isLoadingDatasets] = DatasetClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("id", "in", linkedIds),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: hasLinked },
  });
  const [bindings, isLoadingBindings] = DictionaryBindingClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("dataset_id", "in", linkedIds),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: hasLinked },
  });
  const linkedDatasets = useMemo(() => {
    return hasLinked
      ? _toLinkedDatasets(datasets ?? [], bindings ?? [])
      : NO_LINKED_DATASETS;
  }, [hasLinked, datasets, bindings]);
  return {
    linkedDatasets,
    isLoading:
      isLoadingVirtual || (hasLinked && (isLoadingDatasets || isLoadingBindings)),
  };
}
```

```tsx
                <List.Item key={linkedDataset.id}>{linkedDataset.name}</List.Item>
              );
            })}
          </List>
```

- [ ] **Step 17: Write it.** `src/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/DatasetColumnCodes/describeDictionaryUses/describeDictionaryUses.ts`:

```ts
import type { ColumnCodes } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnCodes/ColumnCodes";
import type { LinkedDataset } from "@/hooks/datasets/useLinkedDatasets/useLinkedDatasets";

/** One way a dictionary reaches a dataset, as the dataset's rail says it. */
export type DictionaryUseNote =
  | { kind: "reference" }
  | { kind: "converted_live" }
  | {
      kind: "converted_pinned";
      /** The oldest version any of the dataset's columns was given. */
      appliedVersion: number;
      /** Undefined once the dictionary is deleted. */
      currentVersion: number | undefined;
    }
  | { kind: "linked"; datasetId: string; datasetName: string };

/** One dictionary in a dataset's rail, with every way it is applied. */
export type DictionaryUse = {
  /** Empty for a deleted dictionary whose pinned conversions remain. */
  dictionaryId: string;
  dictionaryName: string;
  notes: readonly DictionaryUseNote[];
};

function _groupByDictionary(
  columnCodes: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnCodes.T>,
): Map<string, ColumnCodes.T[]> {
  const byDictionary = new Map<string, ColumnCodes.T[]>();
  columnCodes.forEach((codes) => {
    const group = byDictionary.get(codes.dictionaryId) ?? [];
    byDictionary.set(codes.dictionaryId, [...group, codes]);
  });
  return byDictionary;
}

function _getPinnedNote(
  group: readonly ColumnCodes.T[],
): DictionaryUseNote | undefined {
  const pinned = group.filter((codes) => {
    return codes.mode === "convert" && codes.isPinned;
  });
  const [first] = pinned;
  if (!first) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const appliedVersion = Math.min(
    ...pinned.map((codes) => {
      return codes.appliedDictionaryVersion;
    }),
  );
  return {
    kind: "converted_pinned",
    appliedVersion,
    currentVersion: first.currentDictionaryVersion,
  };
}

function _getNotes(
  dictionaryId: string,
  group: readonly ColumnCodes.T[],
  linkedDatasets: readonly LinkedDataset[],
): DictionaryUseNote[] {
  const hasReference = group.some((codes) => {
    return codes.mode === "reference";
  });
  const isConvertedLive = group.some((codes) => {
    return codes.mode === "convert" && !codes.isPinned;
  });
  const pinnedNote = _getPinnedNote(group);
  const linkedNotes = linkedDatasets.flatMap((linkedDataset) => {
    return dictionaryId !== "" && linkedDataset.dictionaryIds.has(dictionaryId)
      ? [
          {
            kind: "linked" as const,
            datasetId: linkedDataset.id,
            datasetName: linkedDataset.name,
          },
        ]
      : [];
  });
  return [
    ...(hasReference ? [{ kind: "reference" as const }] : []),
    ...(isConvertedLive ? [{ kind: "converted_live" as const }] : []),
    ...(pinnedNote ? [pinnedNote] : []),
    ...linkedNotes,
  ];
}

/**
 * Every dictionary that reaches a dataset, with how: attached as
 * reference, converted as it loads (a linked dataset's own conversions),
 * converted in place with the oldest version its columns were given, and
 * each linked dataset that converts with it. Sorted by name, with a
 * deleted dictionary's pinned conversions last. Used by the dataset rail.
 */
export function describeDictionaryUses(
  columnCodes: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnCodes.T>,
  linkedDatasets: readonly LinkedDataset[],
): DictionaryUse[] {
  return [..._groupByDictionary(columnCodes)]
    .map(([dictionaryId, group]) => {
      return {
        dictionaryId,
        dictionaryName: group[0]?.dictionaryName ?? "",
        notes: _getNotes(dictionaryId, group, linkedDatasets),
      };
    })
    .sort((useA, useB) => {
      if ((useA.dictionaryId === "") !== (useB.dictionaryId === "")) {
        return useA.dictionaryId === "" ? 1 : -1;
      }
      return useA.dictionaryName.localeCompare(useB.dictionaryName);
    });
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/DatasetColumnCodes/DatasetDictionariesRailGroup.module.css";
import type { DictionaryUseNote as DictionaryUseNoteT } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/DatasetColumnCodes/describeDictionaryUses/describeDictionaryUses";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  note: DictionaryUseNoteT;
};

/** A linked dataset that reads this one, linked by name. */
function LinkedDatasetNote({
  datasetId,
  datasetName,
}: Readonly<{ datasetId: string; datasetName: string }>): ReactNode {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const link = AppLinks.dataManagerDatasetView({
    workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
    datasetId,
    datasetName,
  });
  const datasetLink = (
    <Link to={link.to} params={link.params} size="xs">
      {datasetName}
    </Link>
  );
  return <Trans>Linked dataset: {datasetLink}</Trans>;
}

/** The pinned version, and how far behind the dictionary it is. */
function PinnedNote({
  appliedVersion,
  currentVersion,
}: Readonly<{
  appliedVersion: number;
  currentVersion: number | undefined;
}>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  const isBehind =
    currentVersion !== undefined && currentVersion > appliedVersion;
  const appliedText = i18n.number(appliedVersion);
  const nowText = i18n.number(currentVersion ?? appliedVersion);
  return (
    <>
      <Trans>Converted this dataset · version {appliedText}</Trans>
      {isBehind ? (
        <Text span display="block" size="xs" c="warning">
          <Trans>
            Applied version {appliedText}, now version {nowText}
          </Trans>
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * One line under a dictionary in a dataset's rail, saying one way the
 * dictionary reaches the dataset.
 */
export function DictionaryUseNote({ note }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  return (
    <Text component="dd" size="xs" c="dimmed" className={css.dictionaryNote}>
      {note.kind === "reference" ? (
        <Trans>Attached as reference · data unchanged</Trans>
      ) : null}
      {note.kind === "converted_live" ? (
        <Trans>Converted as it loads · follows the dictionary</Trans>
      ) : null}
      {note.kind === "converted_pinned" ? (
        <PinnedNote
          appliedVersion={note.appliedVersion}
          currentVersion={note.currentVersion}
        />
      ) : null}
      {note.kind === "linked" ? (
        <LinkedDatasetNote
          datasetId={note.datasetId}
          datasetName={note.datasetName}
        />
      ) : null}
    </Text>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconBook } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { AppViewRail } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewRail/AppViewRail";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import css from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/DatasetColumnCodes/DatasetDictionariesRailGroup.module.css";
import { describeDictionaryUses } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/DatasetColumnCodes/describeDictionaryUses/describeDictionaryUses";
import { DictionaryUseNote } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/DatasetColumnCodes/DictionaryUseNote";
import type { ColumnCodes } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnCodes/ColumnCodes";
import type { LinkedDataset } from "@/hooks/datasets/useLinkedDatasets/useLinkedDatasets";
import type { DictionaryUse } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DatasetMetaView/DatasetColumnCodes/describeDictionaryUses/describeDictionaryUses";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  columnCodes: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnCodes.T>;
  /** The linked datasets that read this dataset. */
  linkedDatasets: readonly LinkedDataset[];
};

/** A dictionary's name, linked, or "A deleted dictionary". */
function DictionaryName({ use }: Readonly<{ use: DictionaryUse }>): ReactNode {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  if (use.dictionaryId === "") {
    return (
      <Text span size="sm">
        <Trans>A deleted dictionary</Trans>
      </Text>
    );
  }
  const link = AppLinks.dataManagerDictionaryView({
    workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
    dictionaryId: use.dictionaryId,
    dictionaryName: use.dictionaryName,
  });
  return (
    <Link to={link.to} params={link.params} size="sm">
      {use.dictionaryName}
    </Link>
  );
}

/**
 * The rail group naming each dictionary that reaches a dataset, one row
 * each, with every way it is applied underneath: attached as reference,
 * converted in place or as it loads, and each linked dataset that reads
 * this one. Nothing renders while no dictionary is attached.
 */
export function DatasetDictionariesRailGroup({
  columnCodes,
  linkedDatasets,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const uses = describeDictionaryUses(columnCodes, linkedDatasets);
  if (uses.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }
  return (
    <AppViewRail.Group title={<Trans>Dictionaries</Trans>}>
      {uses.map((use) => {
        return (
          <div key={use.dictionaryId} className={css.dictionaryRow}>
            <dt className={css.dictionaryName}>
              <IconBook size={16} stroke={1.5} aria-hidden />
              <DictionaryName use={use} />
            </dt>
            {use.notes.map((note) => {
              const key = note.kind === "linked" ? note.datasetId : note.kind;
              return <DictionaryUseNote key={key} note={note} />;
            })}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </AppViewRail.Group>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@avandar/ui";
import { where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { AppViewRail } from "@/components/layouts/AppView/AppViewRail/AppViewRail";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import type { ColumnCodes } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnCodes/ColumnCodes";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** The virtual dataset's `linkedSourceDatasetId`. */
  linkedSourceDatasetId: Dataset.Id | undefined;
  columnCodes: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnCodes.T>;
};

/**
 * Whether any column converts as it loads. Only a linked dataset holds
 * live conversions, so a virtual dataset with one and no source id is a
 * linked dataset whose source was deleted.
 */
function _hasLiveConversions(
  columnCodes: ReadonlyMap<string, ColumnCodes.T>,
): boolean {
  return [...columnCodes.values()].some((codes) => {
    return codes.mode === "convert" && !codes.isPinned;
  });
}

/**
 * The rail fact naming the dataset a linked dataset reads, linked to it,
 * or saying it was deleted. Renders nothing for a virtual dataset that is
 * not linked.
 */
export function LinkedSourceFact({
  linkedSourceDatasetId,
  columnCodes,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { t } = useLingui();
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const [sourceDatasets] = DatasetClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("id", "in", linkedSourceDatasetId ? [linkedSourceDatasetId] : []),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: linkedSourceDatasetId !== undefined },
  });
  if (linkedSourceDatasetId === undefined) {
    return _hasLiveConversions(columnCodes) ? (
      <AppViewRail.Fact label={t`Reads`}>
        <Trans>The dataset it reads was deleted.</Trans>
      </AppViewRail.Fact>
    ) : null;
  }
  const sourceDataset = sourceDatasets?.[0];
  if (!sourceDataset) {
    return null;
  }
  const link = AppLinks.dataManagerDatasetView({
    workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
    datasetId: sourceDataset.id,
    datasetName: sourceDataset.name,
  });
  return (
    <AppViewRail.Fact label={t`Reads`}>
      <Link to={link.to} params={link.params} size="sm">
        {sourceDataset.name}
      </Link>
    </AppViewRail.Fact>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 33: Write the SQL builder.** `src/components/dataDictionaries/CodeListPopover/buildUnlabeledValueCountSql/buildUnlabeledValueCountSql.ts`:

```ts
import { quoteSqlIdentifier, quoteSqlLiteral } from "@avandar/utils/sql";
import { ColumnConversion } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnConversion/ColumnConversion";
import { getRawValuesViewName } from "@/clients/DuckDbClient/duckDbSqlText";

/** The most distinct values the count reads before it stops. */
const MAX_COUNTED_VALUES = 1000;

/**
 * SQL counting the distinct values of a converted column that no pair
 * labels, read from the dataset's raw-values view, as `unlabeled_count`.
 * A value an override maps to a label or empties has a result of its own
 * and is not counted; a value kept as is still has no label and is.
 * Stops at 1,000 values. Used by a converted column's code-list popover.
 */
export function buildUnlabeledValueCountSql(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetId: string;
    columnName: string;
    conversion: ColumnConversion.T;
  }>,
): string {
  const unmatchedSql = ColumnConversion.toUnmatchedValuesSql({
    relationSql: quoteSqlIdentifier(getRawValuesViewName(options.datasetId)),
    valueSql: quoteSqlIdentifier(options.columnName),
    conversion: { ...options.conversion, overrides: [] },
    limit: MAX_COUNTED_VALUES,
  });
  const resolvedKeys = options.conversion.overrides
    .filter((override) => {
      return override.action !== "keep";
    })
    .map((override) => {
      return `lower(trim(${quoteSqlLiteral(override.value)}))`;
    });
  const filter =
    resolvedKeys.length === 0
      ? ""
      : ` WHERE ${ColumnConversion.toValueKeySql('unmatched."value"')} NOT IN (${resolvedKeys.join(", ")})`;
  return `SELECT count(*) AS unlabeled_count FROM (${unmatchedSql}) AS unmatched${filter}`;
}
```

  This reads `toUnmatchedValuesSql`'s value column by its name, `value` (Task 7).

- [ ] **Step 37: Write the footer.** `src/components/dataDictionaries/CodeListPopover/CodeListPopoverFooter.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import type { ColumnCodes } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnCodes/ColumnCodes";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  codes: ColumnCodes.T;
};

/** What a conversion did, and which entry it came from. */
function ConvertedSentence({ codes }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { dictionaryName, entryName } = codes;
  // A converted column's `direction` is the side it holds now.
  const holdsLabels = codes.direction === "encode";
  if (codes.isSourceDeleted) {
    return holdsLabels ? (
      <Trans>
        The values were converted to these labels. The dictionary entry they
        came from was deleted.
      </Trans>
    ) : (
      <Trans>
        The values were converted to these codes. The dictionary entry they
        came from was deleted.
      </Trans>
    );
  }
  return holdsLabels ? (
    <Trans>
      From {dictionaryName} › {entryName}. The values were converted to these
      labels.
    </Trans>
  ) : (
    <Trans>
      From {dictionaryName} › {entryName}. The values were converted to these
      codes.
    </Trans>
  );
}

/** The version a pinned conversion was given, and the current one. */
function PinnedSentence({ codes }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  const appliedVersion = i18n.number(codes.appliedDictionaryVersion);
  const current = codes.currentDictionaryVersion;
  if (current !== undefined && current > codes.appliedDictionaryVersion) {
    const currentVersion = i18n.number(current);
    return (
      <Trans>
        Converted with version {appliedVersion} of the dictionary. The
        dictionary is now at version {currentVersion}.
      </Trans>
    );
  }
  return <Trans>Converted with version {appliedVersion} of the dictionary.</Trans>;
}

/**
 * Where a column's code list came from and what it did to the values:
 * attached as reference, or converted, with the pinned version and the
 * kept original values when they apply. The foot of `CodeListPopover`.
 */
export function CodeListPopoverFooter({ codes }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { dictionaryName, entryName } = codes;
  if (codes.mode === "reference") {
    return (
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        <Trans>
          From {dictionaryName} › {entryName}. Attached as reference. The values
          in the data are unchanged.
        </Trans>
      </Text>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        <ConvertedSentence codes={codes} />{" "}
        {codes.isPinned ? <PinnedSentence codes={codes} /> : null}
      </Text>
      {codes.keepsOriginal ? (
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
          <Trans>
            The original values are kept beside it, in a column ending in
            _original.
          </Trans>
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { where } from "@avandar/utils";

import { buildUnlabeledValueCountSql } from "@/components/dataDictionaries/CodeListPopover/buildUnlabeledValueCountSql/buildUnlabeledValueCountSql";
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { DatasetQueryClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetQueryClient";
import { WorkspaceQuerySession } from "@/clients/qetl/WorkspaceQuerySession/WorkspaceQuerySession";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import type { ColumnCodes } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnCodes/ColumnCodes";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";

/** The binding's conversion, as the count needs it. */
function _toConversion(
  codes: ColumnCodes.T,
  binding: DictionaryBinding.T,
): Parameters<typeof buildUnlabeledValueCountSql>[0]["conversion"] {
  return {
    datasetColumnId: codes.datasetColumnId,
    direction: binding.direction,
    pairs: [...codes.pairs].map((pair) => {
      return { ...pair, acceptedSpellings: [...pair.acceptedSpellings] };
    }),
    isOrdered: codes.isOrdered,
    overrides: binding.valueOverrides,
    keepsOriginalAs: undefined,
    outputDataType: "varchar",
    inputDataType: undefined,
  };
}

/**
 * How many distinct values of a converted column have no label, read on
 * this device when it is first asked for. The query key sits under
 * `DatasetQueryClient`, so whatever refreshes a dataset's rows refreshes
 * the count too. Used by a converted column's code-list popover.
 */
export function useUnlabeledValueCount(
  options: Readonly<{
    datasetId: Dataset.Id;
    columnName: string;
    codes: ColumnCodes.T;
  }>,
): { count: number | undefined } {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { datasetId, columnName, codes } = options;
  const [bindings] = DictionaryBindingClient.useGetAll(
    where("dataset_column_id", "eq", codes.datasetColumnId),
  );
  const binding = bindings?.[0];
  const { data } = useQuery({
    queryKey: [
      DatasetQueryClient.getClientName(),
      "unlabeledValueCount",
      datasetId,
      columnName,
      binding?.updatedAt,
      codes.pairs,
    ],
    enabled: binding !== undefined && binding.mode === "convert",
    queryFn: async () => {
      const result = await WorkspaceQuerySession.runQuery({
        workspaceId: workspace.id,
        rawSql: buildUnlabeledValueCountSql({
          datasetId,
          columnName,
          conversion: _toConversion(codes, binding!),
        }),
      });
      return Number(result.data[0]?.unlabeled_count ?? 0);
    },
  });
  return { count: data };
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from "@avandar/ui";
import { Plural, Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { useUnlabeledValueCount } from "@/components/dataDictionaries/CodeListPopover/useUnlabeledValueCount";
import { AppLinks } from "@/config/AppLinks/AppLinks";
import { useCurrentWorkspace } from "@/hooks/workspaces/useCurrentWorkspace";
import type { ColumnCodes } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/ColumnCodes/ColumnCodes";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  datasetId: Dataset.Id;
  columnName: string;
  codes: ColumnCodes.T;
};

/**
 * "3 values in the data have no label." for a converted column, with a
 * link to label them on the dictionary. Mounted only while the popover is
 * open, so the count is read only when someone looks. Renders nothing
 * while it reads, and when every value has a label.
 */
export function UnlabeledValuesNote({
  datasetId,
  columnName,
  codes,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const workspace = useCurrentWorkspace();
  const { count } = useUnlabeledValueCount({ datasetId, columnName, codes });
  if (!count) {
    return null;
  }
  const { dictionaryName } = codes;
  const link = AppLinks.dataManagerDictionaryView({
    workspaceSlug: workspace.slug,
    dictionaryId: codes.dictionaryId,
    dictionaryName,
  });
  return (
    <Text size="xs">
      <Plural
        value={count}
        one="# value in the data has no label."
        other="# values in the data have no label."
      />{" "}
      {codes.isSourceDeleted ? null : (
        <Link to={link.to} params={link.params} size="xs">
          <Trans>Label them in {dictionaryName}</Trans>
        </Link>
      )}
    </Text>
  );
}
```

### Task 23: The Dictionary view's Used by: Linked, Changed the data, and status

The Used by tab says how the dictionary reaches each dataset (spec 7.2): **Reference** (data unchanged, always current), **Linked** (updates when this dictionary changes), or **Changed the data** (keeps the version it was given), and a Status of "Up to date" or "Applied version 2, now version 3". A dataset is Linked when its convert bindings are live, which only a linked dataset (`sourceType` `virtual`) can hold, and Changed the data when they are pinned (Task 4's rules). Its applied version is the oldest version any pinned convert binding with a code list still in place was given: a binding pinned because its list was deleted cannot be re-applied, so it does not make the row look behind. Task 30 adds **Re-apply** to a row that is behind.

A dictionary save changes what a converted column shows, and can change its type (Task 3), so saving also refreshes the datasets' columns and every query showing dataset rows. Task 10's projection key then rebuilds the loaded views, and an open linked dataset shows the new labels without a reload.

- [ ] **Step 3: Rewrite the hook.** Replace `useDictionaryUsage.ts` with:

```ts
import { prop, where } from "@avandar/utils";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { DictionaryBindingClient } from "@/clients/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBindingClient";
import { DatasetClient } from "@/clients/datasets/DatasetClient/DatasetClient";
import { ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT } from "@/config/queryOptions.constants";
import type { DataDictionary } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DataDictionary/DataDictionary";
import type { DictionaryBinding } from "$/models/dataDictionaries/DictionaryBinding/DictionaryBinding";
import type { Dataset } from "$/models/datasets/Dataset/Dataset";

/**
 * How a dictionary reaches a dataset's values: attached as reference,
 * converted as the dataset loads (a linked dataset), or converted in place
 * with the version it was given.
 */
export type DictionaryUsageHow = "reference" | "linked" | "changed";

/** One dataset a dictionary is applied to, as the Used by tab lists it. */
export type DictionaryUsageRow = {
  datasetId: Dataset.Id;
  datasetName: string;
  sourceType: Dataset.T["sourceType"];
  /** How many of the dictionary's entries the dataset's columns use. */
  entryCount: number;
  howApplied: DictionaryUsageHow;
  /**
   * The oldest version a pinned conversion that can be re-applied was
   * given, or undefined when none is pinned.
   */
  appliedVersion: number | undefined;
  /** Whether that version is older than the dictionary's. */
  isBehind: boolean;
};

/** The datasets a dictionary is applied to, sorted by name. */
export type DictionaryUsage = {
  rows: readonly DictionaryUsageRow[];
  /** The dictionary's version now. */
  currentVersion: number;
  isLoading: boolean;
  /** True when the bindings or their datasets could not be read. */
  hasError: boolean;
};

function _getHowApplied(
  dataset: Dataset.T,
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
): DictionaryUsageHow {
  const isConverted = bindings.some((binding) => {
    return binding.mode === "convert";
  });
  if (!isConverted) {
    return "reference";
  }
  return dataset.sourceType === "virtual" ? "linked" : "changed";
}

/** The oldest version a re-appliable pinned conversion was given. */
function _getAppliedVersion(
  bindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
): number | undefined {
  const versions = bindings
    .filter((binding) => {
      return (
        binding.mode === "convert" &&
        binding.pinnedPairs !== undefined &&
        binding.codeListId !== undefined
      );
    })
    .map(prop("appliedDictionaryVersion"));
  return versions.length === 0 ? undefined : Math.min(...versions);
}

function _toRow(
  dataset: Dataset.T,
  allBindings: readonly DictionaryBinding.T[],
  currentVersion: number,
): DictionaryUsageRow {
  const bindings = allBindings.filter((binding) => {
    return binding.datasetId === dataset.id;
  });
  const appliedVersion = _getAppliedVersion(bindings);
  return {
    datasetId: dataset.id,
    datasetName: dataset.name,
    sourceType: dataset.sourceType,
    entryCount: new Set(bindings.map(prop("entryId"))).size,
    howApplied: _getHowApplied(dataset, bindings),
    appliedVersion,
    isBehind: appliedVersion !== undefined && appliedVersion < currentVersion,
  };
}

/**
 * The datasets one dictionary is applied to, that the user can see, with
 * how each uses it and whether a pinned conversion is behind the
 * dictionary's current version. A dataset the user cannot read is never
 * counted, because its bindings are hidden with it. Bindings refetch on
 * mount, so an apply made a moment ago is listed. Used by the Dictionary
 * view's header and Used by tab.
 */
export function useDictionaryUsage(
  options: Readonly<{
    dictionaryId: DataDictionary.Id;
    currentVersion: number;
  }>,
): DictionaryUsage {
  const { dictionaryId, currentVersion } = options;
  const [bindings, isLoadingBindings, bindingsQuery] =
    DictionaryBindingClient.useGetAll({
      ...where("dictionary_id", "eq", dictionaryId),
      useQueryOptions: ALWAYS_REFETCH_ON_MOUNT,
    });
  const datasetIds = useMemo(() => {
    return [...new Set((bindings ?? []).map(prop("datasetId")))];
  }, [bindings]);
  const [datasets, isLoadingDatasets, datasetsQuery] = DatasetClient.useGetAll({
    ...where("id", "in", datasetIds),
    useQueryOptions: { enabled: datasetIds.length > 0 },
  });
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const readable = datasetIds.length > 0 ? (datasets ?? []) : [];
    return readable
      .map((dataset) => {
        return _toRow(dataset, bindings ?? [], currentVersion);
      })
      .sort((rowA, rowB) => {
        return rowA.datasetName.localeCompare(rowB.datasetName);
      });
  }, [bindings, datasets, datasetIds, currentVersion]);
  return {
    rows,
    currentVersion,
    isLoading: isLoadingBindings || isLoadingDatasets,
    hasError: bindingsQuery.isError || datasetsQuery.isError,
  };
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge, Group, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import { IconLink, IconReplace, IconTag } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import type { DictionaryUsageHow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/useDictionaryUsage/useDictionaryUsage";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  howApplied: DictionaryUsageHow;
};

const ICON_BY_HOW = {
  reference: IconTag,
  linked: IconLink,
  changed: IconReplace,
} as const satisfies Record<DictionaryUsageHow, unknown>;

/** The badge naming how a dataset uses the dictionary. */
function HowAppliedBadgeText({ howApplied }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  switch (howApplied) {
    case "reference":
      return <Trans>Reference</Trans>;
    case "linked":
      return <Trans>Linked</Trans>;
    case "changed":
      return <Trans>Changed the data</Trans>;
  }
}

/** What that means for the dataset's values. */
function HowAppliedNote({ howApplied }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  switch (howApplied) {
    case "reference":
      return <Trans>data unchanged, always current</Trans>;
    case "linked":
      return <Trans>updates when this dictionary changes</Trans>;
    case "changed":
      return <Trans>keeps the version it was given</Trans>;
  }
}

/**
 * The Used by tab's "How it was applied" cell: a badge, then what it
 * means for the dataset's values.
 */
export function HowAppliedCell({ howApplied }: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const Icon = ICON_BY_HOW[howApplied];
  return (
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
      <Badge
        size="sm"
        variant="light"
        color="neutral"
        tt="none"
        flex="none"
        leftSection={<Icon size={12} aria-hidden />}
      >
        <HowAppliedBadgeText howApplied={howApplied} />
      </Badge>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
        <HowAppliedNote howApplied={howApplied} />
      </Text>
    </Group>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Trans, useLingui } from "@lingui/react/macro";
import { Badge, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import type { DictionaryUsageRow } from "@/views/DataManagerApp/DataDictionaryView/useDictionaryUsage/useDictionaryUsage";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = {
  row: DictionaryUsageRow;
  currentVersion: number;
};

/**
 * The Used by tab's Status cell: "Up to date", or the version a dataset
 * changed in place was given beside the dictionary's current one.
 */
export function UsageStatusCell({
  row,
  currentVersion,
}: Readonly<Props>): ReactNode {
  const { i18n } = useLingui();
  if (!row.isBehind || row.appliedVersion === undefined) {
    return (
      <Badge size="sm" variant="light" color="success" tt="none">
        <Trans>Up to date</Trans>
      </Badge>
    );
  }
  const appliedVersion = i18n.number(row.appliedVersion);
  const nowVersion = i18n.number(currentVersion);
  return (
    <Text size="xs" c="warning">
      <Trans>
        Applied version {appliedVersion}, now version {nowVersion}
      </Trans>
    </Text>
  );
}
```

### Task 24: Eval: converted columns

No prompt changes (owner question 5): a converted column's code line is written for the side it holds (Task 13), `  - GENDER: values Male, Female`, which `data-agent-v5` already reads as stored labels. The eval proves the agents then filter on labels. The measles workspace gains a second dataset, the line list's linked dataset `measles-line-list-small (labeled)`, built by the same `ColumnConversion.toCaseSql` the app's view uses, so `GENDER`, `hosp_yn`, and `ses_cat` hold labels (`ses_cat` as the ordered `ENUM`, and `GENDER`'s unlabeled `9` passed through as `'9'`). Its columns carry the codes as Task 13's loaders hand them to the agents: `direction: "encode"`, the side a decoded column holds. Three questions name it:

| Id | Question | Truth |
